ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MG07Leyawiin_STAGE100_LOG0: I have delivered the amulet to Dagail.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE03A_STAGE5_LOG0: I should now make my way back to New Sheoth and report my success to Sheogorath.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TG01BestThief_STAGE50_LOG1: 1. I can't kill anyone while I'm on the job. Animals and monsters are fair game though.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TG01BestThief_STAGE50_LOG2: 2. Never steal from anyone in the Thieves Guild.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TG01BestThief_STAGE50_LOG3: 3. Never steal from beggars and peasants, especially in the Waterfront. The Gray Fox protects them.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MQ01_STAGE80_LOG0_1: <RT_BlueMed>Walking</> while sneaking makes much less noise, increasing your chance of remaining undetected.

ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_DEM02_STAGE30_LOG0: A Dremora named "Mehrunes' Harbinger" told me to kill a guard to prove my worth in Mehrunes Dagon's eyes.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS16B_STAGE10_LOG0: A Dunmer named Fathis Ules has told me that Albert Jemane, Reynald and Guilbert's father, stole a valuable item from the Thieves Guild many years ago. He's offered to pay me well to return this item to him in Chorrol. Fathis believes it's now hidden inside of Redguard Valley Cave, which he's marked on my map.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS23_STAGE5_LOG0: A Dunmer named Ralsa Norvalo has approached me in the Imperial City Temple District and asked me to meet her husband Gilen. I refused for now, and she told me if I change my mind, to come to her house where she'll fill me in on all of the details.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS23_STAGE10_LOG0: A Dunmer named Ralsa Norvalo has approached me, and said that her husband needs assistance in a matter of what she calls "the utmost importance to the safety of the citizens of the Imperial City". She told me to meet Gilen at the house of someone named Seridur. Apparently, all will be explained when I get there.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS93_STAGE10_LOG0: A High Elf Sorceress named Varulae has asked me to retrieve her crystal ball, located in the hold of the ship the Serpent's Wake, which is moored up in Anvil Bay. The crystal ball is in a chest in the ship's hold. I should be careful, however -- the crew have all been slain, and now roam the ship's decks as creatures of undeath.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MG05Fingers_STAGE10_LOG0: A High Elf named Earana in Chorrol has asked me to bring her a book so that she may translate it. I need to travel to Cloud Top to find the book.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_DEM02_STAGE10_LOG0: A Mythic Dawn undercover agent named Ranaline told me to go to Mingo Cave, wearing the Mythic Dawn's attire.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_ND03_STAGE50_LOG0: A bear attacked me in the sacred grove, but I made no attempts to fight back. A cave has been revealed, and it would seem the Boots of the Crusader are waiting inside.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TG09Arrow_STAGE25_LOG0: A beggar in Bravil told me that Fathis Aren has claimed the ruined tower southeast of the city for himself. The door to the tower is impenetrable, but rumor has it that Fathis uses a secret passage from inside the castle to get to it.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TG05Misdirection_STAGE4_LOG0: A beggar reminded me that I can find S'krivva in the Lonely Suitor Lodge, or at home.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TG06Atonement_STAGE8_LOG0: A beggar reminded me that S'krivva can be found at the Lonely Suitors Lodge and at the Arena. I'll need to speak with her to see if there are any special Thievs Guild assignments available.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TG07Lex_STAGE5_LOG0: A beggar told me I could find S'krivva at the Lonely Suitor Lodge.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TG01BestThief_STAGE15_LOG0: A beggar told me that Amantius Allectus lives in the Temple district, on the far east side.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TG04Mistake_STAGE42_LOG0: A beggar told me that Hlidara Mothril, Alessia Caro's chambermaid, might be able to tell me where she keeps her ring. I'll have to sweet talk her though.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TG00FindThievesGuild_STAGE40_LOG0: A beggar told me that if I want to find the Gray Fox, I should look for the Garden of Dareloth in the Waterfront District of the Imperial City around midnight. The Gray Fox is the only clue I have to the mysterious Thieves Guild.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TG07Lex_STAGE12_LOG0: A beggar told me that there may be secret ways in the castle. I am supposed to find the blacksmith. I'm not really sure why.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MQ01_STAGE82_LOG0_0: A closed eye indicates you are <RT_BlueMed>undetected</>. The eye slowly opens as you are about to be detected.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MQ01_STAGE82_LOG0:
A closed eye indicates you are <RT_BlueMed>undetected</>. The eye slowly opens as you are about to be detected.

If the eye is fully open and opaque, you have been <RT_BlueMed>detected</>.

When a <RT_BlueMed>fight begins</>, the eye will flicker and two chevrons will appear on its sides.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_DL9MehrunesQuest_STAGE17_LOG0: A diary I've found contains a password to explore further, and seems to indicate that some kind of army is amassing here, led by somebody named Drothan.  If I can find the journal in his cabin, I may be able to learn more.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS11_STAGE150_LOG0: A full day has passed, and I haven't made it to Boreal Stone Cave to stop Raynil. I fear I may be too late. I should hasten there as soon as I can to confirm my theory.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS29_STAGE10_LOG0: A group calling themselves the Society of Concerned Merchants has hired me to investigate a new store that's just opened up in the Market District with ridiculously low prices. They suspect the owner must be doing something illegal. I should pay a visit to Thoronir at The Copious Coinpurse.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_DEM01_STAGE10_LOG0: A guard told me about strange notes in the Imperial City's Talos Plaza. It seems to be related to the Mythic Dawn. I should go there and try to find one.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE01Door_STAGE20_LOG0: A guard, Gaius Prentus, has approached me. He tells me that the people here have all returned from inside this strange gate, and all are now mad.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_DAHermaeusMora_STAGE10_LOG0: A man has told me that Hermaeus Mora wishes for me to visit his shrine.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE10_STAGE5_LOG0: A messenger has arrived for me in Sheogorath's throne room.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_DEAk01_STAGE40_LOG0: A powerful magic is preventing me from going further. I should tell of my findings to Ilav.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_DEAk01_STAGE20_LOG0: A priest named Ilav Dralgoner mentioned an Ayleid ruin, Beldaburo. He says it's where these disappearances are occurring. I must investigate.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE46_STAGE10_LOG0: A resident of Split has told me I should speak to Horkvir Bear-Arm to help solve the problem of all the doubles in this town. There are two Horkvir Bear-Arms in town, so I can speak to either one.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MG10Vahtacen_STAGE30_LOG0: A room in Vahtacen contains a pillar that reacts to magic. I need to figure out how it works, but I must be careful so that I am not harmed. It's been suggested that I should stay away from anything but simple, single-effect spells.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE13_STAGE20_LOG0: A second Obelisk has activated. I need to shut it down to stop the Knights from overwhelming the defenders.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE13_STAGE30_LOG0: A third Obelisk has activated. I need to shut it down.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_Dark10SanctuaryFIN_STAGE10_LOG0: According to Lucien Lachance, I will now receive my contracts, as well as any rewards I may be owed,  by visiting secret dead drop locations scattered around Cyrodiil. My next contract can be found in a hidden hollow inside the moss-covered rock on the top of Hero Hill, which is to the southeast of Fort Farragut.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_ND01_STAGE20_LOG0: According to Sir Amiel's journal, the Helm of the Crusader is located in Pelinal's shrine.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_DLCFrostcragSpire_STAGE10_LOG0: According to a deed that's been delivered to me, I've inherited a property called Frostcrag Spire from a long-lost relative. I've marked its location on my map. At the next opportunity, I should make my way out there and inspect my new acquisition.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_DLCDeepscorn_STAGE10_LOG0: According to a mysterious message that's been delivered to me, I've inherited an underground lair called Deepscorn Hollow from a long-lost relative. It's situated at the southernmost point of Cyrodiil, south of Leyawiin. I've marked its location on my map. At the next opportunity, I should make my way out there and inspect my new acquisition.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_Dark09Retirement_STAGE20_LOG0: Adamus Phillida is dead. I may return now to the Sanctuary for my reward. If I want to receive a bonus, however, there is one more task I must complete. Phillida wears an Imperial Legion ring. I should take his finger, with the ring still attached, and put it in the desk of Phillida's Imperial Legion successor, in his office in the Imperial City.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MG01Destruct_STAGE100_LOG0: Adrienne Berene has agreed to send a recommendation to the Arcane University on my behalf.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SQ09_STAGE110_LOG0: Aelwin Merowald at the Weye Settlement needed 12 Rumare Slaughterfish Scales. After berating me for fishing "his" waters, he traded me an amulet for the scales.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SQ09_STAGE10_LOG0: Aelwin Merowald at the Weye Settlement southwest of the Imperial City is looking to acquire 12 Rumare Slaughterfish Scales to sell to a customer. He's asked me to do the legwork, as he's getting quite old and can't handle the difficult task. The Rumare slaughterfish is a special breed of slaughterfish that can only be found in Lake Rumare, directly north of Weye.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE11_STAGE160_LOG0: After I approached the Grove Of Reflection, a shadowy image of myself appeared from the waters of the grove and attacked me. I defeated it, and now the Tree of Shades is beckoning to me...
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_DAVaermina_STAGE20_LOG0: After I left an offering of a black soul gem, Vaermina's followers summoned the Daedra, who spoke to me. Vaermina told me of an Orb that had been stolen by the wizard Arkved. I am to travel to his tower, retrieve the Orb, and bring it back to Vaermina.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_DASheogorath_STAGE30_LOG0: After I left the requested items at the Shrine, Haskill spoke to me. He told me of the settlement of Border Watch. I am to simulate a prophecy by committing two acts. I should speak to the shaman in the settlement to learn about the K'Sharra prophecy.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_DASheogorath_STAGE30_LOG1: After I left the requested items at the Shrine, Sheogorath spoke to me. He told me of the settlement of Border Watch. I am to simulate a prophecy by committing two acts. I should speak to the shaman in the settlement to learn about the K'Sharra prophecy.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_DAMeridia_STAGE20_LOG0: After I made the correct offering, Meridia appeared and spoke to me. The Daedra told me of a cult of necromancers in the Howling Cave who have been stealing from graves in order to raise an undead army. Meridia wants the necromancers killed. I can reach them from a secret door in the back of the cave.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_DAHircine_STAGE20_LOG0: After I made the required offering, Hircine was summoned, and spoke to me. He told me that he desires the horn of a unicorn. I may be able to find a unicorn in the Harcane Grove.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_DASanguine_STAGE20_LOG0: After I provided the offering to Sanguine, the Daedra Prince spoke to me. Sanguine believes that the Countess of Leyawiin is too stuffy, and wants me to do something about it. She will be hosting a dinner party tomorrow, and I am to sneak into the castle undetected and cast the spell of Stark Reality on her.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS13_STAGE80_LOG0: After I touched the Sigil Stone, I appeared outside of Oblivion and back on Tamriel. The gate has been destroyed. I should report my actions to Amminus Gregori as soon as possible.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS13_STAGE80_LOG1: After I touched the Sigil Stone, I found myself outside of Oblivion and back on Tamriel. The gate is now nowhere to be found. I should now speak with Farwil.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE07B_STAGE40_LOG0: After Thadon rose to deliver an odd soliloquy, he clutched his heart and fell to the ground dead. I should now collect as much of his tainted blood as possible.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS11_STAGE40_LOG0: After asking around Bruma, I've discovered that Raynil has been staying at Olav's Tap and Tack while he's been in town. The inn is located next to the city gates. This should be my next destination if I'm to question Raynil.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS31_STAGE70_LOG0: After discussing the futility of her plan, Selene has agreed to hand back the control of the Bloated Float to Ormil. I should speak to Ormil to find out what he wishes me to do with her.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS04_STAGE60_LOG0: After entering the farmhouse, I encountered Faustina who enticed me to remove my weapons, armor and clothing and place them aside. Once I did so, she yelled out and the rest of the gang entered the room fully armed and ready for battle. I had no choice but to kill them.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS04_STAGE60_LOG1: After entering the farmhouse, I encountered Faustina who tried to convince me to join in on their scheme. When I told her no, she yelled out and the rest of the gang entered the room fully armed and ready for battle. I had no choice but to kill them.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS04_STAGE60_LOG2: After entering the farmhouse, I encountered Faustina who tried to entice me to remove my weapons, armor and clothing and place them aside. Knowing this was a ruse, I refused. She yelled out and the rest of the gang entered the room fully armed and ready for battle. I had no choice but to kill them.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS05_STAGE80_LOG0: After giving him the four Dreamworld Elements, I've succeeded in convincing Henantier he was in a dream, and we've returned to the real world. I should speak to him now that we're back.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE07B_STAGE55_LOG0: After informing Sheogorath of my victory, Syl, the Duchess of Dementia became furious. Before she stormed out of the Sacellum, she threatened that we hadn't heard the last of her. I should continue speaking to Sheogorath to receive my rewards of office.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE07A_STAGE45_LOG0: After informing Sheogorath of my victory, Thadon, the Duke of Mania became furious. Before he departed the Sacellum, he threatened that we hadn't heard the last of him. I should speak with Sheogorath about the next step in his plan.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS02_STAGE75_LOG0: After questioning Velwyn, I've learned that his grandfather dabbled in necromancy and was killed when the townspeople of Anvil found out. Strangely, the body was never recovered. Since then, the house has been cursed. I need to convince Velwyn to come back with me to Anvil and lift the curse.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_DLCFrostcragSpire_STAGE40_LOG0: After reading the dusty tome, I've learned that I can purchase everything I need to restore this place to its former glory from Aurelinwae at the Mystic Emporium in the Market District of the Imperial City.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_DLCDeepscorn_STAGE40_LOG0: After reading the journal, I've learned that I can acquire everything I need to restore this place to its original state from Rowley Eardwulf at the Wawnet Inn just outside the Imperial City.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_ND04_STAGE120_LOG0: After recovering the Mace of the Crusader, I found the minions of Umaril attacking the Chapel of Zenithar. They were all defeated and the Leyawiin's Chapel escaped desecration.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS23_STAGE50_LOG0: After searching Roland's home, I've found a letter written to Roland from his girlfriend. It mentions a cabin where the two would meet. It's located east of the Imperial City in the Great Forest. I think this may be where Roland could be hiding. I should head out there immediately before he has a chance to escape.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS12_STAGE100_LOG0: After seeing the orders, the Akaviri Commander vanished. The ruins are now silent and at peace. After so many years, the Akaviri's final mission has been completed.  I should proceed ahead and search for the Madstone.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS29_STAGE70_LOG0: After showing the macabre manifest to Thoronir, he agreed to stop meeting Agarmir. He also told me that Agarmir said he had "something important" to do this very day. I think I need to check out the local graveyard, as the last name on the list was here in the Imperial City. I should return with one more piece of evidence of Agarmir's crime to confirm the manifest's contents.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS04_STAGE35_LOG0: After speaking to Gogan, I've learned that there are at least two gang members, an Imperial and a Nord. They lure men to a remote location, trick them into removing their clothes and equipment, and then ambush them while they are defenseless. I think at this point I have enough information to pay a visit to The Flowing Bowl.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE07A_STAGE40_LOG0: After touching the Altar of Arden-Sul, there was a brief flash of light. Arctus, the High Priest of Dementia, has now proclaimed me Duchess of Dementia.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE07A_STAGE40_LOG1: After touching the Altar of Arden-Sul, there was a brief flash of light. Arctus, the High Priest of Dementia, has now proclaimed me Duke of Dementia.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE07B_STAGE50_LOG0: After touching the Altar of Arden-Sul, there was a brief flash of light. Dervenin, the High Priest of Mania, has now proclaimed me Duchess of Mania. I should speak with Sheogorath about the next step in his plan.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE07B_STAGE50_LOG1: After touching the Altar of Arden-Sul, there was a brief flash of light. Dervenin, the High Priest of Mania, has now proclaimed me Duke of Mania.  I should speak with Sheogorath about the next step in his plan.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS02_STAGE100_LOG0: After touching the altar, I heard the voice of Lorgren Benirus. He said he wished to atone for his past and make peace with the Nines. All he wished was to be whole again. This must be the way to lift the curse from Benirus Manor. I should touch his skeleton while I carry the bony hand and put an end to this madness.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS14_STAGE40_LOG0: After touching the painting Rythe had been working on, I suddenly found myself standing in a strange forest. It looks familiar, like the Great Forest in the heart of Cyrodiil, but something is different about it.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS29_STAGE90_LOG0: Agarmir has been slain. Since the penalty for grave robbing is death, it somehow seems as though justice has been done. I should search the gravesite for anything potentially incriminating.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MG07Leyawiin_STAGE35_LOG0: Agata has asked that I attempt to question Dagail about her father, to find out what his connection to the amulet may be.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS52_STAGE115_LOG0: Agronak gro-Malog has been killed, and my quest to discover his true identity can never be completed.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS52_STAGE10_LOG0: Agronak gro-Malog, the Imperial Arena Grand Champion, has sent me on a quest to find proof of his noble birthright. I must journey now to the west, to a place called Crowhaven, and begin my search. Gro-Malog has provided me with a key I will surely need, but even he is unsure what it opens.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TG04Mistake_STAGE15_LOG0: Ahdarji is offering 100 gold coins for her ring. The ring was stolen by Amusei. I wonder if that is the same Argonian that I competed against to get into the guild? I'll have to look around for him.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TG04Mistake_STAGE70_LOG0: Ahdarji was very grateful and rewarded me nicely for the ring. I get the feeling she hates Argonians though. No wonder Amusei had trouble with her. Now all I have to do is report back to S'krivva in Bravil.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE44_STAGE10_LOG0: Ahjazda believes the world is ending soon, so she's gathering supplies. She would like me to find three items she's still missing: the Amulet of Disintegration, the Ring of Desiccation, and the Calming Pants.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE44_STAGE200_LOG0: Ahjazda has rewarded me for bringing her all the items she requested.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE44_STAGE201_LOG0: Ahjazda is dead and will no longer need the items she requested I find.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_FGD07Kidnap_STAGE105_LOG0: Ajum-Kajin has died. I will be unable to learn any more from him. Oreyn is unhappy I took the interrogation too far.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_FGD07Kidnap_STAGE70_LOG0: Ajum-Kajin seems unwilling to answer me as to the source of the Blackwood Company's power. I will have to persuade him further.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_FGD07Kidnap_STAGE30_LOG0: Ajum-Kajin will now return with me to Modryn Oreyn's house.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TrainingMarksman_STAGE20_LOG0: Alawen has agreed to teach me, but only if I acquire a normal Elven bow and bring it to her.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TrainingMarksman_STAGE200_LOG0: Alawen is dead. I have no hope of being taught more about Marksman skills now.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS10_STAGE50_LOG0: Aldos Othran has been slain by a Cheydinhal guard. He had led me to his old house, where he exchanged heated words with the guards. During the argument, Aldos pulled a knife and the guard put him down. I should tell Llevana the sad news.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS08_STAGE20_LOG0: Aleron owed a great deal of money to an Orc usurer named Kurdan gro-Dragol. He went there a day ago to beg for more time, and hasn't returned since. Kurdan gro-Dragol usually frequents The Lonely Suitor Lodge, which is close by. Perhaps I should pay him a visit.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TrainingBlade_STAGE20_LOG0: Alix Lencolia has refused to train me, saying that he's never heard of me. I'll need to make a name for myself, one way or the other, before he'll offer his services.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TrainingBlade_STAGE100_LOG0: Alix Lencolia has said he's heard of me, and so has offered to train me in the use of Blades.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TrainingBlade_STAGE200_LOG0: Alix Lencolia is no more. I can be taught nothing more about my skill with Blades now.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE46_STAGE70_LOG0: All of the Demented residents of Split are dead. I should return to Horkvir Bear-Arm for my reward.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE46_STAGE70_LOG1: All of the Manic residents of Split are dead. I should return to Horkvir Bear-Arm for my reward.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MQ09_STAGE53_LOG0: All of the cursed Blades of Sancre Tor have been destroyed. Their freed spirits have gone to the Shrine of Tiber Septim to try to dispel the enchantment laid upon it by the Underking long ago. I should go to the Shrine at once to see if they succeed in their final quest.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_Dark08Whodunit_STAGE30_LOG0: All of the guests are dead, and no one knew I was the killer. I must now return to the Sanctuary and speak with Ocheeva to receive my reward and bonus.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_Dark08Whodunit_STAGE40_LOG0: All of the guests have been killed, but someone discovered I was the assassin. I must now return to the Sanctuary and speak with Ocheeva to finish out the contract. Unfortunately, I will receive no bonus.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_DANamira_STAGE40_LOG0: All of the priests of Arkay are dead. I should return to the shrine.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_FGC01Rats_STAGE200_LOG0: All of the rats in Arvena Thelas' basement are dead. I've failed my contract.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MQ01_STAGE140_LOG0:
All of your possessions have been <RT_BlueMed>confiscated</> by the guards.
You will get them back when you have served your sentence.
Go to sleep to <RT_BlueMed>begin serving your sentence</>.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MQ01_STAGE140_LOG1: All of your possessions have been <RT_BlueMed>confiscated</>, you will get them back when you will be released.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE32_STAGE70_LOG0: Althel the archer on the parapet has no arrows. She won't accept normal arrows. I'll have to find her arrows somewhere. She is perfectly positioned to fire into the Fanatic raiders.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE32_STAGE95_LOG0: Althel was grateful for the arrows. She is sure to bring down some of the invaders with them.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_DLCHorseArmor_STAGE41_LOG0: Although I had no horse, Snak gra-Bura outfitted her old nag with steel armor and gave it to me free of charge. From now on, she will outfit any legally owned horse that I bring to her with Steel or Elven armor for 500 gold.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_DAMolagBal_STAGE50_LOG0: Although I tried to goad Petilius into fighting me, he would not. Perhaps I will have to try when he is in a different state of mind.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS10_STAGE180_LOG0: Although my actions removed Ulrich from his position as Captain of the Guard, Garrus didn't approve of my method.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS43_STAGE30_LOG0: Alves Uvenim identified the cursed staff as the Staff of the Everscamp. The only way to rid one's self of the staff is if someone else willingly accepts it. Finally, she pointed out that the only way to fully break the curse would be to return it to where it came from; Darkfathom Cave. I should take this information back to Rosentia immediately.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE40_STAGE10_LOG0: Amiable Fanriene has asked me to find him some place to sleep outside. I should find someone who sleeps outside and ask for their help in finding a good place to sleep outside.

ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TG11Heist_STAGE10_LOG0: Amusei has given me another message from the Gray Fox. I am to meet him at Othrelo's house in the Elven Gardens district in the Imperial City.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TG04Mistake_STAGE20_LOG0: Amusei is in jail here in Leyawiin. The only way I'm going to find that ring is to talk to him there.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TG04Mistake_STAGE30_LOG0: Amusei knows where the ring is, but he won't tell me unless I get him a lockpick.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TG09Arrow_STAGE10_LOG0: Amusei sought me out and delivered a message from the Gray Fox. I am to meet him at the home of Malintus Ancrus in Chorrol. He has another task for me. It seems Amusei has finally straightened up and joined the Thieves Guild. He is even trusted enough to deliver messages for the Gray Fox.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TG04Mistake_STAGE40_LOG0: Amusei told me that the ring was inscribed on the inside with the name Alessia Caro, a.k.a. the Countess of Leyawiin. Apparently he tried to sell it back to her. When he went to deliver the ring, he was arrested and thrown into jail. She kept the ring. It must be somewhere in the castle, assuming she isn't wearing it. I'll need to find someone who can tell exactly where. This might be a good time to revisit Ahdarji, or to see what the beggars know.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TG06Atonement_STAGE52_LOG0: Amusei was grateful for being saved from the Pale Lady and told me where to find the book. It is under a bush, behind Nerastarel's house, near a well.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE13_STAGE10_LOG1: An Obelisk has activated in the Palace courtyard! It seems that Order is launching its final attempt to take control of the Shivering Isles. I need to defeat Jyggalag and his minions once and for all.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS91_STAGE5_LOG0: An Orc in the Leyawiin Castle County Hall claims to be a knight. Marius Caro, Count Leyawiin, asked me to find out why she is there, and to report back to him.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS91_STAGE20_LOG0: An orc named Mazoga sent me to find Weebam-Na and tell him to meet Mazoga in the County Hall of Castle Leyawiin.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS47_STAGE35_LOG0: Ancotar gave me a ring and suggested I wear it while casting the Reverse Invisibility scroll, to protect me from any side effects. He didn't mention what those side effects might be.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS47_STAGE42_LOG0: Ancotar gave me another Reverse Invisibility scroll. He said it was his last one. I need to make sure to stand in the middle of Aleswell when I use it this time.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS47_STAGE70_LOG0: Ancotar is dead, and I have no way of reversing the invisibility he cast on the inhabitants of Aleswell.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS47_STAGE46_LOG0: Ancotar refused to give me a third Reverse Invisibility scroll after I wasted the first two. I should return to Aleswell and tell Diram Serethi the bad news.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TrainingBlock_STAGE100_LOG0: Andragil has agreed to help me train.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TrainingBlock_STAGE200_LOG0: Andragil is dead. I can be taught no more to improve my Block skill.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE08_STAGE5_LOG0: Angry over Syl's replacement as the Duchess of Dementia, Thadon has betrayed Sheogorath and joined with the forces of Order. According to Thadon, Order has already taken the Fringe. I should travel to the Fringe and investigate his claims.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE08_STAGE5_LOG1: Angry over Thadon's replacement as the Duke of Mania, Syl has betrayed Sheogorath and joined with the forces of Order. According to Syl, Order has already taken the Fringe. I should travel to the Fringe and investigate her claims.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE13_STAGE60_LOG2: Another Obelisk has activated. I should shut it down to weaken Jyggalag.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE13_STAGE50_LOG2: Another Obelisk has activated. I should shut it down to weaken Jyggylag.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE13_STAGE60_LOG1: Another Obelisk has activated. Jyggalag appeared to grow stronger when it activated. Perhaps shutting down the Obelisks will weaken him.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE13_STAGE50_LOG1: Another Obelisk has activated. Jyggylag appeared to grow stronger when it activated. Perhaps shutting down the Obelisks will weaken him.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE05_STAGE50_LOG0: Anya Herrick has named Ma'zaddha as being involved in some sort of plot against Lady Syl. I should find and speak to him.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE05_STAGE45_LOG0: Anya Herrick refuses to speak with me. I need Herdir with me to help convince her to talk.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TG04Mistake_STAGE45_LOG0: Apparently Ahdarji can use the ring to read missives and other castle documents written by the Count. She sells the information to other Counts of Cyrodiil. Now that the cat is out of the bag, so to speak, she has upped the reward to 200 gold coins.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS26_STAGE10_LOG0: Apparently there is a corrupt Imperial Watchman in the city. Luronk gro-Glurzog in the Temple district was complaining about him. Luronk ran afoul of him at Jensine's Merchandise in the market district. Luronk didn't have a name, but maybe Jensine does.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS26_STAGE11_LOG0: Apparently there is a corrupt Imperial Watchman in the city. Ruslan in the Temple district was complaining about him. Ruslan ran afoul of him at Jensine's Merchandise in the market district. Ruslan didn't have a name, but maybe Jensine does.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MG12Gate_STAGE100_LOG0: Arch-Mage Traven has been informed of Mucianus Alias' fate.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_ND06_STAGE20_LOG0: Areldur, a priest of Stendarr, has told me that the Gauntlets of the Crusader cannot be moved. I should speak with Kellen, a descendant of Sir Casimir, to learn more.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MG04Restore_STAGE35_LOG0: Arielle Jurard has instructed me to sleep at the Brina Cross Inn, then travel along the Gold Road towards Kvatch.

ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TG01BestThief_STAGE75_LOG0: Armand is giving Amusei and I one more chance we have to steal Rohssan's sword from somewhere in the Imperial City and bring it back to him. The first one of us to do that will also be admitted into the Thieves Guild.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TG04Mistake_STAGE5_LOG0: Armand is no longer my primary Thieves Guild contact. My new contact is S'krivva, in the city of Bravil. I can find her either at home or at the Lonely Suitor Lodge. I should ask her if there are any commission jobs for me.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TG02taxes_STAGE10_LOG0: Armand of the Thieves Guild has asked me to recover the tax records and taxes collected by the Imperial Watch. They are being held by an over-zealous Captain named Hieronymus Lex in the South Watchtower.

ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TG03Elven_STAGE80_LOG0: Armand thanked me for my help in exposing Myvryna Arano as the informant. He promoted me to Bandit in the Thieves Guild.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TGStolenGoods_STAGE30_LOG0: Armand told me that he won't have another commission job for me until I sell more stolen property to Ongar the fence. I'll need about 100 gold worth of stolen goods before he will trust me sufficiently.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TGStolenGoods_STAGE20_LOG0: Armand told me that he won't have any commission jobs for me until I sell more stolen property to Ongar the fence. I'll need about 50 gold worth of stolen goods before he will trust me sufficiently.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS09_STAGE20_LOG0: Arnora told me about a particular crime that she was forced to help her lover, Jorundr, commit. They stole some gold and buried it, but Jorundr was arrested. When she returned to the hiding place, the gold was gone. Jorundr must have moved it. Now she wants to recover the money. I should go to Bruma Castle Dungeons and speak to him.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS09_STAGE180_LOG0: Arnora's death occurred before I struck a bargain with Jorundr and if he would have rewarded me before, he certainly won't now.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_Dark18Mother_STAGE60_LOG0: Arquen and I have been teleported to the Cheydinhal Sanctuary. I should speak now with Arquen, who will serve as my servant and guide in the days to come.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_Dark18Mother_STAGE20_LOG0: Arquen has informed me that she will recite an incantation that will allow the Black Hand an audience with the Night Mother. Arquen also realizes this is all very new to me, and told me I'd be fine as long as I just followed along.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_FGC01Rats_STAGE20_LOG0: Arvena Thelas has rats in her basement, but they're not the problem. She loves the rats, but she's been finding them dead. She would like me to go down and investigate what's been happening.

ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_FGD04Defector_STAGE40_LOG0: Aryarie at the Mage's Guild has told me she is glad someone from the Fighters Guild is going to fulfill her contract. She would like me to find 10 portions of imp gall, and suggests Robber's Glen Cave might be a good spot to hunt for it.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_FGD04Defector_STAGE60_LOG0: Aryarie was pleased with the Imp Gall I brought her. As an extra reward, she's given me a Ring of Aegis. I should return to Oreyn.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_ArenaDialogue_STAGE100_LOG0: As Arena Grand Champion, I can fight in weekly matches against various creatures. All I need do is see Ysabel Andronicus in the Arena Bloodworks and tell her I'm ready for a match.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE11_STAGE190_LOG0: As Dyus requested, I've taken a branch of the Tree of Shades. I should now seek out Ciirta in the Howling Halls.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS14_STAGE100_LOG0: As a reward for getting him home safely with the Brush of Truepaint, Rythe presented me with a fitting reward; his Apron of Adroitness.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_DarkVamp_STAGE10_LOG0: As a reward for my loyal service to the Dark Brotherhood, Vicente Valtieri is willing to turn me into a vampire. If this is my wish, I should speak to Valtieri about the Dark Gift.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS91_STAGE80_LOG0: At Fisherman's Rock, Mazoga got into a fight with four bandits. Now all four bandits are dead. Now I must report to Marius Caro.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS48_STAGE20_LOG2: At least one survivor of the assault on the Oblivion Gate has been taken to the large tower within Oblivion. I need to search for him there.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE46_STAGE50_LOG0: Atrabhi living on the Dementia side of Split is dead.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE46_STAGE50_LOG1: Atrabhi living on the Mania side of Split is dead.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS26_STAGE120_LOG0: Audens Avidius attacked me. He was that crooked guard in the Imperial City that had threatened Luronk and Ruslan. He must have escaped from prison. Sadly, I was forced to kill him. He kept raving about how he would get me for putting him in jail.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS26_STAGE91_LOG0: Audens Avidius has been arrested. That should make Jensine, Ruslan, and Luronk happy. Hopefully it will serve as a lesson for any other guard that is thinking about shaking down innocent citizens.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS26_STAGE119_LOG0: Audens Avidius is dead. He was that crooked guard in the Imperial City that had threatened Luronk and Ruslan. He must have escaped from prison. He kept raving about how he would get me for putting him in jail.

ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_FGC02Protect_STAGE10_LOG0: Azzan has told me about a contract in Anvil, at Norbert Lelles store, Lelles' Quality Merchandise.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_FGC01Rats_STAGE10_LOG0: Azzan has told me of a contract in Anvil with Arvena Thelas. I should speak to her about a problem with rats in her basement.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_FGC05Stone_STAGE10_LOG0: Azzan has told me to report to the Chapel of Talos in Bruma and speak with the priest Cirroc about a contract.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_FGC04Scholar_STAGE100_LOG0: Azzan was pleased with my efforts escorting Elante of Alinor. He has paid out the contract to me.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_FGC03Thieves_STAGE100_LOG0: Azzan was pleased with our efforts, and has paid the contract.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_FGC04Scholar_STAGE110_LOG0: Azzan was unhappy that I allowed harm to come to Elante of Alinor.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_DAClavicusVile_STAGE30_LOG0: Barbas, the Hound of Clavicus Vile, has spoken to me through the figurine that appeared in my pack. He tells me that returning the Umbra Sword to Clavicus Vile is a mistake, likely to cause great ruin to Vile's domain.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS46_STAGE50_LOG0: Barthel Gernand thanked me profusely for ending the goblin threat to Cropsford. He promised me a hero's welcome in Cropsford once they have had a chance to establish the settlement.

ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MQ05_STAGE34_LOG0: Baurus wants me to search the dead agent's body.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MQ02_STAGE20_LOG0: Baurus, one of the Emperor's bodyguards, told me that Jauffre was the head of the Blades, an order of knights sworn to protect the Emperors.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TG01BloodPrice_STAGE11_LOG0: Because Amantius Allectus died during my theft, I must pay Armand the blood price of 500 gold coins. Otherwise I will be denied membership. Unfortunately, he will only talk to me after midnight in the Garden of Dareloth.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE45_STAGE5_LOG0: Because Bolwing is dead, I have no way to get more information about the Fork of Horripilation. Maybe I'll get lucky and find it during my travels in the Shivering Isles. Sadly, that is the best the I can hope for now.
