ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_FGC10Swamp_STAGE10_LOG0: Burz gro-Khash has given me a contract to go to Harlun's Watch, near Cheydinhal, and investigate the disappearances of some of the local populace. I should speak to Drarana Thelis.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_FGC09Ogres_STAGE10_LOG0: Burz gro-Khash has given me a contract to help Lord Rugdumph gro-Shurgak find his daughter, Lady Rogbut gra-Shurgak. I can find Lord Rugdumph at his estate near Lake Arrius.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_FGC07Heirloom_STAGE10_LOG0: Burz gro-Khash has given me a contract to retrieve an heirloom for Biene Amelion, who lives in Water's Edge, a small settlement near Leyawiin. I should report to her for further details.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_FGC10Swamp_STAGE100_LOG1: Burz gro-Khash has paid me the balance of the contract. He tells me that he has no further contracts to offer, but I should speak with Azzan in Sutch, if I have not already.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_FGC10Swamp_STAGE100_LOG0: Burz gro-Khash has paid me the balance of the contract. He tells me that he has no further contracts to offer.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_FGC08Prison_STAGE100_LOG0: Burz gro-Khash was impressed with my efforts in tracking down and killing the fugitives. He has paid me the balance of the contract.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_FGC09Ogres_STAGE100_LOG0: Burz gro-Khash was pleased with my efforts in retrieving Lady Rogbut gra-Shurgak, and he paid me what was owed on the contract.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_FGC06Courier_STAGE100_LOG0: Burz gro-Khash was pleased with my efforts, and has paid me for completing the contract.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_DAMephala_STAGE115_LOG0: By killing everyone in Bleaker's Way, I've spoiled Mephala's scheme, and spoiled any chance of gaining her favor.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE03A_STAGE50_LOG0: By making Grommok think that he actually died and became a ghost, I've driven him insane. Now that all of the adventurers have been dealt with, I should speak to Kiliban.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MQ10_STAGE35_LOG0: Captain Burd and I have entered the Oblivion Gate. I need to accompany him to the sigil stone and show him how to close the Gate.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MQ10_STAGE31_LOG0: Captain Burd and his men are heading into the Oblivion Gate with me. I need to accompany Burd to the Sigil Stone chamber of the Oblivion Gate and show him how to close it.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MQ10_STAGE30_LOG0: Captain Burd and his men are ready to help me close the Oblivion Gate. I just need to let Burd know when I'm ready.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MQ10_STAGE55_LOG0: Captain Burd thanked me for my help, and said that he and his guardsmen will do their best to close any new Oblivion Gates that open near Bruma. I should report my success to Jauffre.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MQ07_STAGE50_LOG0: Captain Burd told me that no strangers were in town, although he said that Jearl had recently returned from a trip. I should search Jearl's house for anything that might reveal more about the activities of Mythic Dawn agents in Bruma.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MQ07_STAGE50_LOG1: Captain Burd told me that no strangers were in town, although he said that Jearl had recently returned from a trip. I should talk to Jearl.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MG16Amulet_STAGE30_LOG0: Caranya was a traitor to the Mages Guild, and intended to deliver the Amulet to the King of Worms. I need to get out of Fort Ontus and take the Amulet back to the Arcane University.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS11_STAGE170_LOG0: Carius mentioned that Raynil has slipped through their grasp and made good his escape from the area. They will keep watch for him, but they doubt he will return. I'm afraid I'll never see him again.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS11_STAGE90_LOG0: Carius told me that Raynil was seen leaving Bruma and heading west. According to the journal, the cave where the artifact is stashed is in that direction. Carius mentioned that the only cave in that direction that matches the journal's description is Boreal Stone Cave. Carius also feels I have only a day before Raynil can make good his escape, so I must get there quickly.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MQ01_STAGE34_LOG1_1: Cast it by pressing <IA id="IA_Game_Combat_Cast"/>. Clairvoyance can guide you towards the next step of your journey.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS49_STAGE100_LOG0: Castle Kvatch is now safely under Savlian Matius' control.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_Dark10SpecialWizard_STAGE30_LOG0: Celedaen is dead. I must pick up my reward and next contract at the dead drop located in an old sack hidden in the bushes beneath the Great Oak, in the city of Chorrol.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_DLC06ThievesDen_STAGE10_LOG0: Centuries ago, a great battle took place in Anvil Bay. In the battle, the legendary pirate Torradan ap Dugal, the captain of the infamous Black Flag, was defeated by the first Count of Anvil. Rumors have been circulating of a hidden underground cavern beneath Castle Anvil. If the rumors are to be believed, then the final resting place of Captain Dugal and his ship have been uncovered. I should investigate these rumors as soon as possible.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MQDragonArmor_STAGE10_LOG0: Chancellor Ocato has ordered a suit of Imperial Dragon armor forged for me in gratitude for the services I rendered to the Empire during the Oblivion Crisis. It will be waiting for me at the armory in the Imperial Legion Compound in two weeks.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS51_STAGE60_LOG2: Chanel seems to have painting supplies concealed in a lectern in her room. The fact they're concealed seems suspicious. I now have enough clues to make an accusation.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS51_STAGE40_LOG2: Chanel seems to have painting supplies concealed in a lectern in her room. The fact they're concealed seems suspicious. I think I should continue searching for more clues.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS51_STAGE50_LOG2: Chanel seems to have painting supplies concealed in a lectern in her room. The fact they're concealed seems suspicious. I think I should continue searching for more clues.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS51_STAGE210_LOG0: Chanel was pleased that I didn't turn her in to the Countess. She told me that as a reward, she'd paint a portrait for me, but it'll take three weeks. I should return to Castle Chorrol at that time.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MQ01_STAGE15_LOG1: Check Captain Renault's body to find a <RT_BlueMed>weapon</>. To open a container or loot a body, press <IA id="IA_Game_Actions_Activate"/>.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE11_STAGE140_LOG1: Ciirta is dead. Taking her eye should be a simple matter now.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE39_STAGE65_LOG0: Cindanwe of Fellmoor is dead. I should check her corpse to see if she had anything interesting on her when she died.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE39_STAGE65_LOG1: Cindanwe of Fellmoor is dead. I should speak with Ranarr-Jo to tell him the mission is accomplished.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS22_STAGE35_LOG0: Claude Maric says that Umbacano has also hired him to retrieve the carving from the High Fane, which Maric identified as Malada in the Valus Mountains. Maric warned me that Malada is very dangerous, and advised that I read "The Cleansing of the Fane" before I go.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS22_STAGE33_LOG0: Claude Maric seems to know where the High Fane is located. Perhaps I can persuade him to tell me what he knows.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_DAClavicusVile_STAGE100_LOG0: Clavicus Vile appreciated my efforts. He has taken the Umbra Sword and rewarded me with the Masque of Clavicus Vile.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_DAClavicusVile_STAGE105_LOG0: Clavicus Vile was not pleased that I elected not to return to him the Umbra Sword.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MQ01_STAGE26_LOG2: Click on an item to equip it. Click again to unequip it. Shift-click to drop an item.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MQ01_STAGE94_LOG2: Click on the compass at the bottom of the journal to bring up the quest and map tab.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MQ01_STAGE36_LOG2: Click on the spell icon at the bottom of the journal to bring up the magic tab.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MQ01_STAGE150_LOG0:
Combine ingredients with <RT_BlueMed>similar effects</> to create potions and poisons.
Your <RT_BlueMed>Alchemy skill</> will make your <RT_BlueMed>creations more powerful</>.
The more potions you create, the higher your Alchemy skill will increase.
<RT_BlueMed>Use additional apparatuses to improve the strength of the potions you create.</>
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS02_STAGE110_LOG0: Completing the skeleton was a ruse and Lorgren rose from the dead! I had no choice but to destroy him. With his destruction, the curse of Benirus Manor was lifted. I should return to The Count's Arms and speak to Velwyn.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SQ03_STAGE100_LOG0: Corrick Northwode was overjoyed to get back his wife's Jade Amulet. He thanked me by rewarding me with gold he had recovered from Exhausted Mine long ago.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE32_STAGE150_LOG0: Count Cirion has given me his helm. With it, I can take his place and do battle with Devoted Fanatic. Only then will the curse be lifted.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MG13Information_STAGE20_LOG0: Count Hassildor has information that he will provide only if I remove the Vampire Hunters lurking around Skingrad, as well as a nest of vampires in Bloodcrust Cavern outside of town.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS40_STAGE20_LOG0: Count Hassildor of Skingrad has asked me to find the cure for vampirism. I should look for a woman in the wilderness along the Corbolo River, east of the Imperial City and south of Cheydinhal.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MG09Motives_STAGE40_LOG0: Count Hassildor saved me from the ambush set by Mercator Hosidius. I need to deliver his message to Raminus Polus.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS40_STAGE100_LOG0: Count Hassildor thanked me for finding a cure for his wife.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MG13Information_STAGE10_LOG0: Count Hassildor wishes to see me; I should travel to Skingrad immediately and speak with Hal-Liurz.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MG13Information_STAGE60_LOG0: Count Hassildor's news about Mannimarco must be delivered to Hannibal Traven right away.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS13_STAGE10_LOG0: Count Indarys of Cheydinhal has mentioned the opening of what they suspect to be a gate to the realm of Oblivion just outside the city walls. The guards seem on alert and tensions appear to be running high. He said if I wanted to help, I should make my way through the west gates of Cheydinhal and speak to the guards there.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS92_STAGE10_LOG0: Count Marius Caro of Leyawiin has offered to make Mazoga and myself Knights-Errant of the White Stallion if we find and kill the Orc named Black Brugo, chieftain of the Black Bow Bandits.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS91_STAGE100_LOG0: Count Marius Caro thanked me for my services to County Leyawiin, and suggested that he might make Mazoga and I knights-errant as reward for our noble deeds.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS12_STAGE20_LOG0: Countess Carvain has told me that her scouts have already located the first landmark mentioned in the diary, Dragonclaw Rock. It's been marked on my map, so I should begin the journey from there.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS12_STAGE10_LOG0: Countess Narina Carvain has told me that she's seeking a particular relic of Akaviri origin: The Draconian Madstone, an amulet that supposedly grants the wearer immunity to poison. It's recently come to her attention that it may be located in the ruins at Pale Pass. She's offering a substantial reward for the talisman's return. I should speak to her for more information.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TG07Lex_STAGE80_LOG0: Countess Umbranox has given me her response. Now I need to deliver it to Hieronymus Lex. The look on his face should be priceless.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS51_STAGE18_LOG0: Countess Valga has told me that the only people who were unaccounted for and had access to her bedchamber were the resident mage, Chanel, and the castle porter, Orgnolf. She suggested I question them and some of the other castle residents: the Captain of the Guard, Bittneld, her herald, Laythe Wavrick, and her Steward, Orok gro-Ghoth.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS51_STAGE10_LOG0: Countess Valga of Castle Chorrol has tasked me with the recovery of a portrait that was stolen from her throne room. It's very dear to her as it reminds her of her husband who was lost years ago. She mentioned clues, perhaps I should find out more.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE30_STAGE125_LOG0: Cutter told me Madness Ore can be found in old ruins and is often carried by Grummites.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE30_STAGE130_LOG0: Cutter told me about magical weapon and armor "Matrices" she can use to create magical weapons and armor. If I find a matrix she'll be able to make a magical item.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE30_STAGE126_LOG0: Cutter will not make any Madness items for me until I am more experienced. [Must be level 8 or higher]
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_Charactergen_STAGE23_LOG2: DEBUG: Assassins finish package to reach floor marker.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_Charactergen_STAGE12_LOG1: DEBUG: Renote reaches marker A. Start conversation with Glenroy.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_Charactergen_STAGE18_LOG1: DEBUG: Stage 18: Renote to secret wall switch
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_Charactergen_STAGE19_LOG1: DEBUG: Stage 19: Secret wall is open
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_Charactergen_STAGE20_LOG1: DEBUG: Stage 20: Renote arrives at marker C
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_Charactergen_STAGE22_LOG1: DEBUG: Stage 22: Trigger start of ambush
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_Charactergen_STAGE28_LOG1: DEBUG: Stage 28: Baurus waiting to warn player not to follow
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_Charactergen_STAGE29_LOG1: DEBUG: Stage 29: Baurus finished warning player, head out.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TrainingMysticism_STAGE100_LOG0: Dagail has agreed to train me in the school of Mysticism magic.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TrainingMysticism_STAGE200_LOG0: Dagail is dead. I have lost my opportunity to be taught more about Mysticism magic.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TrainingMysticism_STAGE20_LOG0: Dagail refuses to train me until I have done more to seal the barriers between Tamriel and Oblivion. I need to find more gates to Oblivion, and close them.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_DLC06ThievesDen_STAGE60_LOG0: Dahlia has helped me convince Jak Silver to join my crew. Jak Silver can get all manner of items that are difficult to find in Cyrodiil. All he asks is that I never question him about his sources. I can find Jak in the lower decks of the Black Flag.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_DLC06ThievesDen_STAGE30_LOG0: Dahlia has put me in contact with the famous black market fletcher Melliwin the Mongrel. Melliwin will be able to provide me with marksman supplies and training that I won't be able to find elsewhere. Melliwin has asked for a place to practice her craft. I will find her in the main cavern of Dunbarrow Cove, near the back wall.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TGDirections_STAGE20_LOG0: Dar Jee is the fence in Leyawiin. The beggar told me she lives east of the temple. I should go to her if I have any stolen property to sell.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS45_STAGE90_LOG0: Dar-Ma has perished.  I should at least inform Seed-Neeus of the bad news.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MG02Alter_STAGE100_LOG0: Deetsan has agreed to send a letter of recommendation to the Arcane University in Falcar's stead.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MG10Vahtacen_STAGE37_LOG0: Denel has offered to find translations of the inscriptions on the walls of Vahtacen. I should read all the inscriptions, and then tell him what they say.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE32_STAGE60_LOG0: Desideratus did not take it well when I told him what I did to his betrothed. However, he is now motivated to stay at his post and fight the invading Fanatics.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE32_STAGE25_LOG0: Desideratus took his "beloved" and ran off. Obviously that isn't going to work. Hopefully he just put the doll back where I found it. I should go check. There must be some other way to use that doll to get him to stay and fight.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS38_STAGE8_LOG0: Dion, Captain of the Skingrad guard, warned me to not get involved with Glarthir, saying that he was crazy and possibly dangerous.  He also asked me to contact him if Glarthir ever asked me to do anything strange.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS47_STAGE60_LOG1: Diram Serethi thanked me for helping him, and offered me free lodging in Aleswell whenever I'm in the area.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS47_STAGE60_LOG0: Diram Serethi was disappointed to learn that I had wasted the Reverse Invisibility scrolls that Ancotar had given me. He told me that I am not welcome in Aleswell.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_FGC10Swamp_STAGE50_LOG0: Drarana Thelis was saddened at the fates of the townsfolk, but has rewarded me for my efforts. I should report to Burz gro-Khash for payment of the contract.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE35_STAGE70_LOG0: Due to my influence in New Sheoth with the House of Dementia, Kithlan has agreed to have Brithaur thrown in the dungeon permanently for his crimes. I should tell Earil the good news.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE30_STAGE25_LOG0: Dumag gro-Bonk told me Amber can be found in root tunnel systems and on Gnarl.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE30_STAGE30_LOG0: Dumag gro-Bonk told me about magical weapon and armor "Matrices" he can use to create magical weapons and armor. If I find a matrix he'll be able to make a magical item.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE30_STAGE26_LOG0: Dumag gro-Bonk will not make any Amber items for me until I am more experienced. [Must be level 8 or higher]
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE10_STAGE100_LOG0: Dylora thanked me for helping the Dark Seducers secure their stronghold, and has given me the ability to summon her kind. She has also given me a set of matching armor.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MG05Fingers_STAGE15_LOG0: Earana has asked me to bring her a book titled 'Fingers of the Mountain' so that she may translate it. I need to tell Teekeeus about this immediately.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MG05A_STAGE10_LOG0: Earana has asked me to steal back the book "Fingers of the Mountain" and deliver it to her. I'll need to find where Teekeeus has placed it in the Chorrol Mages Guild.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MG05A_STAGE40_LOG0: Earana has given me a translation of a portion of the book I delivered to her. I need to read her notes, and then travel back to Cloud Top.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE35_STAGE20_LOG0: Earil has offered me a reward if I can 'get rid' of Brithaur. I'll need to find a way to get Brithaur to stop stealing from the shops in New Sheoth. Before I make any hasty decisions, perhaps I should speak with Brithaur.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE35_STAGE200_LOG0: Earil thanked me for taking care of Brithaur, and has given me a reward.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_FGC04Scholar_STAGE90_LOG0: Elante of Alinor has died. I should report this to Azzan.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_FGC04Scholar_STAGE30_LOG0: Elante of Alinor has reached the Daedric shrine, and is ready to leave Brittlerock Cave.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_FGC04Scholar_STAGE40_LOG0: Elante of Alinor wishes to remain in Brittlerock and continue studying the shrine. I should return to Azzan for my payment.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MQ15_STAGE70_LOG0: Eldamil removed the Bands of the Chosen. I should now be able to leave the Forbidden Grotto and continue on my way towards Mankar Camoran's palace at the top of the mountain.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MQ15_STAGE67_LOG0: Eldamil told me he would meet me further into the caves where he would be able to remove the Bands of the Chosen from my wrists. I should continue searching for a way through these caves to Mankar Camoran's palace.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS11_STAGE120_LOG0: Erline was pleased that I stopped Raynil. She told me that as an extra precaution, Bradon had a command word protection put on the amulet so no one could steal it and use it without his knowledge. Fortunately, Erline was given the command word. After giving it to her, she said the word, and the true nature of the item was revealed: The Phylacetary of Litheness. She then said I could keep the item, as a token of her thanks.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS45_STAGE21_LOG0: Etira Moslin says that Dar-Ma never arrived with the scheduled delivery.  She seemed to be hiding something, however, and I should investigate the town further.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS45_STAGE40_LOG1: Etira Moslin still denies that Dar-Ma ever came to Hackdirt, although it is obvious that Dar-Ma did ... and that she likely never left.  I will have to search the town thoroughly for more clues.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS45_STAGE40_LOG0: Etira Moslin still denies that Dar-Ma ever came to Hackdirt.  She is obviously lying, but I doubt she will tell me anything useful.  I should continue to search the town for clues.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_Dark11Kin_STAGE30_LOG0: Every member of the Draconis family has been killed.  I must pick up my reward and next contract at the dead drop located in the stone well in the Castle Skingrad Courtyard.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_Charactergen_STAGE0_LOG1: Everyone at their places at Marker J.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_Charactergen_STAGE0_LOG2: Everyone in their places at marker G, waiting for player. (stage 56)
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_Dark06Wanderer_STAGE30_LOG0: Faelian has been killed, but not in a secure location, so my reward will be reduced. I must now return to the Sanctuary and speak with Ocheeva to receive my reward.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_Dark06Wanderer_STAGE19_LOG0: Faelian is alone every day for several hours at Lorkmir's House, in the Elven Gardens District of the Imperial City. I could kill him there to avoid any witnesses.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_Dark06Wanderer_STAGE40_LOG0: Faelian is dead. I killed him in Lorkmir's House, a secure location with no witnesses. I must now return to the Sanctuary and speak with Ocheeva and receive my reward and bonus.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_Dark06Wanderer_STAGE16_LOG0: Faelian lives at the Tiber Septim Hotel, in the Talos Plaza District of the Imperial City. I should ask around for him there. I can feel myself getting closer. But I must remember, I will forfeit my bonus if Faelian is killed in an unsecure location. The hotel simply will not do.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_Dark06Wanderer_STAGE17_LOG0: Faelian lives at the Tiber Septim Hotel, in the Talos Plaza District of the Imperial City. I should ask the publican, Augustus Calidia, if she has any information. I can feel myself getting closer. But I must remember, I will forfeit my bonus if Faelian is killed in an unsecure location. The hotel simply will not do.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_Dark06Wanderer_STAGE18_LOG0: Faelian was once a wealthy nobleman, but has squandered his fortune away on skooma. Faelian spends most of his time wandering the city looking for the drug, leaving his sweetheart Atraena at the Tiber Septim Hotel. Maybe Atraena has some more information. What I know for certain is that Faelian is very close to death, but I must not kill him in the hotel if I wish to get my bonus.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MG17Ambush_STAGE30_LOG1: Falcar has fled back into the ruins of Silorn. I must find him.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS13_STAGE85_LOG0: Farwil has been slain. I should bring his signet ring to his father the Count, then report to Amminus Gregori.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS13_STAGE70_LOG0: Farwil has been slain. I should take his signet ring from his body to the Count of Cheydinhal as proof of his son's demise.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS13_STAGE150_LOG0: Farwil has died by my hands. Count Indarys will be extremely upset that this has transpired. I fear I may have ruined the good deed my quest represented.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS13_STAGE90_LOG0: Farwil thanked me in his odd way, and told me to go speak to his father, the Count of Cheydinhal. I should do so. Also, he's bestowed upon me the "honor" of being a Knight of the Thorn. To humor him, I courteously accepted.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS13_STAGE60_LOG0: Farwil told me that all of the Knights of the Thorn have been killed except himself and Bremman Senyan. They died trying to get inside the citadel to obtain the Sigil Stone. He's now ordered me to go into the Citadel and recover the Sigil Stone, and says he'll not leave this place until that task is done.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TGDirections_STAGE50_LOG0: Fathis Ules is the fence in the Imperial City. The beggar told me he lives behind the temple. I should go to him if I have any stolen property to sell.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MQ01_STAGE74_LOG0_2: Fatigue returns quickly on its own, but you can also restore it more quickly by drinking potions or sleeping.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS04_STAGE40_LOG0: Faustina Cartia approached me after I arrived at The Flowing Bowl. She said that I had what it took to join their gang, and if I was interested, to meet her in the farmhouse at a small settlement outside of Anvil called Gweden around 11 tonight. This was the break I was looking for, so I'll follow my map to that location.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_DASheogorath_STAGE20_LOG0: Ferul Ravel has told me I'll need a lesser soul gem, a head of lettuce, and some yarn as an offering at the statue of Sheogorath.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE40_STAGE35_LOG0: Fimmion gave me Uungor's lucky grapes. I should bring them to him.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TG07Lex_STAGE10_LOG1: First, I steal the letter from steward Dairihill's desk in Castle Anvil. Then get a forgery made. I have to find and pay for my own forger. Then seal it with the Imperial Watch seal from the legion commander's desk in the Imperial City. Dairihill cannot be trusted to deliver the letter. I must personally deliver the forged letter to Countess Umbranox of Anvil. I will be paid 500 gold, plus the cost of the forgery.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MG12Gate_STAGE30_LOG0: Fithragaer is the only survivor from the group of Battlemages sent to find Mucianus Alias. I need to help him reach the Necromancers within Nenyond Twyll.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MG12Gate_STAGE40_LOG0: Fithragaer, the only surviving Battlemage, is dead. I'll need to continue on my own into the ruins to find Mucianus Alias.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TrainingAcrobatics_STAGE10_LOG0: For further training in Acrobatics, I need to search the mountains in the northeast of Cyrodiil for Aerin's Camp.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TrainingSneak_STAGE10_LOG0: For more training in Sneaking, I need to find Marana Rian in the Imperial City.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS22_STAGE10_LOG9: Fortunately, I recognized the drawing as Malada, an Ayleid ruin in the Valus Mountains. I should return to Malada and look for the carved panel that Umbacano wants.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS22_STAGE10_LOG10: Fortunately, I remembered a book I had read about the High Fane, which identified it as Malada, an Ayleid ruin in the Valus Mountains. I should go to Malada and look for the carved panel that Umbacano wants.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_Dark05Assassinated_STAGE80_LOG0: Francois Motierre has been killed. I must now return to the Sanctuary and report my failure to Vicente Valtieri.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_DL9MehrunesQuest_STAGE80_LOG0: Frathen Drothan is dead, and with him dies any threat the Drothmeri Army may have posed to the Empire.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS10_STAGE30_LOG0: Garrus Darelliun let me know his dislike of his commanding officer and took it a step further by letting me know he thinks Ulrich is pocketing much of the money from the inflated fines. He said I should speak to Aldos, as Garrus needs a witness to bring Ulrich to justice.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS10_STAGE100_LOG0: Garrus has informed me that he was made Captain of the Guard of Cheydinhal to replace Ulrich, and has rewarded me for helping him.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS10_STAGE70_LOG0: Garrus was saddened by the news of Aldos's death. He vowed to bring Ulrich to justice by any means. He suggested the only way to incriminate the Captain would be by searching his quarters. He is suggesting that I sneak in there and look for such evidence. I'll have to decide if I want to do this Garrus's way or Llevana's way.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS10_STAGE95_LOG1: Garrus was upset that I would resort to such a method to have Ulrich removed from his position, but he was glad it was over. He said he would report this to the Count of Cheydinhal, and told me to meet him at the Cheydinhal Bridge Inn in two hours.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_Dark02Watery_STAGE30_LOG0: Gaston Tussaud is dead. I must now return to the Sanctuary and speak with Vicente Valtieri to receive my reward.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS06_STAGE40_LOG0: Gilgondorin said that the "mouth of the panther" is a reference to the old nautical term for the Panther River and the delta where it meets Niben Bay. The name was given to it by sailors because of the pointed rock formations jutting from the water that vaguely resemble teeth. He added its location to my map. I should make my way over there to unravel Grantham's cryptic message.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS06_STAGE18_LOG0: Gilgondorin told me that the Forlorn Watchman appears at Bawnwatch Camp every night at 8 on the shore of Niben Bay. He was very helpful, and even marked the camp's location on my map. Perhaps I should make my way out there and see what this local legend is all about.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TrainingArmorer_STAGE200_LOG0: Gin-Wulm is dead. I can receive no further training in my Armorer skill.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS38_STAGE10_LOG1: Glarthir believes that Bernadette Peneles is following him. I need to be outside his house at 6am and see what she does. He will then meet me behind the Great Chapel at midnight to get my report.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS38_STAGE10_LOG0: Glarthir claims that there is a conspiracy against him among the people of Skingrad.  He wouldn't say why, but implied that he knows secrets which powerful people want to keep quiet. I have agreed to help him determine whether he is being followed or watched, and he has promised to pay me 150 gold for my services.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS38_STAGE50_LOG4: Glarthir has given me a list of people he wants me to kill. Everyone on the list was someone I told him was spying on him. He told me to meet him behind the Great Chapel at midnight after they were all dead, and he would pay me 1000 septims.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS38_STAGE65_LOG0: Glarthir has gone on a rampage in Skingrad. It seems since I wouldn't help him, he decided to kill those whom he believed were conspiring against him.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS38_STAGE30_LOG3: Glarthir has one final person for me to investigate. He believes that Davide Surilie is spying on his house.  I should observe him for a day and then report back to Glarthir at midnight at our usual spot behind the Great Chapel.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS38_STAGE81_LOG0: Glarthir is dead. My attempts to convince him that there was no conspiracy against him have ended in tragedy.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS38_STAGE80_LOG0: Glarthir now believes that I am part of the conspiracy against him, and is trying to kill me! I have no choice but to defend myself.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS38_STAGE20_LOG2: Glarthir now wants me to observe the behavior of Toutius Sextius, another suspected member of the conspiracy against him. Glarthir said that if I waited outside Toutius Sextius's house this morning, I would see Toutius following him, and then could find out who Toutius was reporting to.  At midnight I am to meet Glarthir in our usual spot behind the Great Chapel and tell him what I learned.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS38_STAGE45_LOG0: Glarthir seems pleased with my efforts in investigating the people he believed were conspiring against him. He paid me well for my work.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS38_STAGE50_LOG3: Glarthir wants me to kill Bernadette Peneles, who I said was spying on him. He told me to meet him behind the Great Chapel at midnight after she was dead, and he would pay me 1000 septims.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS38_STAGE50_LOG1: Glarthir wants me to kill Davide Surilie, who I said was spying on him. He told me to meet him behind the Great Chapel at midnight after Davide was dead, and he would pay me 1000 septims.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS38_STAGE50_LOG2: Glarthir wants me to kill Toutius Sextius, who I said was spying on him. He told me to meet him behind the Great Chapel at midnight after Toutius was dead, and he would pay me 1000 septims.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS38_STAGE54_LOG2: Glarthir was overjoyed to learn that his enemies were dead, and paid me as promised.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS38_STAGE54_LOG1: Glarthir was overjoyed to learn that his enemy is dead, and paid me as promised.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MQ01_STAGE140_LOG2: Go to <RT_BlueMed>sleep</> to serve your sentence.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MQ01_STAGE22_LOG2: Go to your Inventory. From here, you can equip armor and weapons by hovering the item on the list and clicking on the equip button or by pressing <IA id="IA_UI_Generic_Accept"/>.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS31_STAGE60_LOG0: Graman said he wouldn't sail the ship while the Bloated Float's owner, Ormil, is still in danger. I need to rescue Ormil in the captain's cabin to get the ship underway.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS06_STAGE120_LOG0: Grantham's map has led me to a treasure chest concealed among some rocks. This must be where Grantham hid his belongings while he was at sea. He has passed this on to me now, as a reward for helping free his spirit.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS16A_STAGE10_LOG0: Guilbert and Reynald Jemane have asked for my help in reclaiming their ancestral home. I need to look for Weatherleah, somewhere to the south of Chorrol. Perhaps I could ask around town and see if anyone can help.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS16_STAGE100_LOG0: Guilbert thanked me again for all I did to reunite his family.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS16A_STAGE30_LOG0: Guilbert was glad that I'd found Weatherleah's location, but I'll need to kill the ogres so that it's safe to travel there.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS16A_STAGE50_LOG0: Guilbert was very happy to hear that I'd killed the band of ogres at Weatherleah, and is anxious to return. I should take he and his brother there as soon as I'm ready.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MQ05_STAGE62_LOG0: Gwinas has picked up his copy of Volume 3. I need to get that book from Gwinas.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MQ05_STAGE70_LOG0: Gwinas told me that Volume 4, the last book I need, can only be given to you by a member of the Mythic Dawn. He had set up a meeting with one, whom he called "The Sponsor". He was to go alone and sit at the table in the Sunken Sewer beneath the Imperial City. I will go and take that meeting instead, but should find Baurus first.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MG18KingofWorms_STAGE10_LOG0: Hannibal Traven has promoted me to Arch-Mage, and has tasked me with stopping the King of Worms. I need to take the Black Soul Gem to Echo Cave and confront him.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MG14Plot_STAGE10_LOG0: Hannibal Traven wants me to check in with Jeanne Frasoric at the Bruma Mages Guild. I should go there immediately.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MQ06_STAGE40_LOG0: Harrow, the Warden of the Shrine, accepted me as an initiate into the Mythic Dawn cult. I was required to give him all my possessions and dress in an initiate's robe. He said that the Master, Mankar Camoran himself, is here at the shrine, and might perform my initiation himself. I should follow Harrow and see if he leads me to Mankar Camoran and the Amulet of Kings.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_DASheogorath_STAGE65_LOG0: Haskill has congratulated me for simulating the first two signs of the K'Sharra Prophecy. I am to go to the center of town to await the final sign.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_DASheogorath_STAGE100_LOG0: Haskill has rewarded me for my efforts by giving me Wabbajack.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE01Door_STAGE40_LOG0: Haskill has told me that his Lord Sheogorath is searching for a mortal to become his champion. I should speak again with Haskill when I have made my decision.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_Dark15Coldest_STAGE20_LOG0: Havilstein Hoar-Blood is dead. I must now pick up my reward and next contract at the dead drop located in an old chest that is sunk into the pool at the Ayleid ruin of Nornal.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MQ01_STAGE72_LOG0_1: Health regenerates outside combat. You can restore it more quickly by drinking potions, casting healing spells or waiting.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TrainingHandtoHand_STAGE100_LOG0: Helvius Cecia has agreed to train me.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TrainingHandtoHand_STAGE200_LOG0: Helvius Cecia is dead. I have no chance to be taught more about Hand to Hand combat now.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS05_STAGE100_LOG0: Henantier has thanked me for saving him. As a reward, he's provided me with some of his magic scrolls.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE05_STAGE30_LOG0: Herdir has agreed to accompany me. I need to speak with people in Crucible for information about this supposed conspiracy. Perhaps starting with those close to Syl would be useful.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_DAHermaeusMora_STAGE100_LOG0: Hermaeus Mora was pleased with the souls I brought him. He has rewarded me with the Oghma Infinium.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_DAHermaeusMora_STAGE20_LOG0: Hermaeus Mora wishes for me to gather for him ten souls, one of each of the races.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS27_STAGE20_LOG1: Herminia Cinna gave me the key to the royal burial vault of Lindai, which she believes holds a similar Ayleid Crown. She suggested that Umbacano would not know the difference between the Crown of Lindai and the Crown of Nenalata, since he has never seen either one.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS27_STAGE20_LOG0: Herminia Cinna refused to sell me the Crown of Nenalata that Umbacano wants. She hinted that it can be used to access potent magical powers that would dangerous in the wrong hands.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_Dark05Assassinated_STAGE70_LOG0: Hides-His-Heart has been killed. I must now return to the Sanctuary and report my failure to Vicente Valtieri.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TG03Elven_STAGE75_LOG0: Hieronymus Lex found the bust I planted. Now all I have to do is report to Armand. Unfortunately I'll have to wait until the next midnight for him to return to the Garden of Dareloth.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TG07Lex_STAGE85_LOG0: Hieronymus Lex was shocked to learn he had been reassigned. Now the Thieves Guild will be safe from his persecution. All I have to do is get back to S'krivva to collect my reward.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_DAHircine_STAGE100_LOG0: Hircine was impressed with my skill in hunting the unicorn. He has rewarded me with the Savior's Hide.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_DAHircine_STAGE10_LOG0: Hircine's followers have told me that, in order to summon the Daedra, I must leave an offering of a wolf or bear pelt at the statue.  [You must be level 17 to begin this quest.]
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE36_STAGE15_LOG0: Hirrus Clutumnus asked me for a favor, I've turned him down.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE36_STAGE20_LOG0: Hirrus Clutumnus has asked that I kill him.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE36_STAGE30_LOG0: Hirrus Clutumnus is dead, just as he wanted. I can now get my reward from his house. The key should be on his corpse.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE36_STAGE210_LOG0: Hirrus Clutumnus is dead. I'll never find out what he wanted.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE36_STAGE10_LOG0: Hirrus Clutumnus told me to meet him after dark at the sewer grate northeast of the statue of Sheogorath sitting on his throne.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TG11Heist_STAGE150_LOG0: History has been rewritten. I should go see the new Thieves Guild Hall in the Imperial City Waterfront. The Gray Fox, or Count Corvus as he is now known, told me that I get to run the place.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE32_STAGE130_LOG0: Hloval Dreth was grateful for the help. He is able to attack the Fanatic raiders now.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MQ01_STAGE28_LOG1_1: Hold <IA id="IA_Game_Combat_Attack"/> to perform a <RT_BlueMed>stronger attack</>. To <RT_BlueMed>block</>, hold <IA id="IA_Game_Combat_Block"/>.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE46_STAGE20_LOG0: Horkvir Bear-Arm living on the Dementia side of Split is dead.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE46_STAGE20_LOG1: Horkvir Bear-Arm living on the Mania side of Split is dead.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MG00Join_STAGE22_LOG0: I  have spoken with Kud-Ei in Bravil. She has told me that in order to join the Mages Guild, I must not be a wanted criminal.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MQ15_STAGE56_LOG0: I accepted Eldamil's offer to help me escape the Forbidden Grottos. Eldamil wants me to pretend to be a prisoner until his Dremora overseer finishes his inspection. I wonder if I can trust him.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE06_STAGE70_LOG0: I agreed to help Ulfri defeat the Golden Saints. Her scouts report that the Saints have launched their attack. I should follow Ulfri and help her destroy the Golden Saints.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS91_STAGE50_LOG0: I agreed to lead Mazoga to Fisherman's Rock. Fisherman's Rock is north of Leyawiin, about six hours walk, on a point of land on the eastern shore of the Niben. At Fisherman's Rock, Mazoga wants to talk to someone named Mogens Wind-shifter. She made it clear I was not to interfere before she talked to him.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_DAMolagBal_STAGE105_LOG0: I allowed Petilius to kill me, but he did not use the Cursed Mace. I have failed in the task given to me by Molag Bal.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS51_STAGE75_LOG0: I am certain that Chanel is the culprit. After all, the evidence clearly points to her. But without a full confession, Countess Valga won't be satisfied. I need to convince Chanel to trust me enough to tell me why she did the crime.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_ArenaDialogue_STAGE20_LOG0: I am now a combatant in the Arena faction. To arrange for a match, I must speak with Owyn in the Arena Bloodworks, in the Imperial City. After every match, I must speak to Owyn again to close out the match and receive any rewards earned. While I'm involved in any active matches, I will be unable to bet on any fights.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_ArenaDialogue_STAGE40_LOG0: I am now an Arena Champion. There are no more standard matches left to fight. Instead, I must challenge the Grand Champion, Agronak gro-Malog, for his title.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_FGD05Oreyn_STAGE35_LOG0: I am to meet Oreyn at the Fighters Guild in Leyawiin. From there, we will travel to Arpenia to look for Azani Blackheart.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE09_STAGE80_LOG0: I am to meet Relmyna Verenim at the statue of Lord Sheogorath in the Fringe where we will perform the ceremony to build the Gatekeeper.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TG01BestThief_STAGE5_LOG0: I approached Armand Christophe about the Thieves Guild. Apparently this is not the right time or place to discuss it. He told me to meet him in the ruined Garden of Dareloth in the Waterfront distict of the Imperial City. I have to be there at midnight.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MQ03_STAGE20_LOG0: I arrived at Kvatch to find the city in ruins and the survivors camped outside the walls. I need to find out if anyone here knows what happened to Martin.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MQ13_STAGE39_LOG0: I arrived at the battlefield to find one open Oblivion Gate. Once all three are open, the Mythic Dawn will open a Great Gate, which I must enter and retrieve its Great Sigil Stone.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MQ04_STAGE50_LOG0: I brought Martin and Jauffre safely to Cloud Ruler Temple.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE38_STAGE25_LOG0: I brought Una Armina a Two-Headed Septim I found, and she was happy to add it to her museum. I should bring her any new Oddities that I find.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE38_STAGE30_LOG0: I brought Una Armina the Ring of Disrobing I found. She was pleased with it, and asked me to bring her any new Oddities I find.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_DEM02_STAGE100_LOG0: I can now summon Mehrunes' Harbinger at any time to obtain items imbued with Mehrunes Dagon’s power. I should speak to Snak Gra-Bura at the Chestnut Handy Stables about crafting a matching set of horse armor.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS47_STAGE40_LOG0: I cast the Reverse Invisibility spell Ancotar gave me, but I wasn't in Aleswell when I did it, so I need to ask Ancotar for another one.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MQ10_STAGE50_LOG1: I closed the Gate with Captain Burd. I should ask him if he needs any more help from me.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MQ11_STAGE40_LOG0: I closed the Oblivion Gate outside of Anvil. I should speak to the Countess about sending aid to Bruma now that Anvil is no longer directly threatened.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MQ11_STAGE43_LOG0: I closed the Oblivion Gate outside of Bravil. I should speak to the Count about sending aid to Bruma now that Bravil is no longer directly threatened.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MQ11_STAGE45_LOG0: I closed the Oblivion Gate outside of Cheydinhal. I should speak to the Count about sending aid to Bruma now that Cheydinhal is no longer directly threatened.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MQ11_STAGE42_LOG0: I closed the Oblivion Gate outside of Chorrol. I should speak to the Countess about sending aid to Bruma now that Chorrol is no longer directly threatened.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MQ11_STAGE44_LOG0: I closed the Oblivion Gate outside of Leyawiin. I should speak to the Count about sending aid to Bruma now that Leyawiin is no longer directly threatened.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MQ11_STAGE41_LOG0: I closed the Oblivion Gate outside of Skingrad. I should speak to the Count about sending aid to Bruma now that Skingrad is no longer directly threatened.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE06_STAGE50_LOG4: I convinced Kaneh to attack through the Underdeep. Ulfri will be pleased when I lead the Golden Saints into her trap. I should help destroy the Golden Saints once the Dark Seducers spring their ambush.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_DEAk02_STAGE30_LOG0: I defeated the lich that stole the Elder Scroll. I must retrieve it immediately.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS91_STAGE30_LOG0: I delivered Mazoga's message, and Weebam-Na agreed to go talk to Mazoga. Maybe I should tag along and find out what this is all about.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MQ07_STAGE10_LOG0: I delivered the Mysterium Xarxes to Martin, and told him that Mankar Camoran had escaped to Paradise with the Amulet of Kings. Martin believes the key to opening a portal to Camoran's Paradise lies within the pages of the Mysterium Xarxes, but he will need some time to study it, and ward himself against its evil power.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TG07Lex_STAGE30_LOG0: I delivered the letter to The Stranger. He said to return in a day and he would have the new letter ready. It's going to cost 500 gold coins.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS45_STAGE100_LOG1: I delivered the news of Dar-Ma's death.  Seed-Neeus was devastated, but thanked me for my brave attempt to save her daughter.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TG09Arrow_STAGE28_LOG0: I didn't find the Arrow of Extrication in his room. I should explore this secret passage though. It would be very much like a wizard to hide his valuables in some dark hole filled with monsters.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TG06Atonement_STAGE15_LOG0: I discovered that Theranis was arrested. It seems he was found in a tavern, drunk and bragging about stealing something from Castle Skingrad. The Captain of the Skingrad Guard overheard him and arrested him. I'm going to have to break into the dungeon if I want to speak to Theranis.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_DASanguine_STAGE105_LOG0: I failed to affect all the guests with the Stark Reality spell. The spell has worn off, and my items have been returned to me, but I have failed my quest for Sanguine.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS04_STAGE150_LOG0: I fear I've slain one of the gang members prematurely. Although this puts a stop to the crimes, a better way may have been available had I followed through with the undercover operation.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS10_STAGE40_LOG0: I found Aldos, drunk as usual. He begged me to follow him back to his old house where he wanted me to witness something. I should follow.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TG09Arrow_STAGE26_LOG0: I found Fathis Aren's rooms in Castle Bravil. Now to locate the Arrow of Extrication.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MQ02_STAGE50_LOG1: I found Jauffre and gave him the Amulet of Kings. The Emperor's words to me filled him with foreboding, especially in light of the destruction of the city of Kvatch. Mehrunes Dagon, the Lord of Destruction, is one of the princes of Oblivion, the demonic world. It seems that with no Emperor on the throne, the daedra from Oblivion are able to invade our world.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MQ02_STAGE50_LOG0: I found Jauffre and gave him the Amulet of Kings. The Emperor's words to me filled him with foreboding. Mehrunes Dagon, the Lord of Destruction, is one of the princes of Oblivion, the demonic world. Jauffre fears that with no Emperor on the throne, the daedra from Oblivion may be able to invade our world.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MQ04_STAGE20_LOG1: I found Jauffre. He believes the attackers may have taken the Amulet of Kings from its hiding place in Weynon House. I should go and see if it is still safe.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MQ04_STAGE20_LOG2: I found Jauffre. The attackers have stolen the Amulet of Kings from its hiding place in Weynon House. At least Martin is safe.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MQ15_STAGE80_LOG0: I found Mankar Camoran in his palace of Carac Agaialor. Now I must kill him and take the Amulet of Kings back to Tamriel.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MQ03_STAGE50_LOG0: I found Martin among the survivors of Kvatch. He was surprised to learn that Emperor Uriel Septim was his father, but has agreed to return to Weynon Priory with me to speak to Jauffre.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_FGD06DeadViranus_STAGE20_LOG0: I found Viranus Donton dead. I should look for clues as to what happened here.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE38_STAGE50_LOG0: I found a Blind Watcher's Eye. This might be something Una Armina would want for the Museum of Oddities.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE38_STAGE51_LOG0: I found a Deformed Swamp Tentacle. This might be something Una Armina would want for the Museum of Oddities.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MQ15_STAGE35_LOG1: I found a Xivilai trapped in a cave, and set it free.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TG10Boots_STAGE30_LOG1: I found a book of Imbel family geneology. No mention of Springheel Jak's burial location. Maybe the Earl himself can tell me, with a little friendly persuasion.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TG10Boots_STAGE30_LOG0: I found a book of Imbel family geneology. Very interesting reading. I should ask the Gray Fox about this.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MQ07_STAGE80_LOG0: I found a document in Jearl's basement that reveals the enemy's plans. I should show this document to Jauffre immediately.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE32_STAGE110_LOG0: I found a ghostly Dagger of Depletion in Hloval Dreth's rooms. It should let him recharge his magicka. I wonder who or what he'll use it on?
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE32_STAGE110_LOG1: I found a ghostly Dagger of Depletion. For some reason I am unable to wield it though.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MQ07_STAGE40_LOG1: I found a key marked 'Basement Key'. Perhaps this clue can help me locate a Mythic Dawn agent's base in Bruma.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MQ07_STAGE40_LOG0: I found a key marked 'Basement Key'. Perhaps this clue can help me locate a Mythic Dawn agent's base in Bruma. Captain Burd may be able to provide some information about suspicious activity.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE05_STAGE95_LOG0: I found a key on Ma'zaddha's body; he has hidden evidence somewhere that may help my investigation. I'll need to find it.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TG09Arrow_STAGE30_LOG0: I found a key shaped arrow head, but not the whole arrow. This must be what the Gray Fox is looking for, or at least as close as I am going to get. I should take it to him.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE38_STAGE52_LOG0: I found a lump of Amber that looks vaguely like Sheogorath. This might be something Una Armina would want for the Museum of Oddities.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MQ05_STAGE64_LOG0: I found out that Gwinas is staying at the Tiber Septim Hotel in the Talos Plaza District. I need to find Gwinas and get Volume 3 of Camoran's "Commentaries" from him.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MQ05_STAGE65_LOG0: I found out that Gwinas is staying at the Tiber Septim Hotel in the Talos Plaza District. I need to find out what Gwinas wanted with Volume 3 of Camoran's "Commentaries".
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE32_STAGE120_LOG1: I found some ghostly welkynd stones. I can't seem to use them myself.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE32_STAGE120_LOG0: I found some ghostly welkynd stones. I might be able to use them to help Hloval Dreth.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TG08Blind_STAGE26_LOG0: I found the Temple of the Ancestor Moths. Now I just have to locate Savilla's Stone. Maybe I can persuade one of the monks to help me.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE38_STAGE54_LOG0: I found the ashes of someone named Din in an urn deep in the ruins of Ebrocca. This might be something Una Armina would want for the Museum of Oddities.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS48_STAGE30_LOG0: I found the prisoner in Oblivion. He told me I need to reach the top of the largest tower and look for the Sigil Stone. But I will need the Sigil Keeper's key to gain entry into the Sigil Keep.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TG02taxes_STAGE20_LOG0: I found the tax records. Now to get them back to Armand in the Waterfront district.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_DAMalacath_STAGE36_LOG2: I freed one group of ogres. I must check to see if there are more to be freed.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_DAMalacath_STAGE37_LOG2: I freed one group of ogres. I must check to see if there are more to be freed.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MQ15_STAGE35_LOG2: I freed the Xivilai Anaxes from the cave where he was trapped. I should return to Kathutet and see if he will give me the Bands of the Chosen, as he promised.

If I could remove the Sands of Resolve from Celedaen's posession, perhaps through pickpocketing, he would surely die.

ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_NDPilgrim_STAGE15_LOG0: I have prayed at the Wayshrine of Kynareth.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_NDPilgrim_STAGE16_LOG0: I have prayed at the Wayshrine of Mara.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_NDPilgrim_STAGE17_LOG0: I have prayed at the Wayshrine of Stendarr.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_NDPilgrim_STAGE18_LOG0: I have prayed at the Wayshrine of Talos.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_NDPilgrim_STAGE19_LOG0: I have prayed at the Wayshrine of Zenithar.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_ND06_STAGE50_LOG0: I have prayed at the altar in the Chapel of Stendarr, and have been granted the ability to Lay Hands on Kellen. I need to see him at once.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MSShadowscale_STAGE100_LOG0: I have presented Teinaava with the Argonian's heart.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS39_STAGE40_LOG0: I have reached The Shadeleaf Copse. I can now begin my search for the Nirnroot.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TG10Boots_STAGE40_LOG0: I have read Jakben Imbel's diary, or should I say Springheel Jak's diary. Now I understand why the boots were not in the tomb. Why bury such a valuable item when you can wear it? Even more shocking, it seems that Springheel Jak may have know the Gray Fox himself! They may have been partners in crime several centuries ago.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_Dark09RetirementFIN_STAGE30_LOG0: I have read the sealed orders from Lucien Lachance. I am to meet him at Fort Farragut, which is in the wilderness northeast of the Dark Brotherhood Sanctuary. Apparently, he has a special assignment for me.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_Dark10SpecialWizard_STAGE10_LOG0: I have received my new orders from Lucien Lachance. I must go to Leafrot Cave and kill a Necromancer who has begun the process of transforming himself into a lich. This Necromancer, Celedaen, has not yet completed his metamorphosis but is still incredibly powerful -- possibly too powerful to kill if faced directly. I should search the cave for Celedaen's writings, and try to discover his weakness.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_Dark11Kin_STAGE10_LOG0: I have received my new orders from Lucien Lachance. I must kill every member of the Draconis family -- Perennia Draconis, Matthias Draconis, Andreas Draconis, Sibylla Draconis and Caelia Draconis. I know the location of only the family matron, Perennia Draconis, who can be found on the farm known as Applewatch. I should head to Applewatch, find out as much information as I can on the locations of the other family members, and then systematically kill them all.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MG00Join_STAGE90_LOG0: I have received recommendations from all of the local guild halls in Cyrodiil. I must now travel to the Arcane University, and speak with Raminus Polus.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_DLCOrrery_STAGE30_LOG0: I have recovered all of the missing Dwarven artifacts. I should take them to Bothiel at the Arcane University at once, so she can repair the Orrery.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_ND06_STAGE100_LOG0: I have recovered the Gauntlets of the Crusader.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_ND05_STAGE100_LOG0: I have recovered the Shield of the Crusader.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_ND08_STAGE60_LOG1: I have recovered the Sword of the Crusader, but it has been desecrated by the foul wraith that wielded it. I should take it to the Chapel of Arkay in Cheydinhal to reconsecrate it to its holy purpose.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE11_STAGE112_LOG0: I have refused to give Ra'kheran the daggers that he needs to kill Ciirta. I should return to him if I change my mind.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MG05A_STAGE200_LOG0: I have refused to steal "Fingers of the Mountain" for Earana. That should be an end to my dealings with her.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MG04Restore_STAGE30_LOG0: I have rented a bed at the Brina Cross Inn. I need to wait in my room for Arielle Jurard, and then spend the night sleeping in the Inn.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_Dark10Sanctuary_STAGE100_LOG0: I have reported back to Lucien Lachance at Fort Farragut. He has advanced me to rank of Silencer and given me his own horse, a magical steed named Shadowmere.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_Dark05Assassinated_STAGE110_LOG0: I have reported back to Vicente Valtieri. Because of my failure, I have received no reward.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_Dark09RetirementFIN_STAGE100_LOG0: I have reported to Lucien Lachance at Fort Farragut, and received my special assignment.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MQ03_STAGE50_LOG1: I have rescued Martin from the Chapel of Akatosh. He was surprised to learn that Emperor Uriel Septim was his father, but has agreed to return to Weynon Priory with me to speak to Jauffre.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS93_STAGE20_LOG0: I have retrieved Varulae's crystal ball. I must now return it to her on the top deck of the Serpent's Wake.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS27_STAGE30_LOG0: I have retrieved the Ayleid Crown from Herminia Cinna's house. Now to deliver it to Umbacano.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_DAVaermina_STAGE30_LOG0: I have retrieved the Orb of Vaermina. I should now return it to the Shrine.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_DAClavicusVile_STAGE50_LOG0: I have retrieved the Umbra Sword.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_FGC07Heirloom_STAGE30_LOG0: I have retrieved the ceremonial sword and armor from the Amelion Tomb. I should return them to Biene Amelion.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE45_STAGE200_LOG0: I have returned the Fork of Horripilation to Big-Head. He has told me a secret as a reward.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_FGC05Stone_STAGE50_LOG0: I have returned the Stone of St. Alessia to Cirroc. As a show of his gratitude, he's given me some Strong Healing Potions. I should return to Azzan to collect my reward.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_FGC07Heirloom_STAGE100_LOG0: I have returned to Burz gro-Khash, who was pleased with my efforts. He has paid me what was owed on the contract.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_Dark09Retirement_STAGE100_LOG0: I have returned to Ocheeva at the Sanctuary.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_Dark06Wanderer_STAGE100_LOG0: I have returned to the Sanctuary and spoken with Ocheeva.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_DAPeryite_STAGE90_LOG0: I have returned to the mortal realm, and the souls of Peryite's followers have gone back to their bodies. I should speak with the Daedra again.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TG03BloodPrice_STAGE30_LOG0: I have slain one of the residents of the Chapel of Arkay in Cheydinhal. I'll have to pay the blood price for it. Armand told me it is 1000 gold per person slain. Unfortunately, he will only talk to me after midnight in the Garden of Dareloth.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TG02BloodPrice_STAGE20_LOG0: I have slain someone while trying to recover the tax records. Armand will not be happy about this if he finds out. Murder is against the Thieves Guild rules. It will cost me 1000 gold per person slain to get back into the guild. Unfortunately, he will only talk to me after midnight in the Garden of Dareloth.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_DarkExile_STAGE100_LOG0: I have slain the Wrath of Sithis, and am no longer exiled from the Dark Brotherhood. I may resume my duties as normal.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_DarkExile2_STAGE100_LOG0: I have slain the Wrath of Sithis, and am no longer exiled from the Dark Brotherhood. I may resume my duties as normal. I should be wary, however, for this was my last chance at redemption. If I invoke the Wrath of Sithis again, I will be forever exiled, even if the spirit is slain.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_Dark17Following_STAGE100_LOG0: I have spoken to Arquen, and the Black Hand has been teleported to the site of the ritual.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_FGC10Swamp_STAGE20_LOG0: I have spoken to Drarana Thelis in Harlun's Watch. She tells me that folks have been seeing strange lights in the swamps, and when they've gone to investigate, none have returned.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_FGD07Kidnap_STAGE10_LOG0: I have spoken to Modryn Oreyn, who tells me that, although he has been expelled from the Fighters Guild, he will still work to restore its honor. To that end, he wants me to go to the Glademist Cave and capture a Blackwood Company leader, Ajum-Kajin.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_DAMolagBal_STAGE30_LOG0: I have spoken to a resident of Brindle Home, who tells me that Petilius has lived in a small house outside of town since the death of his wife.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MG00Join_STAGE26_LOG0: I have spoken with Adrienne Berene in Skingrad. She told me I must not be a wanted criminal if I wish to join the Mages Guild.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_Dark18Mother_STAGE100_LOG0: I have spoken with Arquen and she has offered her guidance.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_FGD00JoinFG_STAGE22_LOG0: I have spoken with Azzan in Anvil. He has told me that I must not be a wanted criminal or have a long history of lawlessness in order to join the Fighters Guild.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_FGD00JoinFG_STAGE25_LOG0: I have spoken with Burz gro-Khash in Cheydinhal. He has told me that I must not be a wanted criminal or have a long history of lawlessness in order to join the Fighters Guild.

ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MG00Join_STAGE25_LOG0: I have spoken with Dagail in Leyawiin. She has told me that in order to join the Mages Guild, I must not be a wanted criminal.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_Dark08Whodunit_STAGE15_LOG0: I have spoken with Fafnir, the doorman, who appears to be a fellow member of the Dark Brotherhood. ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MG00Join_STAGE24_LOG0: I have spoken with Falcar in Cheydinhal. He has told me I cannot be a wanted criminal if I wish to join the Mages Guild.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MG00Join_STAGE23_LOG0: I have spoken with Jeanne Frasoric in Bruma. She has told me I must not be a wanted criminal if I wish to join the Mages Guild.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_DAMalacath_STAGE31_LOG0: I have spoken with Lord Drad. He believes the ogres to be suitable slaves, as it does not violate Imperial Law. I fear I've angered him, though, and he will no longer speak with me. Perhaps his wife will be more forthcoming.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_DAMalacath_STAGE30_LOG0: I have spoken with Lord Drad. He believes the ogres to be suitable slaves, as they are mindless beasts, and is pleased with the ogres he uses in Bleak Mine. It appears I will have to free the ogres myself, if I am to complete Malacath's task for me.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_Dark08Whodunit_STAGE50_LOG0: I have spoken with Ocheeva and received a special reward, the Night Mother's Blessing. I now have permanent increases to my Sneak, Blade, Security, Acrobatics and Marksman skills.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_Dark07Medicine_STAGE100_LOG0: I have spoken with Ocheeva and received my reward.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_Dark09RetirementFIN_STAGE20_LOG0: I have spoken with Ocheeva, and she has given me sealed orders from Lucien Lachance himself. Apparently it is an urgent matter, and I must read the orders as soon as possible.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MG00Join_STAGE20_LOG0: I have spoken with Teekeus in Chorrol. He has told me that  I must not be a wanted criminal if I wish to join the Mages Guild,
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_Dark04Execution_STAGE100_LOG0: I have spoken with Vicente Valtieri and received my reward.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_Dark05Assassinated_STAGE100_LOG0: I have spoken with Vicente Valtieri and received my reward.

ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_Dark03Accidents_STAGE100_LOG0: I have spoken with Vicente Valtieri.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_FGD00JoinFG_STAGE20_LOG0: I have spoken with Vilena Donton in Chorrol. She has told me that I must not be a wanted criminal or have a long history of lawlessness in order to join the Fighters Guild.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TG01BestThief_STAGE30_LOG0: I have stolen Amantius Allectus' diary from Methredhel. Now to get back to Armand at Dareloth's garden by midnight.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MGExpulsion01_STAGE10_LOG0: I have stolen from the Mages' Guild, and have been suspended from the guild for it.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MGExpulsion02_STAGE10_LOG0: I have stolen from the Mages' Guild, and have been suspended from the guild for it.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_DASanguine_STAGE30_LOG0: I have succeeded in casting the Stark Reality spell on the Countess of Leyawiin and her company. I should return to the Shrine of Sanguine.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_Dark07Medicine_STAGE15_LOG0: I have successfully entered Fort Sutch. I must now locate Roderick's medicine and replace it with the bottle of posioned medicine.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TrainingConjuration_STAGE100_LOG0: I have summoned a Faded Wraith for Olyn Seran, and he has agreed to train me.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_Dark06Wanderer_STAGE25_LOG0: I have supllied Lorkmir with skooma, and gained some valuable information in return. Every day, from 11:00 in the morning until 5:00 at night, Faelian goes to Lorkmir's House, in the Elven Gardens District of the Imperial City. The house is deserted, so Faelian goes there to use his skooma. I could kill him there to avoid any witnesses. And, conveniently enough, he's even given me a key.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE04_STAGE50_LOG0: I have survived Dunroot Burrow. Now I need to search the tower above for the Chalice of Reversal.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_Dark07Medicine_STAGE20_LOG0: I have taken Rodericks' medicine. I must now put the bottle of poisoned medicine in its place.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_FGC02Protect_STAGE30_LOG0: I have taken care of the crooks breaking into Norbert Lelles' store. I should speak with the shopkeeper himself.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS46_STAGE40_LOG0: I have taken the Totem Head from the goblins at Timberscar Cave. I should return to Mirisa and ask her what to do next.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MQ09_STAGE80_LOG0: I have the Armor of Tiber Septim. Now to take it to Martin at Cloud Ruler Temple.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MQ15_STAGE45_LOG1: I have the Bands of the Chosen. I should find the door to the Forbidden Grotto and see if he was telling the truth.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE04_STAGE60_LOG0: I have the Chalice of Reversal. It should be delivered to Thadon as soon as possible.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TG11Heist_STAGE100_LOG0: I have the Elder Scroll! This is the treasure of the century. My name shall be known across Tamriel for this theft! Now to get it back to the Gray Fox. The way back is blocked. I'll have to go upstairs to find a way out. Even through they are blind, these monks will not be easy to sneak past.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE02_STAGE161_LOG0: I have the Key to Dementia and can enter through the Gates of Madness.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE02_STAGE160_LOG0: I have the Key to Mania and can enter through the Gates of Madness.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TG06Atonement_STAGE60_LOG0: I have the Lost Histories of Tamriel. Now all I have to do is return it to S'krivva in Bravil.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MQ06_STAGE60_LOG0: I have the Mysterium Xarxes, the Mythic Dawn's book of secrets. Now I must escape this place and return to Cloud Ruler Temple.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TG10Boots_STAGE45_LOG0: I have the boots. Now to get back to the Gray Fox in Ganredhel's house in Cheydinhal.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TG03Elven_STAGE20_LOG0: I have the bust. Now to get back to Armand.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MQ05_STAGE90_LOG0: I have the fourth and last volume of Mankar Camoran's writings on the Mysterium Xarxes. I can now piece together the clues within them to find the Mythic Dawn's secret shrine. Maybe Tar-Meena can help.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS48_STAGE40_LOG0: I have the key to the Sigil Keep.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TG07Lex_STAGE20_LOG0: I have the letter. Now I need to find a forger.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MG13Information_STAGE100_LOG0: I have told Arch-Mage Traven about Mannimarco's presence in Cyrodiil.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_DASheogorath_STAGE50_LOG0: I have used cheese to lure many rats into Border Watch. I should speak with Ri'Bassa to see if he believes this to be part of the prophecy.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_Dark10SanctuaryFIN_STAGE100_LOG0: I have visited my first dead drop location and received my next contract.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_DarkVamp_STAGE117_LOG0: I have waited three days and embraced the Dark Gift. I am now a full vampire, like Vicente.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_DASheogorath_STAGE70_LOG1: I have witnessed Sheogorath create the Plague of Fear. I should return to the Shrine.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_DASheogorath_STAGE70_LOG0: I have witnessed the Plague of Fear. I should return to the Shrine.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE32_STAGE10_LOG0: I heard a rumor about the fortress of Vitharn in the far south of the Shivering Isles. Someday I should investigate it.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_HouseBravil_STAGE10_LOG0: I just bought a house in Bravil on the east side of the canal.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_HouseBruma_STAGE10_LOG0: I just bought a house in Bruma. It's right next to the main gate.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_HouseCheydinhal_STAGE10_LOG0: I just bought a house in Cheydinhal. It's right next to the town statue.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_HouseChorrol_STAGE10_LOG0: I just bought a house in Chorrol. It's on the main plaza and back up against the chapel.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_HouseLeyawiin_STAGE10_LOG0: I just bought a house in Leyawiin. It's right in the middle of town.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_HouseSkingrad_STAGE10_LOG0: I just bought a house in Skingrad. It's just inside the main gate, next to the bridge that leads to the Chapel.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_HouseImperialCity_STAGE10_LOG0: I just bought a house in the Imperial City. It's in the Waterfront district, on the far side of the harbor wall.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TG10BloodPrice_STAGE100_LOG0: I just killed someone while trying to get the Boots of Springheel Jak. That will cost me my Thieves Guild membership unless I can pay the blood price of 1000 gold for each murder. I can pay Armand.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MQ15_STAGE90_LOG0: I killed Mankar Camoran. Upon his death, the Paradise he had created dissolved around me, and I found myself back in Cloud Ruler Temple with the Amulet of Kings in my hand. I must give the Amulet to Martin.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE46_STAGE210_LOG1: I killed one of the Demented residents of Split. I won't get rewarded for my efforts.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE46_STAGE210_LOG2: I killed one of the Manic residents of Split. I won't get rewarded for my efforts.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MQ15_STAGE36_LOG0: I killed the Xivilai that I freed from the cave.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TG02taxes_STAGE15_LOG0: I learned that Hieronymus Lex has an office in the South Watchtower. That's probably where he keeps the taxes and tax records. I should check it out.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TG10Boots_STAGE60_LOG0: I learned that the Gray Fox is not immortal. The Gray Cowl of Nocturnal has been passed from master thief to master thief for close to 300 years now. The original thief that stole it from Nocturnal is long dead. So who is the current Gray Fox?
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TG03Elven_STAGE15_LOG0: I learned that the bust of Llathasa Indarys is in her tomb. She is buried in the chapel undercroft of the Temple of Arkay in Cheydinhal.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS46_STAGE10_LOG0: I met Barthel Gernand on the road southeast of the Imperial City. He and his family wish to build a settlement at Cropsford, but have been unable to do so thanks to marauding goblins. I should talk to Mirisa about how to clear the goblins from the settlement site.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_Dark06Wanderer_STAGE20_LOG0: I met Faelian, and he wants me to supply him with skooma. If I do that, he may consider me a friend, making his elimination that much easier. Faelian mentioned that a man named Nordinor in Bravil sells skooma, late at night...
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS38_STAGE9_LOG0: I met Glarthir behind the Great Chapel as he had asked.  He wanted me to help uncover evidence of a conspiracy against him, but I decided not to get involved.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_FGD05Oreyn_STAGE20_LOG0: I met Modryn Oreyn at his house, as he requested. He told me a story about Azani Blackheart, Vitellus Donton's death, and the Blackwood Company's current involvement. He would like me to go with him now to find out what really happened.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS22_STAGE45_LOG0: I met S'razirr at the Tiber Septim Hotel and paid him for his help at Malada.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS27_STAGE70_LOG0: I met Umbacano outside the ruins of Nenalata. I need to guide him safely to the throne room.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MQ15_STAGE54_LOG0: I met a High Elf named Eldamil. He served Mankar Camoran and the Mythic Dawn on Tamriel, but since coming to Gaiar Alata and seeing the true nature of Mankar Camoran's 'paradise', he claims to have regretted his deeds. He warned me that it was impossible to leave these caves while wearing the Bands of the Chosen, and offered to help me by removing them.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS22_STAGE40_LOG1: I met a Khajiit named S'razirr in the wilderness near Malada. He admitted that he is working for Claude Maric. He agreed to help me against Maric in return for half of my reward.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS22_STAGE40_LOG2: I met a Khajiit named S'razirr in the wilderness near Malada. He admitted that he is working for Claude Maric. He agreed to help me against Maric in return for one quarter of my reward.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MQ15_STAGE30_LOG0: I met a dremora named Kathutet who offered to help me get into the Forbidden Grottos if I helped him by freeing a Xivilai that the Mythic Dawn immortals have trapped in a cave. He claimed that the only way to leave the Savage Garden was by wearing the Bands of the Chosen, which he would give me if I help him.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MQ15_STAGE32_LOG0: I met a dremora named Kathutet who told me that he holds the key to the Forbidden Grotto, which he claims is the only way out of the Savage Garden. I should find out what this key is and get it from him.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE32_STAGE20_LOG0: I met a ghost named Count Cirion in the haunted keep of Vitharn. Unfortunately, I insulted him before he could tell me his tale. Now I'm locked into the keep. There must be a way out. Maybe I can talk to the other ghosts.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS38_STAGE5_LOG0: I met a mysterious Wood Elf named Glarthir in Skingrad who asked me to meet him behind the Great Chapel at midnight tonight.  He wouldn't tell me what it was about, but promised to make it worth my while.

ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TrainingDestruction_STAGE20_LOG0: I must bring 20 bear pelts to Bralsa Andaren so that she will agree to teach me what she knows about Destruction magic.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MQ16_STAGE5_LOG0: I must escort Martin to the Elder Council Chambers in the Imperial Palace, to formally present his claim to the Septim Throne.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TrainingArmorer_STAGE20_LOG0: I must find the answer to Gin-Wulm's question: "What does the name Hazadir mean to you?" He hinted that a book in the shop First Edition may have the answer.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TrainingRestoration_STAGE20_LOG0: I must finish saving Kvatch from the Daedra that have attacked it before Oleta will train me.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MQ05_STAGE75_LOG0: I must follow Baurus to the Sunken Sewer beneath the Elven Gardens District and obtain Volume 4 of Mankar Camoran's "Commentaries on the Mysterium Xarxes". One of us will need to meet "The Sponsor" alone to get the book.

I must then kill all the other guests. I should start my mission by speaking with the doorman, just outside the manor.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_Dark06Wanderer_STAGE15_LOG0: I must go to the Imperial City, find a High Elf named Faelian, and kill him. If there are any witnesses to the killing, or if I eliminate him in any non-secure location, my reward will be greatly reduced.  I should start my search by asking any Elves in the Imperial City if they've ever heard of Faelian.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_Dark06Wanderer_STAGE10_LOG0: I must go to the Imperial City, find a High Elf named Faelian, and kill him. If there are any witnesses to the killing, or if I kill him in any non-secure location, my reward will be greatly reduced.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_Dark02Watery_STAGE10_LOG0: I must go to the Waterfront District in the Imperial City and gain access to the pirate ship Marie Elena, so I can kill Captain Gaston Tussaud. I may be able to smuggle myself onboard with the cargo, in one of the packing crates.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_Dark16Kiss_STAGE10_LOG0: I must go to the city of Bravil, and lie in wait near the ancient statue known as the Lucky Old Lady. A Wood Elf named Ungolim visits the statue every night between around 6:00 PM and 1:00 AM to make a wish, as is the local custom. When I see Ungolim, I must kill him. I should be warned, however, that Ungolim has been alerted to danger, and if he senses an assassin will probably attack on sight. He has also bribed the guards to look the other way if there is a fight. Perhaps a stealth approach would be best...
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_Dark03Accidents_STAGE10_LOG0: I must go to the city of Bruma, find Baenlin's house, and gain entrance. Once inside, I should stage a tragic accident.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MSShadowscale_STAGE10_LOG0: I must journey to the southeastern tip of Cyrodiil, to a swamp known as Bogwater. There I will find a renegade Shadowscale known as Scar-Tail. I must kill Scar-Tail, and return his heart to Teinaava.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_Dark09Retirement_STAGE10_LOG0: I must kill Adamus Phillida, a recently retired Imperial Legion officer, who has taken up residence in the City Watch barracks in Leyawiin. For this task, I have been given an enchanted arrow called the Rose of Sithis. If I can hit Phillida with the arrow when he is not wearing his armor, the strike will be fatal. I should head to Leyawiin, stalk Adamus Phillida, and attack when the moment is right. The contract will be complete when Phillida lies dead, whether I use the Rose of Sithis or not.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_Dark10Sanctuary_STAGE10_LOG0: I must kill every Dark Brotherhood member in the Cheydinhal Sanctuary -- Ocheeva, Vicente Valtieri, Antoinetta Marie, Gogron gro-Bolmog, Telaendril, M'raaj-Dar and Teinaava. Because I am now working for the Black Hand, I am no longer bound by the Five Tenets, and should employ any means necessary to Purify the Sanctuary.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_Dark01Knife_STAGE30_LOG0: I must now go to the abandoned house in the city of Cheydinhal, and attempt to open the door in the basement. When questioned, I must answer with "Sanguine, my Brother" to gain access to the secret Dark Brotherhood Sanctuary. Once inside, I should speak with Ocheeva.
