The mace is named Rockshatter. Her husband, Bjalfi the Contemptible, was last seen heading for the ruins of Fort Strand to join the Marauder Gang there.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_DAMephala_STAGE90_LOG0: I've been detected committing a crime in Bleaker's Way. I will not be able to continue my task for Mephala.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE07_STAGE8_LOG0: I've been directed by Sheogorath become the sovereign of Mania or Dementia. He's suggested I speak to Arctus, High Priest of Dementia or Dervenin, High Priest of Mania at the Sacellum Arden-Sul here in New Sheoth to learn more.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE40_STAGE20_LOG0: I've been directed to Uungor as a likely candidate to give up his sleeping spot for Amiable.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE07A_STAGE25_LOG0: I've been duped! The woman in Syl's bed was merely a decoy. Kithlan has told me that Syl must have used her escape tunnel to make good her escape from the Palace. I should immediately pursue Syl before she gets away.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MG03Illusion_STAGE10_LOG0: I've been given a charm scroll, and need to use it to help persuade Varon Varmori in Bravil to return Ardaline's staff.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE03_STAGE8_LOG0: I've been given the Manual of Xedilian and a strange device called an Attenuator of Judgment by Sheogorath. I've been directed to proceed to Xedilian, and to return the place to working order. I should either read the Manual or speak to Sheogorath's Chamberlain, Haskill, to familiarize myself with the strange dungeon.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_ND10_STAGE10_LOG0: I've been granted the Blessing of Talos by the Prophet. I am now ready to destroy Umaril. My knights are on their way to Garlas Malatar to prepare for our final assault on his fortress.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_FGD03Viranus_STAGE5_LOG0: I've been told I should report to Modryn Oreyn in Chorrol for assigned duties.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE05_STAGE60_LOG0: I've been told that Ma'zaddha has been meeting Nelrene late at night in Crucible. I'll need to find them and listen in on their conversation.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_FGD04Defector_STAGE20_LOG0: I've been told that Maglir can be found in the tavern at the Lonely Suitor Lodge.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS23_STAGE30_LOG0: I've been told that Roland Jenseric here in the Temple District of the Imperial City is a vampire. The Order would like me to kill him.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_DAClavicusVile_STAGE40_LOG0: I've been told that Umbra was once a resident of Pell's Gate, but now has left. Some claim to have seen her recently near the Vindasel Ruins.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS02_STAGE60_LOG0: I've been told that Velwyn stays in the King and Queen Tavern here in the Imperial City. I should go there to find him.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TrainingHeavyArmor_STAGE10_LOG0: I've been told that if I want additional training in the use of Heavy Armor, I need to find a man named Pranal, who was last seen at the Roxey Inn.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TrainingLightArmor_STAGE10_LOG0: I've been told that if I want more Light Armor training, I need to talk to J'bari in Leyawiin.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_FGD02DandD_STAGE75_LOG0: I've brough Margarte the ectoplasm she requested. She'll now pay Fighters Guild members for minotaur horns and ogre teeth. I should tell the men back at the Five Claws.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE44_STAGE60_LOG0: I've brought Ahjazda the Amulet of Disintegration.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE44_STAGE50_LOG0: I've brought Ahjazda the Calming Pants.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE44_STAGE70_LOG0: I've brought Ahjazda the Ring of Desiccation.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS16A_STAGE100_LOG1: I've brought Guilbert Jemane safely to Weatherleah. Unfortunately, Reynald was killed along the way.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE32_STAGE50_LOG0: I've burned the doll in the ghostly flames. Desideratus has no reason to find his betrothed now, because she is no more. I should go tell him.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE32_STAGE50_LOG1: I've burned the doll in the ghostly flames. I don't know why I was able to do that, but there must have been some purpose.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_DAHermaeusMora_STAGE32_LOG0: I've captured the soul of a Bosmer.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_DAHermaeusMora_STAGE31_LOG0: I've captured the soul of a Breton.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_DAHermaeusMora_STAGE35_LOG0: I've captured the soul of a Dunmer.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_DAHermaeusMora_STAGE34_LOG0: I've captured the soul of a Khajiit.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_DAHermaeusMora_STAGE37_LOG0: I've captured the soul of a Nord.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_DAHermaeusMora_STAGE38_LOG0: I've captured the soul of a Redguard.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_DAHermaeusMora_STAGE36_LOG0: I've captured the soul of an Altmer.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_DAHermaeusMora_STAGE30_LOG0: I've captured the soul of an Argonian.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_DAHermaeusMora_STAGE33_LOG0: I've captured the soul of an Imperial.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_DAHermaeusMora_STAGE39_LOG0: I've captured the soul of an Orc.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE03A_STAGE20_LOG0: I've caused Syndelius the Mage to go insane by pouring hundreds of keys on the ground which convinced him that one of them opened the gate to the huge treasure pile. All that remains now is the leader of the group, Grommok. I should make my way to the last observation room and choose how the stubborn Orc will encounter his final obstacle.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE03A_STAGE50_LOG1: I've caused the death of the remaining Orc adventurer, Grommok, by animating the zombies in the final room of Xedilian. Now that all of the adventurers have been dealt with, I should speak to Kiliban.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MG08MagesStaff_STAGE50_LOG0: I've chosen a staff, and need to speak to Delmar when it's complete.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SQ08_STAGE10_LOG0: I've come across a bottle of wine with markings I've never seen before. I can barely make out "Shadowbanish Wine" on the label. It must be quite valuable. I should hold onto it until I find out more.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SQ07_STAGE20_LOG0: I've come across a discarded page from a journal of a Slythe Seringi in an abandoned farmhouse near the ruins of Kvatch. It mentions some sort of pilgrimage to bring an offering of great value to something called "The Sunken One". All signs point to Sandstone Cavern nearby. I should proceed there, as I fear for Slythe's safety.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SQ07_STAGE30_LOG0: I've come across a second discarded page from Slythe Seringi's journal. This one details his descent into Sandstone Cavern and how he met dangerous resistance and began to doubt his journey. I should press on and see if I can locate him.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SQ10_STAGE10_LOG0: I've come across an unusual mace named Rockshatter on the body of a Nord. The mace has a worn inscription on the haft reading "To Maeva and Bjalfi in honor of your union." I should hang onto this weapon, as I'm sure Maeva will want to know her late husband's fate.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SQ03_STAGE20_LOG0: I've come upon a sad Breton named Corrick Northwode at Harm's Folly settlement. It seems a goblin war party attacked his home, killed his wife and retreated back to their lair, Exhausted Mine. Now he wants me to go there and recover his wife's Jade Amulet.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS13_STAGE13_LOG0: I've come upon an Oblivion Gate dominating the landscape outside the walls of Cheydinhal. A few Cheydinhal guards seem to be patrolling its perimeter. I should approach one of them and see if I can render any assistance.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS09_STAGE35_LOG1: I've committed a crime and been sent to jail. Perhaps now I can convince Jorundr to tell me about the stolen gold.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS09_STAGE35_LOG0: I've committed a crime and been sent to jail. This may be the perfect opportunity to speak to Jorundr about the stolen gold.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_ND02_STAGE130_LOG3: I've completed Sir Casimir's quest by recovering the Gauntlets of the Crusader. I should continue to search for the Relics that the other ghost Knights were questing for.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_ND02_STAGE130_LOG1: I've completed Sir Casimir's quest by recovering the Gauntlets of the Crusader. I should return to the Priory and find out if there is any news of the remaining two Relics.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_ND02_STAGE130_LOG2: I've completed Sir Casimir's quest by recovering the Gauntlets of the Crusader. I should talk to the other ghost Knights for help in recovering the remaining Relics.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_ND02_STAGE120_LOG3: I've completed Sir Henrik's quest by recovering the Shield of the Crusader. I should continue to search for the Relics that the other ghost Knights were questing for.

ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_ND02_STAGE100_LOG2: I've completed Sir Juncan's quest by recovering the Boots of the Crusader. I should return to the Priory and find out if there is any news of the remaining two Relics.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_ND02_STAGE100_LOG3: I've completed Sir Juncan's quest by recovering the Boots of the Crusader. I should talk to the other ghost Knights for help in recovering the remaining Relics.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_ND02_STAGE110_LOG3: I've completed Sir Ralvas's quest by recovering the Mace of the Crusader. I should continue to search for the Relics that the other ghost Knights were questing for.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_ND02_STAGE110_LOG1: I've completed Sir Ralvas's quest by recovering the Mace of the Crusader. I should return to the Priory and find out if there is any news of the remaining two Relics.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_ND02_STAGE110_LOG2: I've completed Sir Ralvas's quest by recovering the Mace of the Crusader. I should talk to the other ghost Knights for help in recovering the remaining Relics.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_DLC06ThievesDen_STAGE100_LOG0: I've completely upgraded Dunbarrow Cove and hired on a full crew. Once a week, the pirates who follow me will provide me with my share of their plunder. In order to send them out, I must speak with one of them to send them on a mission. They will return to Dunbarrow Cove in one week with my share of the loot.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS51_STAGE80_LOG0: I've confronted Chanel with the clues, and she admitted taking the painting. She pointed out where it was hidden, and now I must decide whether or not to tell the Countess about her crime.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS51_STAGE70_LOG0: I've confronted Orgnolf with the clues, but all he did was become irate and threatened to tell the Countess of my false accusations. I think I made the wrong choice. I should go speak to Chanel.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_FGC01Rats_STAGE90_LOG0: I've confronted Quill-Weave, and she has admitted to trying to kill off Arvena's rats. She has promised to stop, and has asked me not to tell Arvena what she's done.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS09_STAGE60_LOG0: I've convinced Arnora to give me her amulet. However, I've agreed to split the gold with her. She gave me the key to unlock the chest next to her bed. Inside is the amulet Jorundr is looking for. I should retrieve it and bring it to the Bruma Castle Dungeon.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS26_STAGE80_LOG0: I've convinced both Ruslan and Luronk to testify against Audens Avidius. I hope Itius Hayn is true to his word and arrests his fellow Watch Captain. Otherwise those two are going to be in a lot of trouble. I could keep an eye on those two and make sure they go to see Itius first thing in the morning.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MQ05_STAGE78_LOG0: I've decided Baurus will be the one to take the book from The Sponsor and I will provide backup. No matter what happens, we must get that book.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MQ05_STAGE77_LOG0: I've decided to be the one to take the book from The Sponsor and Baurus will provide backup. No matter what happens, I must get that book.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS23_STAGE84_LOG0: I've decided to give Roland a chance, and will investigate his story. Roland told me that Seridur makes the occasional trip to the First Edition bookshop in the Market District of the Imperial City. He told me I should speak to the owner, Phintias.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS31_STAGE80_LOG0: I've decided to kill Selene. Now that she's dead, I should speak to Ormil.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS12_STAGE13_LOG0: I've declined Countess Narina Carvain's offer for now. She said I could return at any time if I wish to change my mind.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS14_STAGE35_LOG0: I've declined to help Tivela locate her husband, but she said she'd be here if I change my mind.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MG07Leyawiin_STAGE70_LOG0: I've defeated Kalthar, who was attempting to manipulate Dagail. I need to give her this information immediately.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS08_STAGE70_LOG0: I've defeated all of the hunters. I should search the body of the Orc Hunter for the key to the keep door of Fort Grief.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_ND02_STAGE50_LOG0: I've defeated the ghostly guardians of the Cuirass of the Crusader. I can now claim it for my own.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MG09Motives_STAGE100_LOG0: I've delievered Hassildor's message to Raminus Polus.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MG05A_STAGE30_LOG0: I've delivered the "Fingers of the Mountain" book to Earana. I need to return to her in a days' time to receive my reward for helping her.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MG05A_STAGE5_LOG0: I've delivered the "Fingers of the Mountain" book to Earana. I need to return to her in a days' time to receive my reward for helping her.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MG05Fingers_STAGE200_LOG0: I've delivered the "Fingers of the Mountain" book to Earana. I need to return to her in a days' time to receive my reward for helping her.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MG05Fingers_STAGE100_LOG0: I've delivered the "Fingers of the Mountain" book to Teekeeus at the Chorrol Mages Guild. In exchange, Teekeeus has agreed to write a recommendation for me. I shall have to tell Earana she won't be getting the book.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MG16Amulet_STAGE100_LOG1: I've delivered the Necromancer's Amulet to Hannibal Traven.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS12_STAGE105_LOG0: I've destroyed the commander of the Akaviri fort. I should proceed ahead and search for the Madstone.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_DLC06ThievesDen_STAGE18_LOG0: I've destroyed the last of the undead pirates and claimed Dunbarrow Cove as my own. The cavern and the hulk of the Black Flag are in terrible condition after hundreds of years underground. I should speak with Dahlia Rackham of the Clarabella. She will be able to assist me in hiring a crew to turn Dunbarrow Cove into a suitable base of operations.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE12_STAGE60_LOG0: I've discovered a chrysalis that generates a tame Gnarl Cultivator. Perhaps these gnarls can help me halt the spread of Order throughout the Fountainhead.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_DLCFrostcragSpire_STAGE30_LOG0: I've discovered a dusty tome within Frostcrag Spire. I should read it to learn more about this unusual structure.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_DLCDeepscorn_STAGE30_LOG0: I've discovered a long forgotten journal within Deepscorn Lair. I should read it to learn more about this unusual structure.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS11_STAGE70_LOG0: I've discovered a small journal in Raynil's room at the inn. It seems he was part of a group of adventurers who uncovered an artifact of some sort from some Ayleid ruins. They all agreed to stash the artifact in a cave until more research could be done about it. Each of them took a key to the chest it was secured in. The two other members of the group were Bradon and someone named Gelebourne. I need to find out more about Gelebourne to confirm my suspicions about Raynil. Olav may be able to help.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_HouseSkingradQuest_STAGE10_LOG0: I've discovered an old, dusty parchment in an unused part of Rosethorn Hall. I doubt that it's been disturbed in at least 200 years or more. It tells of a treasure located somewhere within this place. If I can answer the riddle, I may know what I'm looking for.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS29_STAGE50_LOG0: I've discovered that Agarmir has a house in Talos Plaza. I should go inside when he's not around and investigate.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS11_STAGE10_LOG0: I've discovered that Bradon Lirrian, a resident here in Bruma, was actually a vampire. He was slain by a vampire hunter who has appeared in town named Raynil Dralas. However, the circumstances of this incident sound sketchy at best. I should make my way to the crime scene at Bradon's house to investigate.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS23_STAGE85_LOG0: I've discovered that Seridur makes the occasional visit to a place called Memorial Cave. It's a burial site for many heroes that died in past wars. Seridur supposedly has a relative interred there. Perhaps I should go investigate.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE07A_STAGE10_LOG0: I've discovered that Syl tends to stay out of public sight, and lets members of her court perform her day-to-day needs. It was suggested I seek out Anya Herrick, her Courtier and Kithlan, her Steward for more information. Perhaps if I can convince them to see things my way, I'll get some help from them.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS02_STAGE50_LOG0: I've discovered that Velwyn has left town and made his way to the Imperial City. If I am to find out why Benirus Manor is haunted, I need to find him there.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS12_STAGE60_LOG0: I've discovered the body of the messenger who penned the diary I've been carrying. Even though he died over a thousand years ago, the bones have been well preserved by the frost in the caves. He seems to be clutching something in his bony hand. I should investigate.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS12_STAGE85_LOG0: I've discovered the crumbled walls of the once mighty Fort Pale Pass. It appears to have been destroyed by a landslide long ago. I should proceed into the ruins and search for the Madstone.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE03_STAGE20_LOG0: I've discovered the first of the three Focus Crystals. It was affixed to the top of a Grummite Shaman's Crystal Staff. I think they are using the crystals as a power source for their weapons. Now that I've removed it from the staff, I should place the Focus Crystal in its Judgment Nexus to continue.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS06_STAGE70_LOG0: I've discovered the logbook of the Emma May. It appears that at some point, there was a mutiny and the ship was diverted from its course. Two men tried to stop the mutiny, but were imprisoned below decks. Seeking shelter from a bad storm, the ship pulled into what looked like a safe cove. That was the last entry. I fear that they didn't see the rocks of the Mouth of the Panther and ran aground. I should continue investigating.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SQ04_STAGE10_LOG0: I've discovered the research notes of a Lithnilian. The notes mention him being at the Imperial Bridge Inn. Perhaps if I return this book to him, he'll offer me a reward.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE03_STAGE30_LOG0: I've discovered the second Focus Crystal. I should place it in its Judgment Nexus to continue.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE08_STAGE50_LOG0: I've discovered the source of Order's power -- an obelisk is having its power amplified by the spire that leads to the center of Passwall. I must find a way to shut down the obelisk.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE03_STAGE40_LOG0: I've discovered the third and final Focus Crystal. I should place it in its Judgment Nexus to continue.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_DL9MehrunesQuest_STAGE60_LOG0: I've dispelled Drothan's barrier and can now follow him into Varsa Baalim.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TrainingHeavyArmor_STAGE100_LOG0: I've done all that Pranal has asked of me, and he has agreed to teach me what he knows about Heavy Armor.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS12_STAGE80_LOG0: I've emerged from The Serpent's Trail and find myself face to face with the legendary Pale Pass. A path winds down into the snowy valley. If I follow it, it should lead me directly to the ruins.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SQ01_STAGE30_LOG0: I've encountered an Ogre out in the wilderness. This seems to be S'jirra's thief, as it was carrying her Jumbo Potatoes.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS37_STAGE80_LOG0: I've entered Frostfire Glade. The entire area seems filled with a swirling, freezing mist. The extreme cold in this place is unbearable without magical protection. The glade is true to its namesake; the frost burns as if it was fire. I should now carefully begin searching it for Garridan's Tears.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS05_STAGE50_LOG0: I've entered Henantier's Dreamworld. To my surprise, I've arrived naked except for the Dreamworld amulet! Not only am I unarmed, but also I've discovered that the amulet is preventing me from using any magic. I'll have to explore this strange place in hopes of finding something to defend myself with.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE41_STAGE20_LOG0: I've entered Knotty Bramble. I should make my way carefully to the pool Sickly Bernice spoke of and recover a sample of aquanostrum.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS23_STAGE90_LOG0: I've entered Memorial Cave. It's now being used as a vampire den. I need to see if I can find Seridur in here and put a stop to his charade.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS11_STAGE60_LOG0: I've entered Raynil's room. I should carefully search the place for anything suspicious.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_DL9MehrunesQuest_STAGE15_LOG0: I've entered Sundercliff Watch, a place that folklore links to Mehrunes Dagon. I should explore the area.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE07A_STAGE22_LOG0: I've entered Syl's Private Chambers. I now need to locate Syl herself and put an end to her reign as Duke of Dementia.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE03_STAGE15_LOG0: I've entered Xedilian. I should now begin locating the Focus Crystals that link the Resonator of Judgment with the rest of the dungeon.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TG08Blind_STAGE4_LOG0: I've entered the Catacombs of the blind monks. The Gray Fox hinted that the true guardians of Savilla's Stone would not be subject to Blood Price. I'm betting that also means they won't be too happy to see me. I'd better be careful from here on.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_DL9MehrunesQuest_STAGE90_LOG0: I've entered the Nefarivigum and read Drothan's notes. They seem to indicate that by eating the heart of Dagon's champion, I'll be allowed to retrieve the Razor. Drothan seemed to suspect some other means of claiming the dagger, though he seemed unsure how.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE02_STAGE190_LOG0: I've entered the Shivering Isles. I should seek out Sheogorath.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS11_STAGE5_LOG0: I've entered the house of Bradon Lirrian in Bruma. A guard named Carius Runellius has told me that this was the scene of a crime, and unless I was a guard or someone named Raynil Dralas, I should leave.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_DL9MehrunesQuest_STAGE70_LOG0: I've entered the lost Ayleid city of Varsa Baalim. There's no telling what I may encounter here; I must be on my guard.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE07B_STAGE35_LOG1: I've entered the main hall in the House of Mania later than expected to find Thadon already dead from his Greenmote overdose. I should now collect as much of his tainted blood as possible.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE07B_STAGE35_LOG0: I've entered the main hall in the House of Mania, and the evening feast is underway. I should watch the effect the Greenmote overdose has on Thadon.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SQ07_STAGE10_LOG0: I've entered what appears to be a recently abandoned farmhouse. Perhaps if I search around, I may find a clue as to the owner's whereabouts.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE07B_STAGE18_LOG0: I've followed Wide-Eye to a unremarkable alcove in the Palace courtyard. I should watch from this vantage point to see what she does.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_DLC06ThievesDen_STAGE15_LOG0: I've followed the rumors and found Dunbarrow Cove and the remains of the Black Flag. However, the caverns are overrun by the skeletons of the pirates who perished here. I'll have to put them all to rest before I can begin to refit the cove.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS39_STAGE70_LOG0: I've found 20 more of the Nirnroot. I should return to Sinderion in Skingrad so he can begin creating a moderate version of the Elixir of Exploration from them.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS39_STAGE80_LOG0: I've found 30 more of the Nirnroot. I should return to Sinderion in Skingrad so he can begin creating a strong version of the Elixir of Exploration from them.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS39_STAGE90_LOG0: I've found 40 more samples of Nirnroot. I should return to Sinderion in Skingrad so he can begin creating a grand version of the Elixir of Exploration from them.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS09_STAGE160_LOG0: I've found Arnora's body in her house. Tyrellius has indeed killed her. I should probably leave before the town guard thinks I had something to do with it. On the bright side, all of Jorundr's gold is now mine.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SQ10_STAGE30_LOG0: I've found Bjalfi the Contemptible inside Fort Strand, with Rockshatter still in his possession. I should take the weapon back to Maeva and tell her of her late husband's fate.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_FGC04Scholar_STAGE20_LOG0: I've found Elante of Alinor in Brittlerock Cave. She tells me that she would like to travel to the bottom of this cave complex, as she has heard there is a Daedric Shrine there. She will lead the way, and I will protect her.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MG01Destruct_STAGE70_LOG0: I've found Erthor in Bleak Flats Cave, and have agreed to escort him back to Adrienne Berene in Skingrad.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MG01Destruct_STAGE80_LOG0: I've found Erthor in Bleak Flats Cave, and have told him to return to his guild hall. I need to report back to Adrienne Berene in Skingrad once Erthor has returned to town.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_ND05_STAGE20_LOG0: I've found Fort Bulwark. I need to get inside and find the Shield.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS17_STAGE60_LOG0: I've found Jirloin Doran trapped in Rock Bottom Caverns. I'll need to help him escape the ogres.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE05_STAGE92_LOG0: I've found Ma'zaddha dead in his home. I should see if he was holding any evidence of this conspiracy.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MG12Gate_STAGE50_LOG0: I've found Mucianus Alias. He's been transformed into some kind of walking dead; there's nothing I can do for him. I should report his fate to Hannibal Traven at the Arcane University.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS02_STAGE70_LOG0: I've found Velwyn at The King and Queen Tavern in the Imperial City. I should speak to him further about the manor and the strange goings on within.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS16A_STAGE20_LOG0: I've found Weatherleah south of Chorrol, but it's overrun with ogres. I should report this information to Guilbert.

He then painted trolls to protect himself, but they turned on their creator and killed him. Now the Brush is on the thief's body, and we can't leave without it. I should take my leave of Rythe for now and begin exploring this surreal forest.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE03_STAGE10_LOG0: I've learned that in order to restore Xedilian, I must activate the Resonator of Judgment. To do so, I will need to find three Focus Crystals and place them each in a Judgment Nexus, which will prepare the Resonator for attunement. I should proceed to Xedilian now and begin my search.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_FGD07Kidnap_STAGE50_LOG0: I've learned that the Blackwood Company is over 100 strong, and growing every day. I must find out who leads them.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS12_STAGE2_LOG0: I've learned that the Countess of Bruma, Narina Carvain is the collector of Akaviri artifacts. Apparently, she's seeking a particular piece to add her relics. The townsperson I spoke to recommended I seek out Tolgan, her steward, if I was interested in retrieving the piece.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_FGD07Kidnap_STAGE60_LOG0: I've learned their leader is Ri'Zakar. I must now learn the source of their power, what gives them such courage in battle.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS29_STAGE82_LOG0: I've located Agarmir inside the Trentius Family Mausoleum. It appears as though he's attempting to desecrate another grave along with someone else I don't recognize. I need to convince him to stop this heinous act.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS13_STAGE50_LOG0: I've located Farwil and one other survivor of his group. They look wounded and shaken. I should speak to them to learn what's happened here.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS05_STAGE60_LOG0: I've located Henantier. He seems awfully confused and doesn't understand where he is or how he got here. He did mention that he lost some things. Perhaps they're keys or clues explaining how to exit this bizarre place.  I have no choice but to explore the recesses of his Dreamworld and find these objects.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS11_STAGE110_LOG0: I've located Raynil in Boreal Stone Cave. He refused to surrender, choosing instead to attack me. I was forced to kill him to defend myself. I can now recover the artifact mentioned in Gelebounre's journal from the chest.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS14_STAGE50_LOG0: I've located Rythe Lythandas. He was standing in this strange forest, seemingly waiting for someone to rescue him. He blames his predicament on a thief. I should continue speaking with Rythe to find out more.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SQ07_STAGE40_LOG0: I've located Slythe Seringi's corpse. I should search around him to learn the conclusion to his sad journey.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS13_STAGE50_LOG1: I've located a Dunmer and a Breton in the Oblivion plane. They look wounded and shaken. I should speak to them to learn what's happened here.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS05_STAGE75_LOG2: I've located the Element of Courage, the final element in this bizarre amalgam of Henantier's dreams. I should bring all four elements to Henantier and try to restore his sanity.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS05_STAGE72_LOG2: I've located the Element of Courage, the second Element to be found in Henantier's Dreamword. I should continue searching for more elements.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS05_STAGE74_LOG2: I've located the Element of Courage, the third Element to be found in Henantier's Dreamword. I should continue searching for more elements.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS05_STAGE70_LOG2: I've located the Element of Courage. This must be one of the things that Henantier misplaced. Losing this attribute of his mind must be what's making him so confused. If I can find all of the elements, and bring them back to him, it should restore Henantier's sanity and help him awaken. I should continue searching for other elements if I ever intend to leave this waking nightmare.

ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE10_STAGE53_LOG0: I've located the Wellspring of the Aureal. It's been covered in Order crystals; I'll need to destroy them to restore the Wellspring.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE10_STAGE48_LOG0: I've located the Wellspring of the Mazken. It's been covered in Order crystals; I'll need to destroy them to restore the Wellspring.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS14_STAGE60_LOG0: I've located the thief's corpse. I should now search it for the Brush of Truepaint.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE08_STAGE45_LOG0: I've made my way into the ruins of Xeddefen. I must seek out the spire's source of power and find a way to deactivate it.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_FGD02DandD_STAGE40_LOG0: I've managed to subdue the three Fighters Guild members. I should find out why they have been causing so much trouble.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS13_STAGE20_LOG0: I've met Amminus Gregori at an Oblivion Gate that has appeared outside of Cheydinhal. He said that a group of Knights led by the Count of Cheydinhal's son, Farwil Indarys, went inside to close the Gate. That was almost two days ago. The Count has posted a generous reward for the closing of the Oblivion Gate and information on Farwil's whereabouts. I should question him to learn more.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE30_STAGE120_LOG0: I've met Cutter of New Sheoth. She can forge items from Madness Ore.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE30_STAGE20_LOG0: I've met Dumag gro-Bonk who lives in New Sheoth. He can forge things from Amber.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS16_STAGE20_LOG0: I've met Guilbert Jemane, who is Reynald's twin brother. Guilbert did not know that his brother was still alive, and is anxious to meet him. He asked me to meet him in Chorrol, so that they can thank me together for my help in reuniting them.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE03A_STAGE10_LOG0: I've met Kiliban Nyrandil inside one of the many observation rooms of Xedilian. It also appears that Xedilian has its first visitors, a group of adventurers. It's up to me to decide whether to allow Xedilian to kill them or drive them insane.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SQ04_STAGE20_LOG0: I've met Lithnilian, an Altmer Sorcerer, at the Imperial Bridge Inn in the wilderness southeast of the Imperial City. He's asked me to locate his research notes on Welkynd Stones which he lost in the depths of Bramblepoint Cave.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS08_STAGE10_LOG0: I've met Ursanne Loche in Bravil. She's told me that her husband, Aleron Loche is missing and she needs my help to locate him. I should ask her more about Aleron to help determine if I'm interested in helping.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS02_STAGE20_LOG0: I've met Velwyn Benirus. He has a manor house for sale here in Anvil. I should question him further to see how much he wants for it.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS02_STAGE85_LOG0: I've met Velwyn at The Count's Arms Tavern. He's agreed to escort me to the house and open the secret room.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SQ02_STAGE10_LOG0: I've met a Legion Guard named Lerexus Callidus outside the walls of Leyawiin. He tells me there is a Skooma dealer named Kylius Lonavo in the Greyland settlement just up the road. He's offered me a reward to go into the house, put a stop to the drug traders and bring him Lonavo's ring as proof.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS12_STAGE5_LOG0: I've met a Nord named Tolgan. Apparently, he's the herald of Countess Narina Carvain from here in Bruma. He presented me with a stipend of gold, and a request from Lady Carvain to meet her at the castle. Not wanting to offend the Countess, I should accept the request, and make my way there when she holds court.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS14_STAGE20_LOG0: I've met a kindly Dunmer named Tivela Lythandas. It seems that her husband, Rythe, has gone missing. She seems extremely distraught, so perhaps I should talk to her to find out more information.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS22_STAGE30_LOG0: I've met a man named Claude Maric, who claims to be another treasure hunter hired by Umbacano. He promised to tell me more over drinks at the Tiber Septim Hotel across the street from Umbacano's house.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE34_STAGE10_LOG0: I've met a man named Pyke in the Hale Settlement. He claims to be something called a "Knight of the Thorn"; an elite group of knights from Cyrodiil. In a recent clash with some Grummites, he lost his Knights of the Thorn medallion and wants me to recover it from Fetid Grove, which he marked on my map.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SQ01_STAGE20_LOG0: I've met a strange Khajiit named S'jirra at the Faregyl Inn. She insists someone is stealing her supply of Jumbo Potatoes. Apparently, she uses them to make what she calls her "Famous Potato Bread". She's offered a reward for the potatoes safe return. Whoever they are, S'jirra said they were "huge" and headed west.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS29_STAGE80_LOG0: I've noticed that the door to the Trentius Family Mausoleum has been unsealed. This must be Agarmir's doing. I should proceed inside.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_HouseCheydinhal_STAGE30_LOG0: I've now bought everything Borba gra-Uzgash has for my house in Cheydinhal.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_HouseLeyawiin_STAGE30_LOG0: I've now bought everything Gundalas has for my house in Leyawiin.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_HouseSkingrad_STAGE30_LOG0: I've now bought everything Gunder has for my house in Skingrad.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_HouseBravil_STAGE30_LOG0: I've now bought everything Nilawen has for my house in Bravil.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_HouseChorrol_STAGE30_LOG0: I've now bought everything Seed-Neeus has for my house in Chorrol.

ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_HouseBruma_STAGE30_LOG0: I've now bought everything Suurootan has for my house in Bruma.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS39_STAGE60_LOG0: I've now found a total of 10 Nirnroot. I should return to Sinderion in Skingrad so he can begin creating an Elixir of Exploration from them.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_DLCFrostcragSpire_STAGE50_LOG0: I've now purchased everything Aurelinwae had available for Frostcrag Spire.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_DLCBattlehornCastle_STAGE100_LOG0: I've now purchased everything Nilphas Omellian had available for Battlehorn Castle.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_DLCDeepscorn_STAGE50_LOG0: I've now purchased everything Rowley Eardwulf had available for Deepscorn Hollow.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE07B_STAGE20_LOG0: I've observed Wide-Eye activating the secret entrance to the Greenmote Silo. I need to get inside and procure two extra doses of the potent drug without getting caught.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS29_STAGE40_LOG0: I've observed a meeting between Thoronir and a mysterious man named Agarmir. Looks like my new target is Agarmir. I should follow him and see where he goes.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE07B_STAGE45_LOG0: I've obtained Thadon's drug-tainted blood. I now need to make my way back to the Altar of Arden-Sul at the Sacellum.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS12_STAGE110_LOG0: I've obtained the Draconian Madstone. I should now make the long journey back to Countess Carvain in Bruma.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SQ06_STAGE60_LOG0: I've obtained the fifth West Weald Bear Fang.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SQ06_STAGE20_LOG0: I've obtained the first West Weald Bear Fang from a bear that has been threatening Thorley Aethelred's sheep.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SQ06_STAGE50_LOG0: I've obtained the fourth West Weald Bear Fang.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SQ06_STAGE30_LOG0: I've obtained the second West Weald Bear Fang.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SQ06_STAGE70_LOG0: I've obtained the sixth and final West Weald Bear Fang. I should return to Shardrock and give the fangs to Thorley Aethelred as proof of my deed.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SQ06_STAGE40_LOG0: I've obtained the third West Weald Bear Fang.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE07B_STAGE25_LOG0: I've obtained two doses of Greenmote. I now need to sneak into Thadon's kitchen sometime before eight o'clock and attempt to slip an extra dose into his evening meal and into his wine without being seen, otherwise try again tomorrow night. Gundlar prepare the meal in the morning, so I'll have to wait until the afternoon to poison his food.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE06_STAGE125_LOG0: I've opened the gate. The Golden Saints can now continue their attack. I should accompany them and help them destroy the rest of the Dark Seducers in Cylarne.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_ND10_STAGE20_LOG0: I've ordered my Knights to attack Umaril and his Aurorans at Garlas Malatar. We must destroy Umaril once and for all.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE05_STAGE70_LOG0: I've overheard Ma'zaddha and Nelrene speaking. I need to confront Ma'zaddha with this information.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS02_STAGE10_LOG0: I've overheard a rumor that Velwyn Benirus wants to sell a manor here in Anvil, and that he's selling it cheap. I should go find him and see what he has to offer.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE08_STAGE70_LOG0: I've overloaded the obelisk and collapsed the spire. The caverns are now coming down around me and I must escape before I'm trapped.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MG03Illusion_STAGE60_LOG0: I've paid Soris Arenim, and he has given me Ardaline's staff. I need to deliver the staff to Kud-Ei in Bravil.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MG01Destruct_STAGE30_LOG0: I've paid Sulinus Vassinus, and he has agreed to go to Bleak Flats Cave and perform the task I was given. Once he returns, I can take credit for it.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS17_STAGE20_LOG0: I've placed Jirolin's gems at Spy Rock. I should return and let him know I've completed the task.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_DAMephala_STAGE80_LOG0: I've placed evidence on both bodies of the family leaders. Now I must tell someone I saw them attack each other.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_DASheogorath_STAGE47_LOG0: I've placed the Olroy Cheese into the cooking pot. The smell coming from it is astounding.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE03_STAGE25_LOG0: I've placed the first Focus Crystal into its Nexus. I can now continue searching for Focus Crystals.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE03_STAGE35_LOG0: I've placed the second Focus Crystal into its Nexus. I can now continue searching for the final Focus Crystal.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS43_STAGE70_LOG0: I've placed the staff near the altar at the shrine to Sheogorath. The scamps seem pleased with their new home, and best of all have stopped following me. I should return to Rosentia with the news.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE03_STAGE45_LOG0: I've placed the third and final Focus Crystal into its Judgment Nexus. The path to the Resonator of Judgment itself is now clear. My next task should be to attune the Resonator by using the Attenuator of Judgment that Sheogorath provided me.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TG05Misdirection_STAGE50_LOG0: I've planted the Icestaff in the chest in Ontus' bedroom. I should go see S'krivva and collect my reward.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS37_STAGE40_LOG0: I've purchased Knightfall from Phinitas at the First Edition Bookshop in the Market District. I should read it to find out more about Garridan's Tears.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_DLC06ThievesDen_STAGE70_LOG0: I've purchased an upgrade to my personal quarters on the Black Flag. I should be able to sleep more comfortably now.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS02_STAGE30_LOG0: I've purchased the manor from Velwyn. He gave me a key and the deed of ownership. I can now move in there at any time.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE39_STAGE60_LOG0: I've put Cindanwe's house in disarray.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS49_STAGE60_LOG0: I've raised the gates into Castle Kvatch. I must now help Savlian and his men defeat the monsters within.

ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_ND03_STAGE21_LOG0: I've reached the Grove of Trials. I shall have to wait and see what Kynareth has in store for me.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MQ10_STAGE38_LOG0: I've reached the Sigil Stone. Now I need to bring Captain Burd here and show him how to close an Oblivion Gate.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS12_STAGE40_LOG0: I've reached the second landmark, The Sentinel. I should consult the messenger's diary once again to discern the way to the third landmark.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_DL9MehrunesQuest_STAGE30_LOG0: I've read Drothan's Journal. He's gone into Varsa Baalim in search of something called the 'Nefarivigum', which he believes protects Mehrunes Razor. He has left enchanted bezoars in the care of his Commander and Forgemaster. With these bezoars, I'll be able to dispel his enchantment and follow him into Varsa Baalim.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS21_STAGE10_LOG0: I've received a note from a man called Umbacano; he's interested in the Ayleid statue I found and sold. I should find him in the Imperial City and see what he wants.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE03A_STAGE60_LOG0: I've received some items and gold from Kiliban Nyrandil that had belonged to the adventurers. I can now safely report back to Sheogorath that Xedilian is in full operation.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS14_STAGE38_LOG0: I've reconsidered and decided to help Tivela locate Rythe. She gave me the key to his studio.  If I intend to find her husband, that would be the best place to start.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SQ03_STAGE30_LOG0: I've recovered Kayleen's Jade Amulet. I should return it to Corrick at Harm's Folly.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SQ02_STAGE20_LOG0: I've recovered Kylius Lonavo's ring. I should bring it to Lerexus as soon as possible to obtain my reward.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SQ04_STAGE30_LOG0: I've recovered Lithnilian's research notes from Bramblepoint Cave. I should return it to Lithnilian for the promised reward.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_DL9MehrunesQuest_STAGE100_LOG0: I've recovered Mehrunes Razor, a potent daedric dagger which has a chance to instantly destroy an opponent.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE34_STAGE30_LOG0: I've recovered Pyke's Medallion. I should now return to the Hale Settlement and bring Pyke his missing property.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE41_STAGE30_LOG0: I've recovered a sample of aquanostrum from the pool Sickly Bernice described. I should return to New Sheoth and present it to her for my well-deserved reward.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS39_STAGE10_LOG0: I've recovered a sprig of Nirnroot. A plant ingredient this unusual must have value. Perhaps I should bring it to an alchemist and find out a little more about it. An alchemist can be found in almost every city in Cyrodiil.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE34_STAGE5_LOG0: I've recovered an unusual amulet with the markings of a group calling itself The Knights of the Thorn. On the back, there is an inscription that reads "To Pyke, from Farwil." I can only assume that Pyke is here in the Shivering Isles. If I can find him, I'm sure he will be happy to get his medallion back.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SQ08_STAGE30_LOG0: I've recovered six bottles of Shadowbanish Wine. I should bring them back to Nerussa at the Wawnet Inn for my final reward.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MG17Ambush_STAGE90_LOG0: I've recovered the Black Soul Gem. It needs to be taken back to Hannibal Traven at the Arcane University.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MG15Helm_STAGE30_LOG0: I've recovered the Bloodworm Helm. I need to deliver it to Arch-Mage Traven immediately.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_ND02_STAGE60_LOG0: I've recovered the Cuirass of the Crusader. I should talk to the ghosts of the former Knights of the Nine to see if they can aid me in my quest for the remaining Crusader's Relics.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_ND01_STAGE50_LOG0: I've recovered the Helm of the Crusader, the first piece of the Crusader's Relics.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_ND04_STAGE100_LOG2: I've recovered the Mace of the Crusader.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE07A_STAGE35_LOG0: I've removed Syl's heart. I now need to make my way back to the Altar of Arden-Sul at the Sacellum.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_ND05_STAGE30_LOG0: I've rescued Sir Thedret, a knight imprisoned within the Fort. I need to watch out for traps in the lower levels, and remember the phrase "When the eyes of the Guardians are upon you, Julianos will show you favor."
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS14_STAGE70_LOG0: I've retrieved the Brush of Truepaint. I should go back and return it to Rythe, so together we can leave this strange landscape.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS16B_STAGE50_LOG0: I've retrieved the Honorblade of Chorrol from the Ogre Chieftain. This has to be the item Fathis was seeking. However, due to the nature of the item, I think someone at Castle Chorrol would be anxious to have this back. I need to decide whether to sell the weapon to Fathis, or return it to the Castle.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_FGC03Flagon_STAGE95_LOG0: I've returned Newheim's Flagon to the Nord, who was pleased to have the heirloom returned. He rewarded me with three bottles of his own special brew.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SQ10_STAGE100_LOG0: I've returned Rockshatter to Maeva. She was pleased and rewarded me with a small parcel of gold.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SQ01_STAGE100_LOG0: I've returned the Jumbo Potatoes to S'jirra. She was overjoyed and rewarded me with her first batch of Famous Potato Bread.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SQ04_STAGE100_LOG0: I've returned the research notes to Lithnilian at the Imperial Bridge Inn. He generously rewarded me for my efforts.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS16B_STAGE70_LOG0: I've returned the sword to Laythe Wavrick, Herald to the Countess of Chorrol. In gratitude, he's rewarded me with the Escutcheon of Chorrol, an item only bestowed to the most honored of heroes. I should go speak to the Jemane brothers about what's happened.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS23_STAGE110_LOG0: I've returned to Roland's cabin and told him what had transpired. He thanked me for clearing his name, and vowed to take Seridur's place to continue the Order of the Virtuous Blood. He said I should meet him there for a reward.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS23_STAGE200_LOG0: I've returned to Seridur's home, which the Order still uses to meet. Roland was there, and he told me I was now an honorary member of their group. He also bestowed an enchanted ring on me to help me in my future encounters with vampires.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_FGD08Infiltration_STAGE80_LOG0: I've returned to Water's Edge to a gruesome sight. Biene Amelion's father stands over the corpses of his daughter and the rest of the settlement. There are corpses all around--not goblin corpses as it had appeared in my Hist Sap-clouded mind, but human corpses. The Blackwood Company and I slaughtered the entire population of Water's Edge. I must return to Oreyn immediately.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS08_STAGE80_LOG0: I've returned to find Kurdan himself standing over the corpse of Aleron, whom he'd murdered. I had no choice but to attack and slay him. I should search Kurdan's corpse for anything that may help me get out of these ruins.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TG07Lex_STAGE50_LOG0: I've sealed the letter with the Legion Commander's seal. Now I must deliver it to Countess Umbranox personally. I will take on the role of courier.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TG09Arrow_STAGE27_LOG0: I've searched both chests in Fathis Aren's room. Neither had the Arrow of Extrication. I'm beginning to think it isn't here. This room doesn't seem to have enough wizardly stuff for a wizard of Fathis stature. I wonder if there is a secret chamber where he keeps his more valuable treasures?
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TG11Heist_STAGE85_LOG0: I've seated myself in the reading chair. Now I just have to wait for them to bring me the scroll. So long as I don't speak to any of them, the priests seem to be assuming I am Celia Camoran.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_FGC01Rats_STAGE80_LOG0: I've seen Quill-Weave leaving meat outside Arvena Thelas' house. This must be what is attracting the mountain lions into town and into Arvena's basement. I should confront Quill-Weave.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS09_STAGE70_LOG0: I've shown Arnora's Amulet to Jorundr. He revealed the location of the treasure as being buried outside the town wall.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS16B_STAGE100_LOG1: I've shown the reward given to me by Laythe Wavrick to Guilbert Jemane. He was saddened to hear that his father was actually a master thief, but was happy that the Honorblade was returned to Castle Chorrol where it belongs. He rewarded me with a personal keepsake as thanks for righting one of his family's past wrongs.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS09_STAGE50_LOG0: I've slain Arnora. I should take the amulet off her body and bring it to Jorundr.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS05_STAGE90_LOG0: I've slain Henantier in his sleep. His nightmares are now over.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SQ05_STAGE20_LOG0: I've slain Raelynn the Gravefinder. I should return to Malene at the Roxey Inn and deliver the good news.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS23_STAGE150_LOG0: I've slain Roland Jenseric. I should return to the Order and tell Seridur that my task is completed.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS23_STAGE100_LOG0: I've slain Seridur. I should return immediately to Roland's cabin and give him the news.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE07A_STAGE30_LOG0: I've slain Syl. I should now remove her heart.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS10_STAGE150_LOG0: I've slain Ulrich Leland. At my first opportunity, I should speak with Garrus Darelliun, his second-in-command.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SQ01_STAGE10_LOG0: I've slain an Ogre out in the wilderness. Oddly, it was carrying a bunch of Jumbo Potatoes. I should hang onto these, as they seem quite unusual.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS31_STAGE50_LOG0: I've slain yet another thief, this one a large Nord named Wrath. He was guarding the ship's wheel. He mentioned that they hijacked the Bloated Float to recover something called the "Golden Galleon". I should now get Graman and tell him that the path to the ship's wheel is safe.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE07B_STAGE30_LOG0: I've slipped an extra dose of Greenmote into Thadon's meal and Thadon's wine. I should proceed to the dining area at eight o'clock for the evening feast and watch the effect the Greenmote overdose has on Thadon.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MG10Vahtacen_STAGE40_LOG0: I've solved the puzzle of the pillar, opening up more of the ruins of Vahtacen.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MG04Restore_STAGE40_LOG0: I've spent the night at the Brina Cross Inn. I need to follow the Gold Road towards Kvatch, and be wary of anyone along the road.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE07_STAGE15_LOG0: I've spoken to Arctus, High Priest of Dementia. The Ritual of Accession for Dementia is simple; Syl would have to be slain by the proposed successor, and her heart brought to the Altar of Arden-Sul at the Sacellum. After I decide which ritual to undertake, I should return to Sheogorath and inform him of my choice.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE07_STAGE10_LOG0: I've spoken to Arctus, High Priest of Dementia. The Ritual of Accession for Dementia is simple; Syl would have to be slain by the proposed successor, and her heart brought to the Altar of Arden-Sul at the Sacellum. I should now speak to Dervenin to learn of Mania's ritual.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS09_STAGE15_LOG0: I've spoken to Arnora, but it sounds like she wants me to do something potentially illegal. I've told her I'm not interested. It sounded like she'd welcome me back if I changed my mind.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS11_STAGE20_LOG0: I've spoken to Carius Runellius, an investigator for the Bruma city watch, at the crime scene. He says that Raynil slipped into the house undetected and killed the vampire in its sleep around noon. The wife wasn't home, as she works during the day. Also, the body of an unidentified beggar has been found stashed in Bradon's house. I should question Bradon's wife if I want to investigate further.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS13_STAGE100_LOG0: I've spoken to Count Indarys. He was pleased that the Oblivion Gate outside his city was closed, and ecstatic that his son was still alive. To reward my actions, he presented me with a fine sword named Thornblade.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS13_STAGE105_LOG0: I've spoken to Count Indarys. He was pleased that the Oblivion Gate outside his city was closed, and ecstatic that his son was still alive. To reward my actions, he presented me with a fine weapon named the Staff of Indarys.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS13_STAGE110_LOG0: I've spoken to Count Indarys. He was pleased that the Oblivion Gate outside his city was closed, but heartbroken about his son's death. Still, he was generous enough to reward me in gold.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS13_STAGE115_LOG0: I've spoken to Count Indarys. He was pleased that the Oblivion Gate outside his city was closed, but heartbroken about his son's death. Still, he was generous enough to reward me with 200 gold. When I tried to present him with Farwil's signet ring, he relented and allowed me to keep it as a memento of my journey with Farwil.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE07_STAGE15_LOG1: I've spoken to Dervenin, High Priest of Mania. The Ritual of Accession for Mania requires the current ruler to commit suicide by taking three doses of Greenmote, which is lethal. Then his drug-tainted blood must be brought to the Altar of Arden-Sul at the Sacellum. After I decide which ritual to undertake, I should return to Sheogorath and inform him of my choice.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE07_STAGE10_LOG1: I've spoken to Dervenin, High Priest of Mania. The Ritual of Accession for Mania requires the current ruler to commit suicide by taking three doses of Greenmote, which is lethal. Then his drug-tainted blood must be brought to the Altar of Arden-Sul at the Sacellum. I should now speak to Arctus to learn of Dementia's ritual.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS05_STAGE20_LOG0: I've spoken to Kud-Ei of the Mage's Guild in Bravil. It seems that her friend, Henantier isn't missing after all, but trapped somewhere and Kud-Ei needs my help liberating him. Kud-Ei said to return to her when I'm ready and she'll take me to him.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS04_STAGE10_LOG0: I've spoken to Maelona, a Reguard commoner who lives in Anvil. It seems that a gang of female thieves has taken up residence somewhere nearby. They're luring men out to their farmhouse by seducing them, and then in actuality, robbing them of all their goods when they arrive. The men are so embarrassed about this that they won't report it to the authorities. Maelona's husband is one of the "victims".
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SQ08_STAGE20_LOG0: I've spoken to Nerussa, the publican at the Wawnet Inn just outside the Imperial City. She's searching for a rare wine named Shadowbanish Wine that she says is most commonly found in fort ruins. She tells me if I retrieve six bottles, I'll be well compensated. Looks like I'll need to keep a careful eye out.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_FGC02Protect_STAGE20_LOG0: I've spoken to Norbert Lelles, who says he has had break-ins at his store almost nightly. He would like someone to stay in the store tonight and catch the crooks in the act.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS11_STAGE50_LOG0: I've spoken to Olav at Olav's Tap and Tack. I was able to convince him to give me the key to Raynil's room. He told me that it was up the stairs and at the end of the hall. That should be my next destination.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_DEM01_STAGE60_LOG0: I've spoken to Ranaline about the Mythic Dawn notes. She mentioned a new base of operation of the Mythic Dawn in Mingo Cave.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE07_STAGE200_LOG0: I've spoken to Sheogorath and chosen the Ritual of Accession for Dementia.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE07_STAGE200_LOG1: I've spoken to Sheogorath and chosen the Ritual of Accession for Mania.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE41_STAGE5_LOG0: I've spoken to Sickly Bernice in New Sheoth. It seems she believes she is dying of some horrible malady, and only I can locate the cure. Strangely, she looks well to me, but she promises a reward for the cure's return. Perhaps I should hear her out.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS21_STAGE15_LOG0: I've spoken to a collector of Ayleid artifacts named Umbacano. He has offered to pay me handsomely for any Ayleid Ancestor statues that I bring him.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_NDPilgrim_STAGE10_LOG0: I've spoken to a mysterious Prophet, who told me that in order to seek the Relics of the Crusader, I must first do a pilgrimage to the Wayshrines of the Divines. He gave me a map of the Pilgrim's Way to help me locate the shrines. Once I have visited a wayshrine for each of the Nine Divines, I may receive a vision if I am judged a worthy knight.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS51_STAGE150_LOG0: I've spoken to the Countess about Chanel's crime, and she's been banished from the Castle. However, since the investigation didn't go smoothly, the Countess wasn't pleased and only rewarded me with some gold.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS51_STAGE100_LOG0: I've spoken to the Countess about Chanel's crime. She's been banished from the Castle, and as a reward, a sizable bounty of gold and gems has been given to me.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_NDPilgrim_STAGE9_LOG0: I've spoken to the Prophet outside Anvil Chapel. He claims that an ancient Ayleid sorceror-king has returned from beyond the grave to destroy the church, and that only a true knight wearing the legendary Crusader's Relics can possibly defeat him. I should speak to him further to find out how to find these lost Relics.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE45_STAGE20_LOG0: I've spoken to the beggar Bolwing. He tells me that the Fork of Horripilation is being fought over by groups of Heretics and Zealots. I'll have to get it from them.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_FGC05Stone_STAGE20_LOG0: I've spoken to the priest Cirroc in Bruma. He would like me to retrieve a holy relic of the Church, the Stone of St. Alessia. He believes it was stolen by bandits recently, and he's heard that they were headed east out of town.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS47_STAGE20_LOG0: I've spoken with Diram Serethi of Aleswell, though I haven't actually seen him. He's explained that all of the residents are invisible; he suspects a wizard named Ancotar is to blame. I should look for Ancotar in the ruins of Fort Caractacus.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE11_STAGE35_LOG0: I've spoken with Dyus about the staff of Sheogorath. He is the remnant of the library that Haskill spoke of.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MG03Illusion_STAGE40_LOG0: I've spoken with Erissare Arenim. She told me that Soris has the staff in the basement of their house.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_FGC06Courier_STAGE20_LOG0: I've spoken with Rienna, one of the fighters in the Desolate Mine. She tells me that the cave has been infested with goblins, and we should clear the place out before leaving. I will have to give them each weapons, though.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MG03Illusion_STAGE50_LOG0: I've spoken with Soris Arenim. He will not give back the staff, but will sell it for 200 gold. If I choose to buy it back, I need to pay him the money.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_FGD03Viranus_STAGE30_LOG0: I've spoken with Viranus Donton, and he is prepared accompany me to Nonwyll Cavern.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE11_STAGE100_LOG0: I've spoken with one of Ciirta's followers outside of the Howling Halls. She said that I should be safe inside so long as I wear the robes of the Apostles and do not take any suspicious action. If I can avoid confrontation, I might be able to make it to Ciirta without alerting all of them.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_DEM02_STAGE80_LOG0: I've spoken with the Harbinger. She taught me how to conjure her at any time, if I wish. I should try it and see what she can do.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_ND02_STAGE70_LOG0: I've spoken with the ghosts of the Knights of the Nine and learned where several parts of the Armor of the Crusader are hidden. I should return when I have collected them all.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE02_STAGE140_LOG1: I've squeezed the handkerchief full of the Sorceress' tears into a bottle. This may act as a poison to the Gatekeeper. I have a limited number of doses, so I will need to be careful using them.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE02_STAGE140_LOG5: I've squeezed the handkerchief full of the Sorceress' tears into a bottle. This may act as a poison to the Gatekeeper. I have a limited number of doses, so I will need to be careful using them. I can also find Jayred to get the arrows made from dead Gatekeeper bones, once he is done making them.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE02_STAGE140_LOG4: I've squeezed the handkerchief full of the Sorceress' tears into a bottle. This may act as a poison to the Gatekeeper. I have a limited number of doses, so I will need to be careful using them. I can also follow Jayred to the Gardens of Flesh and Bone.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE02_STAGE140_LOG2: I've squeezed the handkerchief full of the Sorceress' tears into a bottle. This may act as a poison to the Gatekeeper. I have a limited number of doses, so I will need to be careful using them. I can also talk to Jayred about killing the Gatekeeper.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE02_STAGE140_LOG6: I've squeezed the handkerchief full of the Sorceress' tears into a bottle. This may act as a poison to the Gatekeeper. I have a limited number of doses, so I will need to be careful using them. Jayred is still willing to come fight the Gatekeeper with me.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE02_STAGE140_LOG3: I've squeezed the handkerchief full of the Sorceress' tears into a bottle. This may act as a poison to the Gatekeeper. I have a limited number of doses, so I will need to be careful using them.. I can also tell Jayred I'm ready to go to the Gardens of Flesh and Bone.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS23_STAGE82_LOG0: I've stayed my hand, and will let Roland live for now.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS13_STAGE15_LOG0: I've stepped through the Oblivion Gate outside of Cheydinhal and now find myself in the dreaded plane of Oblivion itself. I should proceed carefully, as unknown dangers await me here.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS13_STAGE45_LOG0: I've stepped through the Oblivion Gate outside of Cheydinhal and now find myself in the dreaded plane of Oblivion itself. My only chance to destroy the gate and return home would be obtaining the Sigil Stone in this plane's citadel. I should make my way there now.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MG05A_STAGE25_LOG0: I've stolen the "Fingers of the Mountain" book from Earana's room in the Grey Mare. I need to find Teekeeus, and deliver it to him.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MG05A_STAGE20_LOG0: I've stolen the "Fingers of the Mountain" book from the Chorrol Mages Guild. I need to find Earana, and deliver it to her.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MG03Illusion_STAGE90_LOG0: I've stolen the staff from Soris Arenim's house. I need to deliver it to Kud-Ei in Bravil.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE08_STAGE80_LOG1: I've survived the collapsing ruins of Xeddefen. I should seek out Aurig Desha and ask her how the battle above ground went.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE08_STAGE80_LOG0: I've survived the collapsing ruins of Xeddefen. I should seek out Grakendo Udico and ask her how the battle above ground went.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE04_STAGE40_LOG0: I've taken Felldew in order to enter Dunroot Burrow. I shall have to be careful as I proceed through the Burrow.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS47_STAGE30_LOG0: I've talked to Ancotar, who was unaware of the effect his magic had on the people of Aleswell. He's given me a scroll that should reverse the effects; I need to return to Aleswell to restore its residents.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE08_STAGE25_LOG2: I've talked to Aurig Desha about what has happened in Passwall. Order has been attacking the town non-stop. She's asked for my help in protecting the Passwall. I must place the Golden Saints in the best positions possible to prepare for the attack. When I am satisfied, I should speak to the Aurig.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE08_STAGE25_LOG3: I've talked to Aurig Desha about what has happened in Passwall. Order has been attacking the town non-stop. She's asked for my help in protecting the Passwall. I should provide what aid I can and speak to her when I'm ready.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE08_STAGE25_LOG0: I've talked to Grakendo Udico about what has happened in Passwall. Order has been attacking the town non-stop. She's asked for my help in protecting the Passwall. I must place the Dark Seducers in the best positions possible to prepare for the attack. When I am satisfied, I should speak to the Grekendo.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE08_STAGE25_LOG1: I've talked to Grakendo Udico about what has happened in Passwall. Order has been attacking the town non-stop. She's asked for my help in protecting the Passwall. I should provide what aid I can and speak to her when I'm ready.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_FGC01Rats_STAGE105_LOG0: I've told Arvena Thelas that the problem has been solved, and she has paid me for the contract. I should see Quill-Weave and tell her I've protected her secret.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_FGC01Rats_STAGE100_LOG0: I've told Arvena Thelas what Quill-Weave has been doing. She thanked me for my help, and has paid me for the contract. She's also taught me a bit about Speechcraft.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_FGC01Rats_STAGE60_LOG0: I've told Arvena about the mountain lions, but she doesn't believe her problem is solved, as there's a mountain lion in her basement now. I'll have to kill it.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_FGD02DandD_STAGE80_LOG0: I've told Dubok, Rellian, and Vantus about Margarte's need for ingredients. They've agreed to accept the long-term contract. As this should keep them out of trouble, I should report back to Oreyn.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MG14Plot_STAGE100_LOG0: I've told Hannibal Traven what J'skar saw at the Bruma Mages Guild hall.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_FGD05Oreyn_STAGE30_LOG0: I've told Oreyn that I will not accompany him in investigating how the Blackwood Company fulfilled the Azani Blackheart contract.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_FGD06DeadViranus_STAGE25_LOG0: I've told Oreyn that Viranus Donton is dead. He wants me to go back to Forsaken Mine and find proof of what happened.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MG11NecroMoon_STAGE100_LOG0: I've told Raminus Polus everything about Necromancers and black soul gems that I have seen
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS08_STAGE100_LOG0: I've told Ursanne about her husband's death. I said that he fought bravely and that his thoughts were with her before he died. She thanked me for my kind words and bestowed a book upon me that belonged to Aleron. I know that I did the best I could, but at least Aleron's death was avenged.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS51_STAGE200_LOG0: I've told the Countess that neither suspect is the criminal, and that the painting must be in the possession of someone outside the Castle walls. She seemed disappointed, but I've kept Chanel's honor intact.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE03A_STAGE15_LOG0: I've unleashed the Giant Gnarl on the adventurers in Xedilian. With the threat of what he perceived as certain death knocking at his door, Lewin the Rogue has gone insane. I should make my way to the next observation room and choose how the adventurers will encounter their next obstacle.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE03A_STAGE15_LOG1: I've unleashed the Gnarl Swarm on the adventurers in Xedilian. Unable to survive their onslaught, Lewin the Rogue has been slain. I should make my way to the next observation room and choose how the adventurers will encounter their next obstacle.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TG11Heist_STAGE73_LOG0: I've used the Arrow of Extrication to activate the door and open the secret way into the palace. There is no telling where I might end up. I should take care to extinguish my lights, muffle my footsteps, and be stealthy as I enter the door.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS47_STAGE50_LOG0: I've used the scroll Ancotar gave me, and the people of Aleswell are once again visible. Diram Serethi would probably like to congratulate me on my success.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS43_STAGE40_LOG0: I've willingly accepted the staff from Rosentia. The scamps are now under my escort. I should hasten to Darkfathom Cave and be rid of these annoying creatures.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MG11NecroMoon_STAGE60_LOG1: I've witnessed Necromancers creating Black Soul Gems at the Dark Fissure cave. I need to get this information to Raminus Polus.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE12_STAGE30_LOG1: I've witnessed a gnarl removing the Order crystals that were poisoning a door here in the Fountainhead. It seems that the tame gnarls here can halt the spread of Order throughout the dungeon. I may be able to use their help as I work my way to the Pools of Mania and Dementia.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS08_STAGE65_LOG0: If Aleron and I are to survive, I need to proceed down into the Hunter's Run and defeat the hunters being sent after us. According to the "rules", one of them will have the key to unlock the door Kurdan sealed behind us. Since Aleron is in no condition to fight, I'll have to seek these hunters out myself.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TrainingSecurity_STAGE20_LOG0: If I want J'baana to train me, I need to travel to Bravil and fetch a message from S'krivva.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TrainingMysticism_STAGE10_LOG0: If I want further Mysticism training, I need to visit Dagail at the Mages Guild in Leyawiin.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TrainingBlock_STAGE10_LOG0: If I want more training to improve my Block skill, I need to find Andragil, who lives in Bravil.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TrainingAthletics_STAGE10_LOG0: If I want to learn more about Athletics, I should find Rusia Bradus in Anvil.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TrainingSpeechcraft_STAGE10_LOG0: If I want to learn more about Speechcraft, I need to seek out Tandilwe at the Temple of the One in the Imperial City.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_ArenaDialogue_STAGE10_LOG0: If I wish to join the Arena faction as a combatant, I must speak with Owyn the Blademaster in the Arena Bloodworks.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TrainingRestoration_STAGE10_LOG0: If I wish to train further in Restoration, I must find Oleta at the Chapel of Akatosh in Kvatch.

ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_DEAk02_STAGE100_LOG0: Ilav made me a Paladin of his order and will be willingly giving me any armor or weapon from their chantry at any time! I should speak to Snak Gra-Bura at the Chestnut Handy Stables about crafting a matching set of horse armor.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_DEAk02_STAGE10_LOG0: Ilav mentioned a Time Wound. I do not know much about it, but it is apparently being opened by an Elder Scroll. I must retrieve it at all costs.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_DEAk02_STAGE20_LOG0: Ilav's blessing allowed me to go past the magic that blocked me. Time to face whoever is messing with Time itself.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS48_STAGE20_LOG1: Ilend Vonius, one of the Kvatch Guardsmen who entered the Oblivion Gate to try to close it, told me that at least one other survivor of the assault on the Gate has been taken to the large tower within Oblivion. I should search for him there.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS22_STAGE15_LOG0: In "The Cleansing of the High Fane", the High Fane is identified as the ruin now known as Malada, in the Valus Mountains. I should proceed to Malada and look for the carved panel that Umbacano wants.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS10_STAGE90_LOG0: In Ulrich's quarters, I've discovered a letter he wrote to some relatives outside of Cyrodiil. In it, he talks about sending them a great deal of money and goods he purchased using the illicit funds. This is the evidence Garrus would need. I should take it to him.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_ND08_STAGE55_LOG0: In attempting to use the defiled Sword of the Crusader, I have received a terrible curse. I can only hope that this curse will be lifted when I reconsecrate the Sword at the Chapel of Arkay in Cheydinhal.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MQ01_STAGE110_LOG0:
In each attempt to persuade, you must <RT_BlueMed>Admire, Boast, Joke</>, and <RT_BlueMed>Coerce</>.

ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MQ01_STAGE64_LOG0_1: In order to <RT_BlueMed>create potions or poisons</>, you'll need ingredients that share similar effects.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_FG00Expulsion_STAGE20_LOG0: In order to be accepted back into the Fighters Guild, I must collect twenty bear pelts and return them to Vilena Donton in Chorrol.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_ND03_STAGE20_LOG0: In order to be granted the Boots of the Crusader, I must travel to a sacred grove in the Great Forest and be tested by Kynareth.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_FGD03Viranus_STAGE20_LOG0: In order to boost the young Donton's confidence, I'm to help Viranus discover what became of Galtus Previa in Nonwyll Cavern, northwest of Chorrol.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TrainingSneak_STAGE20_LOG0: In order to get Marana Rian to train me, I must steal a coin from her pocket without her noticing, and return it to her.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MG01Destruct_STAGE10_LOG0: In order to get a recommendation from Adrienne Berene, I need to find Erthor and return him to the Skingrad Mages Guild. I should speak with the other guild mages to learn his whereabouts.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MGExpulsion01_STAGE15_LOG0: In order to regain favor with the Mages Guild, I must bring 20 Nightshade and 20 Mandrake Root to Raminus Polus at the Arcane University.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MGExpulsion02_STAGE15_LOG0: In order to regain favor with the Mages Guild, I must bring 20 Nightshade and 20 Mandrake Root to Raminus Polus at the Arcane University.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MGExpulsion01_STAGE25_LOG0: In order to regain favor with the guild, I must bring 20 Dragon's Tongue and 20 Redwort Flower to Raminus Polus at the Arcane University.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MGExpulsion02_STAGE25_LOG0: In order to regain favor with the guild, I must bring 20 Dragon's Tongue and 20 Redwort Flower to Raminus Polus at the Arcane University.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MGExpulsion01_STAGE35_LOG0: In order to regain favor with the guild, I must gather 20 Vampire Dust and 20 Daedra Hearts and deliver them to Raminus Polus at the Arcane University.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MGExpulsion02_STAGE35_LOG0: In order to regain favor with the guild, I must gather 20 Vampire Dust and 20 Daedra Hearts and deliver them to Raminus Polus at the Arcane University.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE11_STAGE50_LOG0: In order to remake the Staff of Sheogorath, Dyus requires two items. I must seek out the Eye of Ciirta and a Branch of the Tree of Shades. The first is an eye that has seen something that no other has. I can acquire this item from a woman named Ciirta in the Howling Halls. The second item is a branch of the Tree of Shades, an ancient tree that grows in the Grove of Reflection in the ruins of Milchar.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TrainingConjuration_STAGE10_LOG0: In order to train further in Conjuration, I must find Olyn Seran, a Daedra Worshipper somewhere in the Great Forest.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS37_STAGE85_LOG0: In the center of Frostfire Glade, I've discovered an astonishing sight. Garridan himself locked in an eternal frozen struggle with a huge Frost Atronach. It appears that Garridan had dropped his weapon and was using the Ewer to protect himself. The Atronach smashed the Ewer, which must have reacted with the magical waters and froze everything solid. A sad end for such a noble knight.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS06_STAGE60_LOG0: In the wreck of the Emma May, a spirit attacked me. The vessel seems completely infested with them. I suspect them to be the remains of the Emma May's crew. Why this happened to them puzzles me. I should press forward and investigate further.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MQ01_STAGE20_LOG1_1: In your <RT_BlueMed>journal</>, you can see your character attributes, equip objects, choose spells and consult your map and quests.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MQ01_STAGE76_LOG1_1: In your journal, select an item or spell and press <IA id="IA_Game_QuickKeys_OpenMenu"/> to select a slot, then use your mouse to <RT_BlueMed>equip</> your choice.
