ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_HouseSkingradQuest_STAGE100_LOG0: Inside a battered hourglass, I've discovered a ring and several precious gems. This must be the treasure of Rosethorn Hall.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_FGC10Swamp_STAGE40_LOG0: Inside the Swampy Cave, I've found the corpses of the townsfolk that are missing. It looks like trolls have been feeding on the people weakened by the will-o-the-wisps. I should make sure to clear out all the remaining trolls from the cave complex.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_FGC10Swamp_STAGE40_LOG1: Inside the Swampy Cave, I've found the corpses of the townsfolk that are missing. It looks like trolls have been feeding on the people weakened by the will-o-the-wisps. I should report this to Drarana Thelis.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TrainingBlunt_STAGE200_LOG0: Irene Metric is dead. My opportunity to learn more from her about Blunt Weapons has ended.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TrainingBlunt_STAGE100_LOG0: Irene Metrick has agreed to help train me in the use of Blunt weapons.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TrainingBlunt_STAGE20_LOG0: Irene Metrick has told me I need to kill more people before she'll consider helping me train.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_FGD07Kidnap_STAGE45_LOG0: It appears Ajum-Kajin may be ready to give me information.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS48_STAGE90_LOG0: It is now safe for the survivors of the attack on Kvatch to leave the Chapel for safety in the camp south of the city. Savlian has asked me to help him further. I should let him know when I am ready.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_FGD07Kidnap_STAGE55_LOG0: It looks like Ajum-Kajin is ready to tell me more. I should question him.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TG01BloodPrice_STAGE15_LOG0: It may have been a mistake to kill Rohssan. I seem to recall Armand telling me that I couldn't kill anyone while retrieving his sword. I'll have to pay him a fine to get back into the guild. Unfortunately, he will only talk to me after midnight in the Garden of Dareloth.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TG01BloodPrice_STAGE10_LOG0: It may have been a mistake to kill one of the Allectus. I seem to recall Armand telling me that I couldn't kill anyone while retrieving his diary. I'll have to pay Armand a hefty fine. Unfortunately, he will only talk to me after midnight in the Garden of Dareloth.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TG04Mistake_STAGE50_LOG0: It seems that Alessia Caro wears the ring all the time, which is going to make is really difficult to steal it from her. However, I learned that she always takes it off at night. I'll have to sneak into her bedroom at night and rifle through that jewelry box.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS91_STAGE2_LOG0: It seems that Count Marius Caro is concerned about an Orc named Mazoga at Castle Leyawiin. This Orc claims she is a knight. Perhaps Marius Caro would welcome my aid in finding out more about her.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE32_STAGE40_LOG0: It seems that Desideratus "betrothed" is actually a child's doll. I'll have to think of some way to keep him from obessing about the doll.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TG06Atonement_STAGE25_LOG0: It seems that the butler, Shum gro-Yarug, is hiring up at Castle Skingrad. Penetrating the castle would be much easier if I had that job.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_FGC10Swamp_STAGE30_LOG0: It seems that the strange lights people were seeing over the swamp are will-o-the-wisps. But, there don't seem to be any signs of the townsfolk who disappeared. The Will-o-the-wisps were surrounding a cave, though. I should investigate.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TG04Mistake_STAGE48_LOG0: It seems there is a secret passage that leads from the basement to the Countess' private chambers. If I can find it, that passage might be a safer way to sneak into her room.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE07B_STAGE10_LOG0: It was suggested that I speak to Thadon's steward, Wide-Eye. I was told I could find her in the House of Mania or elsewhere in New Sheoth.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_DLC06ThievesDen_STAGE11_LOG0: It would appear that there is a cave that leads under Castle Anvil, it might be worth a look.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS10_STAGE97_LOG0: It's been about two hours, and Garrus Darelliun should be meeting me at the Cheydinhal Bridge Inn.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS51_STAGE220_LOG0: It's been three weeks. I should return to Castle Chorrol and pick up my painting from Chanel.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_Dark12Harem_STAGE20_LOG0: J'Ghasta is dead. I must pick up my reward and next contract at the dead drop located in the rotten box under the Old Bridge, just south of the Imperial City.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TrainingSecurity_STAGE100_LOG0: J'baana has agreed to help with my Security training.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TrainingSecurity_STAGE200_LOG0: J'baana is dead. There is no way I can be taught more about Security skills now.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TrainingLightArmor_STAGE100_LOG0: J'bari has agreed to help with my Light Armor training.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TrainingLightArmor_STAGE200_LOG0: J'bari is dead. I have lost my opportunity to learn more about Light Armor.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MG14Plot_STAGE60_LOG0: J'skar is the only survivor of the slaughter at the Mages Guild Hall in Bruma. He's given me information about the King of Worms. Hannibal Traven should be told immediately; I should return to the Imperial City.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE46_STAGE40_LOG0: J'zidzo living on the Dementia side of Split is dead.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE46_STAGE40_LOG1: J'zidzo living on the Mania side of Split is dead.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE46_STAGE30_LOG0: Jastira Nanus living on the Dementia side of Split is dead.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE46_STAGE30_LOG1: Jastira Nanus living on the Mania side of Split is dead.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MQ11_STAGE10_LOG0: Jauffre is worried that the Bruma Guard will not be able to defend Bruma from a full-scale attack by the Mythic Dawn and their daedric allies. He suggested that I try to obtain support from the other cities of Cyrodiil. Perhaps I can persuade the Elder Council in the Imperial City to help as well.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MQ13_STAGE5_LOG0: Jauffre said that Martin has completely deciphered the ritual in the Mysterium Xarxes. I should speak to Martin immediately.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MQ10_STAGE20_LOG0: Jauffre told me that an Oblivion Gate has opened near Bruma, and the Countess has asked for the Blades to help her guardsmen close it. I should find Captain Burd outside the city walls and help him close the Gate.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MQ07_STAGE20_LOG0: Jauffre told me that strangers have been sighted near Cloud Ruler Temple. He suspects they are Mythic Dawn spies based out of Bruma. He suggested that Captain Burd of the Bruma Guard might know of any strangers in town. Steffan of the Blades can tell me where he has seen the suspected spies.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MQ09_STAGE20_LOG0: Jauffre told me that the Armor of Tiber Septim, a holy relic of the Blades, is contained in a shrine in the catacombs of Sancre Tor. It is said to be splashed with Tiber Septim's blood. Jauffre warned me that the catacombs have become very dangerous, but neither he nor Martin can think of any other way to obtain the blood of a divine.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MQ03_STAGE10_LOG0: Jauffre told me that the Emperor has an illegitimate son named Martin who is currently serving as a priest in the Chapel of Akatosh in the city of Kvatch. I must proceed to Kvatch at once and bring Martin safely back to Weynon Priory.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MQ03_STAGE10_LOG2: Jauffre told me that the Emperor has an illegitimate son named Martin who is currently serving as a priest in the Chapel of Akatosh in the city of Kvatch. I realized that Martin was among the survivors I helped rescue from Kvatch. I must return to Kvatch at once and bring him safely back to Weynon Priory.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MQ03_STAGE10_LOG1: Jauffre told me that the Emperor has an illegitimate son named Martin who is currently serving as a priest in the Chapel of Akatosh in the city of Kvatch. Jauffre fears that the attack on Kvatch was part of the enemy's plan to eliminate all the Septim heirs. I must return to Kvatch at once, find Martin, and bring him safely back to Weynon Priory.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MQ07_STAGE85_LOG0: Jauffre told me to make sure that all the Mythic Dawn agents were dead. The document I found spoke of two agents. I must track down and kill both of them.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MQ05_STAGE20_LOG0: Jauffre wants me to contact Baurus at Luther Broad's Boarding House in the Imperial City. The enemy has the Amulet of Kings, and Baurus may have the leads we need to get it back.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MQ07_STAGE90_LOG0: Jauffre was pleased that I eliminated the spies in Bruma, but is worried that the Mythic Dawn have already learned that Martin is at Cloud Ruler Temple. He promised to warn the Countess that Bruma is in grave danger.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MQ10_STAGE60_LOG0: Jauffre was pleased to hear of my success helping the Bruma Guard close the Oblivion Gate.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE02_STAGE80_LOG1: Jayred has collected bone fragments from a skeleton of what appears to be another Gatekeeper. I should see Jayred in a few hours retrieve the arrows made from these fragments.

ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MG06Bruma_STAGE100_LOG0: Jeanne Frasoric has agreed to send a recommendation to Raminus Polus.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MG06Bruma_STAGE10_LOG0: Jeanne Frasoric has tasked me with finding J'skar. I should speak with the guild mages in Bruma.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MG14Plot_STAGE50_LOG0: Jeanne Frasoric is dead. I should look for other survivors.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS29_STAGE150_LOG0: Jensine awarded me a bounty of gold on behalf of the Society of Concerned Merchants for restoring the economy of the Market District to its rightful place.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS26_STAGE60_LOG0: Jensine refuses to testify against Audens Avidius. I don't think I can persuade her. I'll have to try the other two, Luronk and Ruslan.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS17_STAGE10_LOG0: Jirolin Doran of Chorrol believes that ogres are somehow distantly related to his family line. As such, he's asked me to take an offering of gems and gold to Spy Rock in an effort to establish communications with the ogres.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS17_STAGE40_LOG0: Jirolin Doran took it upon himself to check back at Spy Rock; I should head there and find him.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS17_STAGE50_LOG0: Jirolin is not at Spy Rock. He left a note stating the ogres were escorting him to their home at Rock Bottom Caverns. I should go there and find him.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS17_STAGE100_LOG0: Jirolin thanked me for saving him from the ogres, and gave me some of his offering to the ogres as a reward.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS17_STAGE80_LOG0: Jirolin will head back to Chorrol on his own. I can either head there myself, or go back into Rock Bottom Caverns to raid the stores of treasure the ogres have collected.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS45_STAGE55_LOG1: Jiv Hiriel suggested that the trapdoor in Moslin's Inn offers the best way into the caverns, as it is nearest where Dar-Ma is being held prisoner. I should sneak into the caverns and try to find her.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS45_STAGE55_LOG0: Jiv Hiriel told me that Dar-Ma is being held in caverns beneath the town, apparently for some kind of ritual sacrifice. He gave me a key that will open the trapdoors in any of the houses. The villagers gather for worship in the caverns every night, so that will be the best time to slip into the caverns unnoticed and rescue Dar-Ma.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS45_STAGE50_LOG0: Jiv Hiriel, one of the Hackdirt villagers, seems to know something about Dar-Ma. He was afraid to talk openly, but asked me to meet him in his house tonight after dark.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS09_STAGE40_LOG0: Jorundr had a completely different take on what happened with Arnora. He says she turned him in, hoping to get the gold for herself, but he had moved it. He's furious and wants revenge. Jorundr then offered to give me all of the gold if I kill her. All I have to do is show him her amulet.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS09_STAGE30_LOG0: Jorundr refused to speak to me. He said that he doesn't talk to "outsiders". I think he's referring to the fact that I'm not a prisoner. Sounds like the only way to get him to talk is by getting arrested.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MG19Alchemy_STAGE100_LOG0: Julienne Fanis has told me there is a special chest in the Arch Mage's quarters. Once a week, I may place an ingredient inside, and return a day later to find that ingredient replicated for my use. If I take too long in returning to the chest, however, I will lose whatever was placed inside.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS37_STAGE30_LOG0: Julienne Fanis referred me to a book, "Knightfall", available at the First Edition bookshop in the Market District if I wanted to learn more about the possible location of Garridan's Tears.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE12_STAGE50_LOG0: Just as Haskill suspected, Jyggalag's priests are poisoning the roots of the Tree of Madness. I have cleansed one of the minor pools, but I must find the Pools of Mania and Dementia in order to save the Tree.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_Dark02Watery_STAGE25_LOG0: Just as expected, the crate I hid in has been transported to the ship's hold. I must now find and kill the Captain, Gaston Tussaud. He's probably in his cabin, at the rear of the ship, on a higher deck.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE14_STAGE5_LOG0: Jyggalag has spoken to me and told me the Greymarch is ended and the forces of Order have retreated. Haskill will likely know how I should proceed.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MG07Leyawiin_STAGE30_LOG0: Kalthar seemed to know a great deal about the missing amulet. I should tell Agata what he has told me.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE06_STAGE170_LOG0: Kaneh sacrificed herself on the Altar of Despair in order to light the Flame of Agnon. I can now retrieve the Flame from the courtyard and bring it back to New Sheoth as Sheogorath commanded.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE06_STAGE150_LOG0: Kaneh thanked me for my help in securing Cylarne for the Golden Saints. She is now heading for the Altar of Despair, where she says she will "sacrifice herself" to kindle the Flame of Agnon. I should accompany her and see what happens.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE06_STAGE124_LOG0: Kaneh wants me to open a gate that is blocking the progress of the Golden Saints' attack. She and her troops will hold their position until I find a way to open the gate.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MQ15_STAGE42_LOG0: Kathutet was angry at me for killing the Xivilai. I will have to take the Bands of the Chosen from him by force.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_ND06_STAGE30_LOG0: Kellen told me that his family has been cursed for generations, and that he has come to the Chapel of Stendarr to be freed of this curse. I should speak with Areldur.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE03A_STAGE55_LOG0: Kiliban Nyrandil has told me to meet him in Xedilian's reception chamber where I can recover the defeated adventurer's gear. I should use the final transport pad and make my way there now.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE03A_STAGE200_LOG0: Kiliban explained the identity of the strange beings, calling them Knights of Order. He seemed very dismayed and wishes me to hasten to Sheogorath and report their presence.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE39_STAGE220_LOG0: Kishashi is dead. I'll never be able to earn her trust now. Ranarr-Jo will just have to deal with things on his own.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE05_STAGE15_LOG0: Kithlan has told me that Lady Syl is especially reclusive lately. I may be able to catch her in the garden late around midnight.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE04_STAGE30_LOG0: Kithlan has told me that the Chalice of Reversal is locked away in Dunroot Burrow. I'll need to ingest Felldew to enter the Burrow, and pass through to reach the tower.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS37_STAGE50_LOG0: Knightfall tells the tale of Garridan and the quest for the Everflow Ewer at a place known as Frostfire Glade. It is supposedly located in the mountains near Bruma. Using some of the references from the story, I was able to pinpoint it on my map. The book also mentions needing special refined frost salts to get into the Glade. I should speak to Julienne Fanis about this.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS05_STAGE30_LOG0: Kud-Ei has explained that Henantier has become the victim of his own creation, the Dreamworld Amulet. He's trapped inside his own dreams, and I'll need to put on the amulet and go to sleep to enter Henantier's dreams and hopefully retrieve him. When I'm ready to do this, I should speak to Kud-Ei, who will prepare me for the journey.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS05_STAGE40_LOG0: Kud-Ei has given me Henantier's Dreamworld Amulet. I need to enter his dream by going to sleep while wearing the amulet. Kud-Ei also warned me that if Henantier is slain in the Dreamworld while I'm there, I'd be killed as well, so I must be careful.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MG03Illusion_STAGE30_LOG0: Kud-Ei has given me several more scrolls, and asked me to get the staff back. I need to find Soris Arenim in the Imperial City.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS08_STAGE30_LOG0: Kurdan gro-Dragol has told me that he knows the location of Aleron Loche, and if I want him to reveal it to me, I'll have to retrieve an axe that belonged to his father and was lost on Fort Grief Island some time ago. If I don't bring the axe back, he says that Aleron will die. When I'm ready, I need to speak to Kurdan who will provide a boat for me.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS08_STAGE40_LOG0: Kurdan gro-Dragol told me that the boat is waiting for me at the dock next to the magic shop here in Bravil. I should get underway soon, as I wish to find out what's happened to Aleron.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_DAMalacath_STAGE34_LOG0: Lady Drad has told me that the ogres are located in Bleak Mine, not far from here. I will have to go free them to appease Malacath.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE05_STAGE130_LOG0: Lady Syl has asked me to meet her in the torture chamber. I should travel there immediately.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_ND07_STAGE20_LOG2: Lathon, the young squire of Sir Roderic, arrived at the Priory with a tragic tale. It seems that his master perished while attempting to defeat the dreadful undead guardian of the Sword of the Crusader. Lathon was able to escape with the Greaves of the Crusader, which he surrendered to me. I have made him a Knight, and asked him to accompany me to Underpall Cave where Sir Roderic fell. We will avenge his former master and reclaim the Sword of the Crusader for the Nine.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_ND07_STAGE20_LOG1: Lathon, the young squire of Sir Roderic, arrived at the Priory with a tragic tale. It seems that his master perished while attempting to defeat the dreadful undead guardian of the Sword of the Crusader. Lathon was able to escape with the Greaves of the Crusader, which he surrendered to me. I need to go to Underpall Cave where Sir Roderic fell, and reclaim the Sword of the Crusader for the Nine.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS51_STAGE20_LOG4: Laythe Wavrick, the castle herald, told me that he's observed Orgnolf having a drinking problem and often asking for money to fund his new habit. I should continue questioning the suspects the Countess recommended.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS51_STAGE22_LOG4: Laythe Wavrick, the castle herald, told me that he's observed Orgnolf having a drinking problem and often asking for money to fund his new habit. I should continue questioning the suspects the Countess recommended.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS51_STAGE30_LOG4: Laythe Wavrick, the castle herald, told me that he's observed Orgnolf having a drinking problem and often asking for money to fund his new habit. I should continue questioning the suspects the Countess recommended.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS51_STAGE32_LOG4: Laythe Wavrick, the castle herald, told me that he's observed Orgnolf having a drinking problem and often asking for money to fund his new habit. I should continue questioning the suspects the Countess recommended.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS51_STAGE35_LOG4: Laythe Wavrick, the castle herald, told me that he's observed Orgnolf having a drinking problem and often asking for money to fund his new habit. I've spoken to all of the possible suspects and witnesses. Now, I should concentrate on gathering the clues if I'm to solve the crime.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SQ02_STAGE100_LOG0: Lerexus Callidus has rewarded me for putting a stop to the drug traffickers in Greyland Settlement.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS10_STAGE20_LOG0: Llevana Nedaren told me about the plight of a good friend of hers, Aldos Othran. She explained how he was evicted from his home for non-payment of fines and expressed her hatred of Ulrich. She mentioned that Ulrich's second in command, Garrus Darelliun, seemed sympathetic to the people's plight. I should speak to Garrus next about this matter.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS10_STAGE60_LOG0: Llevana was furious after I told her of Aldos's fate. She wants me to go speak to Ulrich and somehow convince him to follow me back to her house, where she would "take care of him." This doesn't sound like the best method to deal with Ulrich. I think I should speak to Garrus first then decide how to handle this situation.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_FGC09Ogres_STAGE20_LOG0: Lord Rugdumph tells me that his daughter was out picking rocks, and he fears she may have been taken away by a band of ogres that are known to live east of the estate. I am to find and return her.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TGDirections_STAGE30_LOG0: Luciana Galena is the fence in Bravil. The beggar told me she lives by the arena. I should go to her if I have any stolen property to sell.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_Dark17Following_STAGE40_LOG0: Lucien Lachance is dead, killed by the surviving members of the Black Hand, who don't even realize the real traitor is still among them!  They have advanced me to Speaker, in Lachance's place. Between the hours of midnight and 3:00 AM, I must speak with Arquen about the Night Mother, and all of the Black Hand -- including me -- will be teleported to the Night Mother's resting place, for some ancient ritual. I must do as Arquen says, so that I might expose the traitor...
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_Dark01Knife_STAGE115_LOG0: Lucien Lachance, the Dark Brotherhood's representative, has been killed. He was my link to the mysterious assassins guild, and now that link has been severed... forever.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS26_STAGE75_LOG0: Luronk gro-Glurzog has agreed to testify against Audens Avidius in the morning. Now I just have to get Ruslan to testify as well.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE05_STAGE80_LOG0: Ma'zaddha admitted to being involved in a plot to kill Lady Syl. He's asked for time to learn more about who's behind it. I should meet him at his house in one day's time. In the meantime, I should investigate Nelrene's role in this.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE05_STAGE55_LOG0: Ma'zaddha refuses to give me any information. I need evidence that he's involved; I should speak to the citizens of Crucible to learn more.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS04_STAGE110_LOG0: Maelona and Gogan entered the farmhouse in Anvil City Guard armor. It turns out that they have been undercover as a married couple for some time trying to put a stop to the gang. She says I was spotted heading to Gweden so she went back for reinforcements and headed here. She has taken Faustina into custody and paid me the gold she promised.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS04_STAGE100_LOG0: Maelona and Gogan entered the farmhouse in Anvil City Guard armor. It turns out that they have been undercover as a married couple for some time trying to put a stop to the gang. She says I was spotted heading to Gweden so she went back for reinforcements and headed here. She said she would take care of the bodies, and paid me my gold as promised.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS04_STAGE30_LOG0: Maelona told me that the men are usually approached at the local watering hole, The Flowing Bowl. That's where I should make contact with the gang. I should speak to Gogan, as he may be able to add some more useful information.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MQ01_STAGE73_LOG0_1: Magicka returns slowly on its own. You can restore it more quickly by drinking potions or sleeping.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_FGC03Thieves_STAGE30_LOG0: Maglir and I have succeeded in clearing Hrota Cave of all of the thieves living there. I should return to Azzan for payment of the contract.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_FGD01Default_STAGE60_LOG0: Maglir has told me that he doesn't care whether or not Modryn Oreyn knows that he did not complete the contract.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_FGD04Defector_STAGE35_LOG1: Maglir tells me I should speak with Aryarie at the Mage's Guild if I want to finish the Guild contract.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_FGD01Default_STAGE40_LOG0: Maglir tells me his contract was to find the scholar Brenus Astis' journal within Fallen Rock Cave. He doesn't believe he's being paid well enough for the dangerous assignment, so he has chosen not to complete it. He has told me I should complete the contract instead.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_FGD04Defector_STAGE30_LOG0: Maglir tells me that he is no longer a member of the Fighters Guild. He is tired of trying to scrounge up work, so he has joined the Blackwood Company.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MQ01_STAGE74_LOG0_1: Make sure opponents don't <RT_BlueMed>deplete</> your Fatigue or you'll be <RT_BlueMed>staggered</> or <RT_BlueMed>knocked down</>.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_DAMalacath_STAGE200_LOG0: Malacath wanted his ogres freed... not killed. Now there's no chance of earning the reward he promised.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_DAMalacath_STAGE100_LOG0: Malacath was satisfied with my efforts to free the ogres. He has rewarded me with Volendrung.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SQ05_STAGE10_LOG0: Malene at the Roxey Inn in the wilderness north of the Imperial City has asked me to help her rid the area of a Necromancer who calls herself Raelynn the Gravefinder. Raelynn can be found in Moss Rock Cavern to the north.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SQ05_STAGE100_LOG0: Malene was delighted with the news of Raelynn the Gravefinder's death, and rewarded me with some coin.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MQ06_STAGE50_LOG1: Mankar Camoran escaped to his realm of Paradise with the Amulet of Kings, and closed his magical portal behind him. But I have the Mysterium Xarxes, the Mythic Dawn's book of secrets. Now I must escape this place and return to Cloud Ruler Temple.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MQ06_STAGE50_LOG2: Mankar Camoran escaped to his realm of Paradise with the Amulet of Kings, and closed his magical portal behind him. But the Mysterium Xarxes itself is here in the shrine. I must get the Mysterium Xarxes. It is my only hope of finding a way to recover the Amulet now.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TrainingSneak_STAGE100_LOG0: Marana Rian has agreed to train me in Sneaking.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TrainingSneak_STAGE200_LOG0: Marana Rian is dead. There's no way I can be taught more about Sneaking now.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_FGD02DandD_STAGE70_LOG0: Margarte has told me that she would pay well for minotaur horns or ogre teeth. However, she doesn't trust the Guild yet. I'll need to bring her five portions of ectoplasm, and she'll give us her business.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MQ16_STAGE40_LOG0: Martin and I are inside the Temple of the One. I must get Martin to the Dragonfires, or all hope is lost.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MQ13_STAGE40_LOG0: Martin and I have arrived on the battlefield. I must protect Martin until the Great Gate opens.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MQ07_STAGE10_LOG1: Martin asked me to speak to Jauffre about Mythic Dawn agents spying on Cloud Ruler Temple.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MQ09_STAGE10_LOG0: Martin has deciphered a second item needed for the ritual: the 'blood of a Divine'. He could not imagine a way to obtain such a thing, until Jauffre suggested a solution: the blood of Tiber Septim, who was once mortal but became a god. I should ask Jauffre how to obtain this blood.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MQ13_STAGE10_LOG0: Martin has deciphered the fourth item needed for the ritual: a Great Sigil Stone. Unfortunately, it is the anchor for a Great Gate -- the kind of Oblivion Gate the Mythic Dawn opened at Kvatch. While it is very dangerous to allow the Mythic Dawn to proceed with their plan to attack Bruma, it is our only hope to obtain a Great Sigil Stone. Martin will lead the defense of Bruma, while I enter the Great Gate to obtain its Sigil Stone.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MQ12_STAGE10_LOG0: Martin has deciphered the third item needed for the ritual: a rare Ayleid artifact known as a Great Welkynd Stone. He knows of only one place that still might contain one, the Ayleid ruins of Miscarcand. I must find the Great Welkynd Stone of Miscarcand and bring it to Martin at Cloud Ruler Temple.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MQ08_STAGE10_LOG0: Martin has found a section of the Mysterium Xarxes which describes a ritual which will allow him to open a portal to Camoran's Paradise, where Mankar Camoran has taken the Amulet of Kings. He has learned that four items are required for this ritual, but has only identifed one so far: 'the blood of a Daedra Lord', which he says refers to a Daedric Artifact.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MQ12_STAGE40_LOG1: Martin has not yet deciphered the last item needed for the ritual to open a portal to Camoran's Paradise. I should help the Bruma Guard close the Oblivion Gate outside Bruma while he continues to study the Mysterium Xarxes.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MQ15_STAGE15_LOG0: Martin performed the ritual and opened the portal to Camoran's Paradise. He warned me that the portal would close behind me. Martin believes that since Mankar Camoran bound himself to the Mysterium Xarxes in the creation of Paradise, I can only return to Tamriel by killing him. I must enter the portal, kill Mankar Camoran, recover the Amulet of Kings.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MQ16_STAGE35_LOG0: Martin said that while mortal weapons may hurt Mehrunes Dagon, they cannot destroy him. He said that if he can only reach the Temple of the One, there is still a chance to turn defeat into victory.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MQ16_STAGE80_LOG0: Martin shattered the Amulet of Kings and transformed himself into an avatar of Akatosh, the Dragon God of Time. In dragon form he banished Mehrunes Dagon to Oblivion and ended the Oblivion Crisis, and then vanished. Whether he is dead, or has ascended to join his ancestor Tiber Septim, no one knows.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MQ10_STAGE10_LOG0: Martin told me that Jauffre needs to speak to me.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MQ15_STAGE95_LOG0: Martin took the Amulet of Kings from me, and placed it around his neck -- he is indeed of the Septim blood. But he reminded me that Mankar Camoran's death will not halt the Oblivion crisis. Mehrunes Dagon's invasion will continue until Martin lights the Dragonfires in the Temple of the One.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MQ14_STAGE60_LOG0: Martin was pleased to see me return alive from the Great Gate. I gave him the Great Sigil Stone, and he has gone to Cloud Ruler Temple to prepare for the portal-opening ritual.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TrainingIllusion_STAGE100_LOG0: Martina Floria has agreed to train me.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TrainingIllusion_STAGE200_LOG0: Martina Floria is dead. It is now impossible for me to be taught more about Illusion magic.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS91_STAGE40_LOG0: Mazoga asked me to take her to Fisherman's Rock, and I told her, 'Maybe later.' She seemed disappointed.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS92_STAGE105_LOG0: Mazoga is dead. Now I'll never know how to find Black Brugo.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS91_STAGE200_LOG0: Mazoga is dead. Now I'll never learn Mazoga's story.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS92_STAGE30_LOG0: Mazoga knows Black Brugo, and has a plan to ambush him. Black Brugo visits his gang's hideout to collect his share of the loot every night between midnight and six in the morning. The hideout is an Ayleid ruin west of Leyawiin called Telepe. Mazoga offered to help me find and kill Black Brugo. She will wait in the Castle Hall until I ask her to follow me.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS91_STAGE60_LOG0: Mazoga spoke to Mogens Wind-Shifter, and then they started to fight. Mogens has his gang with him so Mazoga needs some help.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS91_STAGE85_LOG0: Mazoga told me she attacked the bandits to avenge the murder of her friend, Ra'vindra. She invited me to take what I wish from the dead... her vengeance is her reward.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS91_STAGE90_LOG0: Mazoga told me she attacked the bandits to avenge the murder of her friend, Ra'vindra. She invited me to take what I wish from the dead... her vengeance is her reward.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS92_STAGE35_LOG0: Mazoga was reluctant to betray a former associate, but she says, sooner or later, Black Brugo visits a hideout west of Leyawiin called Telepe.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MQ16_STAGE30_LOG0: Mehrunes Dagon is here! The barriers between Oblivion and Tamriel have been destroyed! Our only hope now is to somehow defeat Mehrunes Dagon and cast him back into Oblivion. Perhaps Martin will know what to do.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS40_STAGE70_LOG0: Melisande has created a potion to cure vampirism. I have been given two doses; one for myself and one that I need to take to Castle Skingrad. I should travel there and speak with Hal-Liurz.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS40_STAGE41_LOG0: Melisande has given me a special dagger, with which I am to collect the blood of an Argonian. I should find an Argonian, stab him with the dagger, and return it to Melisande.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS40_STAGE42_LOG0: Melisande requires the ashes of a powerful vampire to complete her cure. I should search the area near the North Panther River for Hindaril, a vampire who was imprisoned in an underground cavern many years ago.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS40_STAGE60_LOG0: Melisande's dagger is covered in Argonian blood. I should deliver it to her so that she can brew the potion.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_DAMolagBal_STAGE110_LOG0: Melus Petiliusis dead, so I cannot complete the task given to me by Molag Bal.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_DAMephala_STAGE20_LOG0: Mephala has told me about the settlement of Bleaker's Way. She would like me to kill the leaders of the two families, and leave evidence that the murders were done by the other family. I am to allow no one to see me commit the crimes.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_DAMephala_STAGE105_LOG0: Mephala was disappointed in my failure.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_DAMephala_STAGE100_LOG0: Mephala was pleased with the strife I have caused. She has rewarded me with the Ebony Blade.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_DAMephala_STAGE10_LOG0: Mephala's followers have told me that, in order to summon the Daedra, I must first leave an offering of nightshade at her statue between midnight and dawn. [You must be level 15 to begin this quest.]
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MG09Motives_STAGE30_LOG0: Mercator Hosidius told me the Count will meet with me South of the Cursed Mine west of town at 2 AM.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MG09Motives_STAGE20_LOG0: Mercator Hosidius, a liason to the Count of Skingrad, has told me the Count is not accepting visitors. I need to return tomorrow.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_DAMeridia_STAGE100_LOG0: Meridia was gratified that I had performed the task assigned to me. As a reward, I have been given the Ring of Khajiiti.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TG03Elven_STAGE50_LOG0: Methredhel contacted me. She says that this whole job was just a setup to flush out the informant, a Dark Elf named Myvryna Arano. They didn't see fit to let me in on the plan though. She has specific instructions from Armand to plant the bust in Myvryna's cupboard. Then I have to find Hieronymus Lex and snitch on her.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TG01BestThief_STAGE70_LOG0: Methredhel delivered the diary to Armand before me. She has been accepted into the Thieves Guild.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TG05Misdirection_STAGE15_LOG0: Methredhel has a plan to force Hieronymus Lex to lift his seige of the Waterfront. Myself and four other Thieves Guild operatives will go on a crime spree. Each of us is assigned a high profile item to steal. I am to steal Hrormir's staff from the Archmage's room at the Arcane University. I have a note I am supposed to leave in his nightstand.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TG01BestThief_STAGE20_LOG0: Methredhel has beaten me to Amantius Allectus' diary. If I can't get it from her somehow, she will get into the guild and I'll be left out in the cold. It's too bad the competition rules won't let me kill her. However, Armand didn't say anything about stealing from her!
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TG01BestThief_STAGE22_LOG0: Methredhel has escaped. If I want that diary, I going to have to track her down. I wonder if the beggars can help me?
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TG05Misdirection_STAGE45_LOG0: Methredhel has one last task for me. It's too dangerous to return Hrormir's Icestaff directly to the Arcane University. Instead,  I have to put the Icestaff into a chest in Ontus Vanin's home. He is a researcher for the Arcane University and will certainly find it there.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TG08Blind_STAGE10_LOG0: Methredhel sought me out and delivered a message from the Gray Fox. I am to meet him at the home of Helvius Cecia in Bruma. He has an important task for me. Finally, I am going to get to meet the head of the Thieves Guild in person.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE06_STAGE35_LOG0: Mirel, the Golden Saint lieutenant, told me that his scouts have recently discovered a side passage leading to the Altar of Despair through the Underdeep. He believes an attack down this route will take the Dark Seducers by surprise, but has not been able to convince his commander, Kaneh.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE06_STAGE35_LOG1: Mirel, the Golden Saint lieutenant, told me that his scouts have recently discovered a side passage leading to the Altar of Despair through the Underdeep. He believes an attack down this route will take the Dark Seducers by surprise. I should scout the Dark Seducer deployments in both the side passage and the main passage and find out if Mirel is right.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE37_STAGE20_LOG0: Mirili Ulven has asked that I capture a Baliwog for her. All I need to do is get it close to her and she'll subdue it. She has promised to reward me handsomely.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE37_STAGE40_LOG0: Mirili Ulven has asked that I capture a Gnarl for her. All I need to do is get it close to her and she'll subdue it. She has promised to reward me handsomely.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE37_STAGE50_LOG0: Mirili Ulven has asked that I capture a Scalon for her. All I need to do is get it close to her and she'll subdue it. She has promised to reward me handsomely.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE37_STAGE30_LOG0: Mirili Ulven has asked that I capture an Elytra for her. All I need to do is get it close to her and she'll subdue it. She has promised to reward me handsomely.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE37_STAGE210_LOG0: Mirili Ulven has died. I'll never understand what she was trying to accomplish with her taxonomy.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE37_STAGE25_LOG0: Mirili Ulven has paid me for capturing a Baliwog.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE37_STAGE45_LOG0: Mirili Ulven has paid me for capturing a Gnarl.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE37_STAGE55_LOG0: Mirili Ulven has paid me for capturing a Scalon.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE37_STAGE35_LOG0: Mirili Ulven has paid me for capturing an Elytra.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE37_STAGE10_LOG0: Mirili Ulven of Highcross is willing to pay 10 gold coins for samples of various rare items. She'll only pay for one sample of each though. She gave me a list of the items she is interested in.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE37_STAGE200_LOG0: Mirili has all of her plants and animals now. Her beastiary is complete and her taxonomy of plantlife is complete.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS46_STAGE45_LOG0: Mirisa said that I ended the war just by taking the head from Timberscar Cave. I should tell Barthel Gernand that it's safe for him and his family to return to Cropsford.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS46_STAGE20_LOG0: Mirisa says that the goblins at Cropsford are war parties from Cracked Wood Cave, on their way to attack a rival tribe at Timberscar Cave. She's not sure, but usually goblin wars are caused by one tribe stealing the Totem Head from another.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS46_STAGE20_LOG1: Mirisa suggested two ways to deal with the goblins at Cropsford. One is to recover the Totem Head from the goblins in Timberscar Cave, which would stop the war between the two tribes and leave Cropsford in peace. The other way to keep the goblins away from Cropsford is to kill the shaman of the Cracked Wood Cave tribe, which should effectively destroy the tribe and stop their war parties from attacking Cropsford.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_FGD02DandD_STAGE10_LOG0: Modryn Oreyn has assigned me another of my duties. I am to travel to Leyawiin and find out why three members of the Fighters Guild--Dubok gro-Shagk, Rellian, and Vantus Prelius--have been causing trouble.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_FGD09Hist_STAGE10_LOG0: Modryn Oreyn has decided that the threat of the Blackwood Company must be ended. He wants me to travel to their headquarters and destroy the Hist Tree. It will be behind a locked door, and it is likely that only Ri'Zakar himself has a key.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_FGD06DeadViranus_STAGE10_LOG0: Modryn Oreyn has given me another duty to perform. A band of fighters was contracted to clear the Forsaken Mine of trolls, but none of them have been heard from, including Viranus Donton. I am to go investigate.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_FGD01Default_STAGE20_LOG0: Modryn Oreyn has told me that as my first duty, I am to find out why Maglir has defaulted on a contract he was given near Skingrad.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_FGD04Defector_STAGE10_LOG0: Modryn Oreyn has told me to go to Bravil and find out why Maglir has defaulted on another contract.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_FGD04Defector_STAGE100_LOG0: Modryn Oreyn was disturbed by the news about Maglir, but was glad that I was able to complete the contract.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_FGD03Viranus_STAGE10_LOG0: Modryn Oreyn would like me to complete a mission with Viranus Donton, the Guild Master's son.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_FGD08Infiltration_STAGE10_LOG0: Modryn Oreyn would like me to join the Blackwood Company. I am to go to their headquarters in Leyawiin, infiltrate their ranks, and follow them on a mission to find out the secret of their effectiveness.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_DAMolagBal_STAGE20_LOG0: Molag Bal has spoken to me, and wishes me to help him corrupt Melus Petilius, by forcing him to kill me with the Cursed Mace. I should travel to Brindle Home and see what I can find.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_DAMolagBal_STAGE100_LOG0: Molag Bal was pleased that I was able to corrupt the paladin. He has rewarded me with the Mace of Molag Bal.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_DAMolagBal_STAGE10_LOG0: Molag Bal's follower has told me that, in order to summon the Daedra, I must present an offering of a lion pelt to the statue. [You must be level 17 to begin this quest.]
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_Dark05Assassinated_STAGE50_LOG0: Motierre has been revived, but his ancestors have risen from the dead, angry at the desecration of their tomb! I must keep Motierre alive and escort him out of the Undercroft and to the Grey Mare, where he can arrange passage out of Cyrodiil.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_Dark05Assassinated_STAGE30_LOG0: Motierre has been slashed with the Languorwine Blade and appears to have died from the wound, as expected. I must now flee from Chorrol, and leave Hides-His-Heart alive.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_Dark05Assassinated_STAGE60_LOG0: Motierre has escaped. I must now return to the Dark Brotherhood Sanctuary and speak with Vicente Valtieri to receive my reward.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_ND04_STAGE90_LOG1: My attempts to reach the Mace of Zenithar have been unsuccessful. No matter what I try, I cannot reach the other platform. Perhaps if I continue my quest for the other relics, an answer will present itself.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_ND04_STAGE90_LOG0: My attempts to reach the Mace of Zenithar have been unsuccessful. No matter what I try, I cannot reach the other platform. Perhaps the solution lies with one of the other relics.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_DEM02_STAGE50_LOG0: My cover is blown. I have no option other than fighting back.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MQ06_STAGE41_LOG1: My cover is blown. The Mythic Dawn know I am an enemy. I must reach the inner shrine and locate the Amulet of Kings.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE06_STAGE50_LOG2: My report that the Underdeep was lightly defended convinced Kaneh that this was the better attack route. I need to help the Golden Saints get through the Underdeep before the Dark Seducers realize what is happening.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TG07Lex_STAGE15_LOG0: My sources tell me that there is a master forger in Anvil. He is known only as The Stranger. He lives in a house by the Mages Guild.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_DANamira_STAGE100_LOG0: Namira appreciated my efforts. I have been rewarded with the Ring of Namira.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS12_STAGE70_LOG0: Near the body of the messenger, I've discovered a slate tablet with what appears to be Akaviri writing on its surface. These must be the orders the messenger spoke about in the diary.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE05_STAGE110_LOG1: Nelrene admits to being involved in a conspiracy, and has named Muurine as the architect of the plot. I'll need more evidence before confronting Muurine.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE05_STAGE110_LOG0: Nelrene has admitted to being involved in the conspiracy. I now have enough evidence to confront Muurine.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE05_STAGE90_LOG0: Nelrene has denied involvement in any sort of conspiracy. I'll need to be more persuasive with her, or find direct evidence she's involved.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_FGC03Flagon_STAGE22_LOG0: Newheim has mentioned that he had a family heirloom, a pewter flagon, stolen by the thieves. If I return it to him, he'll reward me.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_FGC03Thieves_STAGE24_LOG0: Newheim has told me that the thieves are all Bosmer and may be located in Hrota Cave, north of the city of Anvil. Maglir and I should travel there and take care of them.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MQ01_STAGE58_LOG0: Nice shot! You can retrieve arrows from the world, as well as recovering the arrows you fire into enemies.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_DANocturnal_STAGE100_LOG0: Nocturnal was pleased that I have returned the Eye of Nocturnal. I have been rewarded with the Skeleton Key.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_FGC02Protect_STAGE100_LOG0: Norbert Lelles was surprised to learn that the men breaking in were all former employees, though none had been with him long. He was glad that the problem was taken care of, though.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS48_STAGE40_LOG1: Now I must reach the Sigil Stone and remove it from the Sigil Keep to close the Oblivion Gate that it anchors.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MQ01_STAGE34_LOG1_0: Now practice casting spells. Open your journal, navigate to the Magic tab and equip the Clairvoyance spell.

ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_FGC08Prison_STAGE90_LOG0: Now that I have killed all of the fugitives, I should return to Burz gro-Khash for my reward.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE11_STAGE5_LOG1: Now that I have secured the stronghold of the Dark Seducers, I should speak to Sheogorath about our next step.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE11_STAGE5_LOG0: Now that I have secured the stronghold of the Golden Saints, I should speak to Sheogorath about our next step.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_HouseBravil_STAGE20_LOG0: Now that I've arrived at my new house in Bravil, I may want to head over to Nilawen at The Fair Deal to secure some furnishings for it.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_HouseBruma_STAGE20_LOG0: Now that I've arrived at my new house in Bruma, I may want to head over to Suurootan at Novaroma to secure some furnishings for it.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_HouseCheydinhal_STAGE20_LOG0: Now that I've arrived at my new house in Cheydinhal, I may want to head over to Borba gra-Uzgash at Borba's Goods and Stores to secure some furnishings for it.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_HouseChorrol_STAGE20_LOG0: Now that I've arrived at my new house in Chorrol, I may want to head over to Seed-Neeus at Northern Goods and Trade to secure some furnishings for it.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_HouseLeyawiin_STAGE20_LOG0: Now that I've arrived at my new house in Leyawiin, I may want to head over to Gundalas at Best Goods and Guarantees to secure some furnishings for it.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_HouseSkingrad_STAGE20_LOG0: Now that I've arrived at my new house in Skingrad, I may want to head over to Gunder at Colovian Traders to secure some furnishings for it.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_HouseImperialCity_STAGE20_LOG0: Now that I've arrived at my new house in the Imperial City, I may want to head over to Sergius Verus at Three Brothers Trade Goods to secure some furnishings for it.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE04Shell_STAGE200_LOG0: Now that I've become a member of the courts of both of the Dukes of Madness, I should return to Sheogorath and report my progress.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_ND02_STAGE12_LOG1: Now that I've recovered the Helm, I should proceed to the Priory of the Nine to see if it still holds the Cuirass of the Crusader.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_ND02_STAGE12_LOG0: Now that I've recovered the Helm, I should proceed to the Priory of the Nine. According to Sir Amiel's journal, I will need his ring to enter the Priory vaults where the Cuirass was kept.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE06_STAGE50_LOG3: Now that Ulfri's troops are redeployed to defend the Underdeep, Kaneh's attack down the main passage should catch the Dark Seducers completely off guard. I should help Kaneh defeat Ulfri and take control of the Altar of Despair.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MQ01_STAGE52_LOG0: Now that you have arrows, pick up the bow and practice using it.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_Dark05AssassinatedFIN_STAGE100_LO: Ocheeva has given me a new contract.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TrainingRestoration_STAGE200_LOG0: Oleta is dead. I have no chance of being taught more about Restoration magic now.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TrainingRestoration_STAGE100_LOG0: Oleta thanked me for helping to save Kvatch, and offered to train me in Restoration.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TrainingConjuration_STAGE200_LOG0: Olyn Seran is dead. I have no chance to be taught more about Conjuration now.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TrainingConjuration_STAGE20_LOG0: Olyn Seran wants me to prove my worth before he will train me. I need to summon a Faded Wraith in his presence.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SQ07_STAGE100_LOG0: On Slythe's corpse, I've located his last journal entry. It seems he fell here believing he was truly going to meet his god and give an offering to him to help all of Tamriel. His death is a sad end to such a well-intended sojourn.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MQ16_STAGE14_LOG0: On behalf of the Elder Council, Chancellor Ocato has recognized Martin as Uriel Septim's heir. Now all that remains is for Martin to light the Dragonfires in the Temple of the One.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS10_STAGE80_LOG0: Once Ulrich was led inside Llevana's house, she cast some sort of paralysis spell on him. At that point, Llevana released some rats upon Ulrich's helpless body that bit into him until he was dead. I should report this to Garrus.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_Dark19Whispers_STAGE10_LOG0: Once a week, I must speak with the statue of the Night Mother in Bravil. The Night Mother will give me a list of names and locations of people who require a visit from a Dark Brotherhood Speaker, to arrange an assassination. If I take this information to Arquen in the Cheydinhal Sanctuary, she will give me my weekly earnings. I can do this every week for as long as I want, and there is no penalty if I choose not to.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_DAClavicusVile_STAGE10_LOG0: One of Clavicus Vile's worshippers has told me that in order to summon the Daedra, an offering of 500 gold must be given to the statue. [You must be level 20 to begin this quest.]
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_DAMalacath_STAGE10_LOG0: One of Malacath's worshippers has told me that, in order to have the Daedra summoned, I must leave an offering of Troll Fat at the statue. [You must be level 10 to begin this quest.]
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_DAMeridia_STAGE10_LOG0: One of Meridia's followers has told me that the Daedra can be summoned if something from the corpse of an undead creature is left as an offering at the statue. [You must be level 10 to begin this quest.]
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_FGC08Prison_STAGE40_LOG0: One of my fellow Thieves has given me information on the fugitives. There are four of them: Enrion, Hlofgar, Ashanta, and Dreet-Lai. They are thought to be hiding in Bloodmayne Cave.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS05_STAGE200_LOG0: One of the characters needed to complete this quest has died.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS08_STAGE150_LOG0: One of the characters needed to complete this quest has died.

ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS29_STAGE5_LOG0: One of the shopkeepers in the Market District of the Imperial City has informed me of another shop that opened recently. Apparently, this shop's prices are so low it's undercutting all of their sales. They're collectively looking for someone to hire to investigate, as they suspect foul play. I was told to go speak with Jensine at her "Good as New" Merchandise store for more information.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS13_STAGE10_LOG1: One of the townspeople in Cheydinhal has mentioned the opening of what they suspect to be a gate to the realm of Oblivion just outside the city walls. The city guards seem on alert and tensions appear to be running high. I should make my way through the west gates of Cheydinhal to investigate.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS16A_STAGE15_LOG0: One of the townspeople in Chorrol mentioned that Sabine Laul at the Fighters Guild may know Weatherleah's location, as she has explored much of the surrounding area. I should speak to her next.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TGDirections_STAGE10_LOG0: Ongar is the fence in Bruma. The beggar told me he lives behind the temple. I should go to him if I have any stolen property to sell.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS11_STAGE115_LOG0: Opening the waterlogged chest with all three keys, I discovered the artifact to be an amulet. It seems fairly unremarkable, and I am unsure of its function. I think I should bring it back to Erline Lirrian and see what she wants me to do with it.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_FGD05Oreyn_STAGE50_LOG0: Oreyn and I have found and defeated Azani Blackheart.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_FGD09Hist_STAGE50_LOG0: Oreyn believes our work is now finished. He has given me the Helm of Oreyn Bearclaw as a symbol of our friendship. He suggests I speak with Vilena Donton and tell her all that has transpired.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_FGD04Defector_STAGE35_LOG0: Oreyn says I should speak with Aryarie in the Bravil Mages Guild in order to get the details needed to complete Maglir's contract.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_FGD06DeadViranus_STAGE100_LOG0: Oreyn was both angered and saddened by what I told him. He has asked that I allow him to tell Vilena Donton the news about her son. Until then, he suggests I find contract work to do.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_FGD08Infiltration_STAGE100_LOG0: Oreyn was deeply troubled by what I told him, but realizes that there was little I could have done to prevent it. He believes it is time to end the Blackwood Company forever.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_FGD02DandD_STAGE100_LOG0: Oreyn was pleased with my efforts, though troubled that the Blackwood Company is stealing Fighters Guild contracts.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_FGD05Oreyn_STAGE60_LOG0: Oreyn wishes to make sure people know who truly defeated the great warrior, and recognize the lies of the Blackwood Company. Oreyn would like me to give him Azani Blackheart's Ring as proof of our accomplishments here today.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_FGD07Kidnap_STAGE40_LOG0: Oreyn would like me to learn some things from Ajum-Kajin: how large the Blackwood Company is; who leads the Company; and what is the source of their power. Oreyn has told me I am to use whatever means necessary to get this information.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_FGD05Oreyn_STAGE5_LOG0: Oreyn would like to speak more about duties, once I am promoted to the next rank.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS31_STAGE90_LOG0: Ormil has explained that the treasure the thieves were looking for was just a publicity stunt he created to drum up more business for the tavern. He never expected to have the Bloated Float hijacked as a result of that stunt. He then suggested I get some sleep again for the voyage back to the Imperial City. I should do so to stay out of their way.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS31_STAGE75_LOG0: Ormil has instructed me to escort Selene to the room next to mine on the inn deck where she'll be locked in until we arrive at port. I should do so before the Bloated Float can get underway.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS31_STAGE100_LOG0: Ormil presented me with a bag of gold, and explained to me that the Imperial City guard had been looking for Selene, and there was a reward for her capture.

I should continue questioning the suspects the Countess recommended.

ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TG07Lex_STAGE13_LOG0: Orrin has shown me a secret passage within the walls of Castle Anvil. It should let me get closer to Dairihill's office without being seen by the castle guards.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TGDirections_STAGE40_LOG0: Orrin is the fence in Anvil. The beggar told me he lives in the far western corner of the city. I should go to him if I have any stolen property to sell.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TrainingMercantile_STAGE100_LOG0: Palonirya has agreed to train me.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TrainingMercantile_STAGE200_LOG0: Palonirya is dead. I cannot be taught any more to improve my Mercantile skill
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE08_STAGE100_LOG0: Passwall has been liberated and the forces of Order have been defeated. I should speak with Sheogorath.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_FGC03Thieves_STAGE20_LOG0: People in Anvil have suggested I speak with Newheim the Portly. He apparently had some goods stolen by the thieves.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_Dark11Kin_STAGE15_LOG0: Perennia Draconis has given me a document that lists the locations of all the members of her family. She thought I was the delivery person she hired to buy gifts for her children. I will instead use the list to find and slay each family member. I should start with Perennia herself. Then I must kill Matthias Draconis in the Talos Plaza District of the Imperial City, Andreas Draconis in the Drunken Dragon Inn, Sibylla Draconis in Muck Valley Cavern and Caelia Draconis in Castle Leyawiin.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_DAPeryite_STAGE20_LOG0: Peryite has told me that five of his followers, in an attempt to get closer to Him, have transported their souls to a plane of Oblivion. The Daedra would like me to travel there and carry their souls back to this world. I should approach the statue again when I am prepared to go.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_DAPeryite_STAGE100_LOG0: Peryite was grateful for my help. He has given me Spell Breaker as a reward.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MQ05_STAGE50_LOG1: Phintias told me he was holding Volume 3 of Mankar Camoran's "Commentaries on the Mysterium Xarxes" for a client named Gwinas, who has already paid for it. I should wait for Gwinas to come to the store, and see why he wanted it.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MQ05_STAGE60_LOG0: Phintias told me that Gwinas is on his way to pick up his copy of Volume 3. I should wait for him to arrive and find out what Gwinas knows.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MQ05_STAGE50_LOG0: Phintias, the bookseller at First Edition, has told me that he has a copy of Volume 3 of Mankar Camoran's "Commentaries on the Mysterium Xarxes" locked away. He is holding it for a client named Gwinas who has already paid for it. I need to get that book, and find out why Gwinas wanted it.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_FGC01Rats_STAGE50_LOG0: Pinarus has agreed to look for mountain lions with me. If we find them, we'll kill them, and make Arvena feel safer.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TrainingHeavyArmor_STAGE20_LOG0: Pranal has asked me to buy a gift for Malene, the owner of the Roxey Inn. I need to find a silver pitcher and four silver glasses and bring them to him.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TrainingHeavyArmor_STAGE200_LOG0: Pranal has died, which means I cannot be taught more about Heavy Armor.

ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE34_STAGE100_LOG0: Pyke was overjoyed at the return of his Medallion, and has rewarded me with a gift.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_FGC01Rats_STAGE110_LOG0: Quill-Weave thanked me for protecting her secret, and has trained me in Acrobatics for free.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE11_STAGE111_LOG0: Ra'kheran is dead. Without his help, I'll have to kill Ciirta myself.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE11_STAGE140_LOG0: Ra'kheran's betrayal of Ciirta has been successful. Now that she is dead, taking her eye should be a simple matter.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MG09Motives_STAGE10_LOG0: Raminus Polus has asked me to retrieve a book from Janus Hassildor, Count of Skingrad.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MG10Vahtacen_STAGE10_LOG0: Raminus Polus has asked that I speak with Irlav Jarol about assisting with his research.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MG18KingofWorms_STAGE100_LOG0: Raminus Polus thanked me for putting an end to the King of Worms, and has recognized me as Arch-Mage of the Mages' Guild.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE39_STAGE10_LOG0: Ranaar-Jo of Fellmoor is in desperate need of help, except he won't trust me until I've earned Kishashi's trust. I should find her and win her over.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE39_STAGE50_LOG0: Ranarr-Jo has asked me to wreck Cindanwe's house, and steal her notebook.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE39_STAGE210_LOG1: Ranarr-Jo is dead. I suppose he won't have to worry about Cindanwe now.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE39_STAGE210_LOG0: Ranarr-Jo is dead. I'll never know what he needed help with now.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE39_STAGE200_LOG0: Ranarr-Jo is grateful that I've taken care of Cindanwe. Now he and his neighbors can live in peace.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE39_STAGE20_LOG1: Ranarr-Jo is in need of a hero, but Kishashi won't tell me more until she can trust me. If I want to know more, I need to get her to trust me. She mentioned needing five pod pits.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_FGD07Kidnap_STAGE80_LOG0: Rather than divulge the Blackwood Company's secret, Ajum-Kajin has killed himself. I should speak with Oreyn for further instruction.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE09_STAGE20_LOG0: Relmyna has asked me to enter the depths of the Gardens of Flesh and Bone, and retrieve some mystical components needed for the ceremony to create the new Gatekeeper. I am to return with Blood Liqueur, Osseous Marrow, Dermis Membrane, and the Essence of Breath. She has given me a key that I can use to get into the Gardens and directly to her Sanctum when I return.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE09_STAGE70_LOG0: Relmyna has instructed me to choose the body parts with which we will create the new Gatekeeper. I am to pick out a head, a torso, a heart, a right arm, a left arm, and legs. I should speak with her when I am finished.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE09_STAGE90_LOG0: Relmyna will perform the ceremonial magic, and I am to follow her instructions during the ceremony.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS16_STAGE15_LOG0: Reynald denies that he's ever been to Cheydinhal recently. In fact, in his drunken condition, it's doubtful he could make it anywhere without falling down. Reynald's paid me fifty gold to travel to Cheydinhal and find the man who's impersonating him.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_DASheogorath_STAGE45_LOG0: Ri'Bassa has suggested I stay at the Border Watch Inn, which apparently has a large collection of cheeses.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS23_STAGE70_LOG0: Roland Jenseric insists that he's not a vampire. In fact, he's accusing Seridur of being one instead! I should listen to what he has to say about Seridur and see if I can determine who's telling the truth.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS23_STAGE80_LOG0: Roland tells me that he thought his lover was having an affair, so he followed her one night on a walk. He came across Seridur draining the blood from her neck. Roland says he attacked Seridur, and in the chaos, Roland's lover was killed. Seridur got away. Knowing Selidur was a respected member of the Imperial City, he panicked and ran to the cabin here to collect his thoughts and decide what to do next. I need to decide what to do about this.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS43_STAGE20_LOG0: Rosentia Gallenus has told me she acquired a strange Daedric staff, and after trying to examine it, she inadvertently summoned some scamps. Now the things follow her wherever she goes. Worse still, the staff seems cursed and she cannot drop it, sell it or get rid of it. She implored me to help her figure a way to rid her of the curse. She suggested I speak to a friend of hers at the Mages Guild, Alves Uvenim.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS43_STAGE100_LOG0: Rosentia Gallenus was gratified that I rid her of the scamps, and rewarded me with a daedric ring she identified as the Ring of Eidolon's Edge.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TrainingAthletics_STAGE100_LOG0: Rusia Bradus has agreed to train me in Athletics.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TrainingAthletics_STAGE200_LOG0: Rusia Bradus has died, along with my chances of learning more about Athletics.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TrainingAthletics_STAGE20_LOG0: Rusia Bradus says I need to see more of the world for myself. I need to explore Cyrodiil and discover more places on my own before she will train me.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS26_STAGE70_LOG0: Ruslan has agreed to testify against Audens Avidius in the morning. Now I just have to get Luronk gro-Glurzog to testify as well.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS14_STAGE75_LOG0: Rythe used the Brush of Truepaint to paint a door back to his studio. I should now step through and return back to Tamriel.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS37_STAGE20_LOG0: S'drassa described a bit about Garridan's Tears to me. Apparently, they're literally tears of a knight who was somehow frozen long ago. To find where they may be located, he suggested I speak to a colleague of his at the Arcane University in the Imperial City, Julienne Fanis.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS37_STAGE10_LOG0: S'drassa of the Mage's Guild in Leyawiin has tasked me to find Garridan's Tears. S'drassa enjoys collecting crystals of a magical nature, and is willing to pay a handsome amount gold for each Tear I recover. I should continue to speak to him about these unique formations.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TG05BloodPrice_STAGE55_LOG0: S'krivva has accepted my blood price. I have been reinstated in the Thieves Guild.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TG04Mistake_STAGE10_LOG0: S'krivva has asked me to retrieve a ring that belongs to Ahdarji. She is a Khajiit living in Leyawiin. I need to go to Leyawiin and see if I can find her.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TrainingSecurity_STAGE30_LOG0: S'krivva has given me a message for J'baana. I should deliver it to him at once.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TG07BloodPrice_STAGE71_LOG0: S'krivva has kicked me out of the Thieves Guild because I killed someone while trying to get the letter forged and replaced. I'll have to pay the blood price of 1000 gold per murder to be let back in. I can pay S'krivva.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TG06BloodPrice_STAGE61_LOG0: S'krivva has kicked me out of the Thieves Guild for killing someone while recovering Ahdarji's ring. The only way I can get back into the guild is to pay a blood price of 1000 gold coins for each person I killed. I can pay  S'krivva.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TG05BloodPrice_STAGE51_LOG0: S'krivva has kicked me out of the guild until I pay the blood price for my murders. I have to pay 1000 gold for each person I killed while helping Methredhel break the siege of the Waterfront. I can pay S'krivva.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TG07BloodPrice_STAGE75_LOG0: S'krivva has readmitted me to the Thieves Guild. Of course I had to pay the blood price first.

He was sent to steal a book entitled Lost Histories of Tamriel from the wizard in Castle Skingrad. My job is to recover the book. S'krivva doesn't care if Theranis delivers it to her or I do.  I'm getting 400 gold coins either way.

I should see what kinds of prices I can get from the new fence, Orrin.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TGStolenGoods_STAGE40_LOG0: S'krivva told me that she won't have another commission job for me until I sell more stolen property to Ongar or Dar Jee. I'll need about 200 gold worth of stolen goods before she will trust me sufficiently.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TGStolenGoods_STAGE70_LOG0: S'krivva told me that she won't have another commission job for me until I sell more stolen property to the guild fences, like Luciana Galena. I'll need about 500 gold worth of stolen goods before she will trust me sufficiently.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TGStolenGoods_STAGE50_LOG0: S'krivva told me that she won't have any commission jobs for me until I sell more stolen property to Ongar or Dar Jee. I'll need about 300 gold worth of stolen goods before she will trust me sufficiently.

ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TG05Misdirection_STAGE60_LOG0: S'krivva was very pleased. The Arcane University has forced Hieronymus Lex to break his siege of the Waterfront. She paid me the 300 gold coins she promised. I have been promoted to Cat Burglar within the Thieves Guild.

ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_Arena_STAGE50_LOG0: Security trainer and his box of locks are active!
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS45_STAGE100_LOG2: Seed-Neeus was overjoyed to see her daughter again.  They both thanked me profusely and swore their eternal gratitude, and Seed-Neeus gave me free Mercantile training.

Before he died, Theranis told Amusei where he hid a special treasure, which I assume is the book. If I can get him out of here, Amusei will tell me where the book is hidden. Of course being seen helping a known prisoner to escape is a crime. I'll have to avoid the guards in the castle.

ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MQ13_STAGE30_LOG0: The Countess has ordered her men to let the Mythic Dawn open the three Gates, and to deploy for battle outside the city gates. Martin has gone to lead the defense of the city. I should proceed to the battleground at once, and protect Martin at all costs.

I have to use this opportunity to slip into Xeddefen and find Order's source of power.

ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MQ15_STAGE33_LOG0: The Dremora Kathutet claims that something called the Bands of the Chosen are the key to the Forbidden Grotto, the only way out of the Savage Garden. I should get these Bands from him.
