I need to enter the Fountainhead beneath the Tree and find the source of the poison before it is too late.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE09_STAGE170_LOG0: The Gatekeeper has been rebuilt. I should return to Sheogorath with news of my success.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE02_STAGE150_LOG0: The Gatekeeper is dead. I should retrieve the keys to the Gates of Madness from the Gatekeeper's corpse.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE02_STAGE7_LOG0: The Gates of Madness are locked. Haskill mentioned that the Gates were guarded by the Gatekeeper. He must have the keys.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS18_STAGE50_LOG3: The Goblins have been defeated; I should return to Chorrol and tell Valus Odiil his sons are safe.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS18_STAGE50_LOG2: The Goblins have been defeated; I should return to Valus Odiil and inform him that Antus did not survive.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS18_STAGE50_LOG1: The Goblins have been defeated; I should return to Valus Odiil and inform him that Rallus did not survive.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS18_STAGE50_LOG0: The Goblins have been defeated; I should return to Valus Odiil and inform him that his sons did not survive.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE08_STAGE35_LOG1: The Golden Saint commander Aurig Desha has a plan to retake Passwall. I need to slip through the gate into the ruins of Xeddefen while her Golden Saints distract the knights. They will continue to hold the line at Passwall. I have to use this opportunity to slip into Xeddefen and find Order's source of power.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE06_STAGE120_LOG0: The Golden Saint commander is dead. I should finish off the remaining Golden Saints in Cylarne to complete the Dark Seducers' victory.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE06_STAGE130_LOG0: The Golden Saints in Cylarne have been utterly destroyed. I should speak to Ulfri about lighting the Flame of Agnon now that her forces control both of the altars.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TG09Arrow_STAGE39_LOG0: The Gray Fox accepted the key shaped arrow head. Apparently it is all that remains of the Arrow of Extrication. He is going to try and get it reforged.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TG09Arrow_STAGE40_LOG0: The Gray Fox accepted the key shaped arrow head. Apparently it is all that remains of the Arrow of Extrication. He is going to try and get it reforged. He thanked me for my efforts and promoted me to Master Thief in the Thieves Guild.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TG10Boots_STAGE50_LOG1: The Gray Fox gave me his thanks for getting the boots.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TG10Boots_STAGE20_LOG0: The Gray Fox has asked me to find out where Springheel Jak is buried. This famous thief died 300 years ago. He is rumored to have owned a pair of magical boots. The story also says he was buried in those boots. A relative of his, Jakben, Earl of Imbel, lives somewhere in the Imperial City.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TG08Blind_STAGE20_LOG0: The Gray Fox has given me the task of recovering Savilla's Stone from a monastery known as the Temple of the Ancestor Moths. It is in the mountains, somewhere north of Cheydinhal, in the farthest corner of Cyrodiil. Killing the human guardians of the stone will not put a bloodprice on my head, but killing innocent people will. The Gray Fox has promised me 500 gold coins.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TG08BloodPrice_STAGE81_LOG0: The Gray Fox has kicked me out of the Thieves Guild for killing someone while trying to recover Savilla's Stone. I'll have to pay 1000 gold per person killed as a blood price. I can pay Armand.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TG09BloodPrice_STAGE91_LOG0: The Gray Fox has recinded my Thieves Guild membership because I committed murder while obtaining the Arrow of Extrication. I can get back in if I pay the blood price. I can pay Armand.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TG10BloodPrice_STAGE101_LOG0: The Gray Fox has revoked my Thieves Guild membership. If I want back in, I'll have to pay 1000 gold for each murder to satisfy the blood price. I can pay Armand.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TG08Blind_STAGE40_LOG0: The Gray Fox has rewarded me for my efforts. He was fairly mysterious about why he needed the stone. He asked me to be available for when he next calls for me.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TG11Heist_STAGE110_LOG0: The Gray Fox has yet to pay me for stealing the Elder Scroll from the Imperial Palace. To get my reward, I have to present a ring to Millona Umbranox, the Countess of Anvil, and gauge her reaction to it. I don't understand what this has to do with the Elder Scroll, but for now I'll trust him.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TG11Heist_STAGE30_LOG0: The Gray Fox intends to steal one of the Elder Scrolls from the Imperial Palace. The audacity of such a theft is astounding! The Gray Fox has laid out the plan for me. It's not simple, but he has given me a written copy for my reference. He has even set aside the guild rule of blood price for this heist. Now I just have to execute the plan. The first step is to infiltrate the Imperial Palace and activate the Glass of Time, whatever that is.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TG11Heist_STAGE20_LOG0: The Gray Fox intends to steal one of the Elder Scrolls from the Imperial Palace. The audacity of such a theft is astounding! When I am ready, I should come back to him at Othrelos house.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TGStolenGoods_STAGE90_LOG0: The Gray Fox may be contacting me soon. Until then I sell more stolen property to the guild fences, like Orrin. I'll need at least 700 gold worth of stolen goods to get his attention..
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TGStolenGoods_STAGE110_LOG0: The Gray Fox may be contacting me soon. Until then I sell more stolen property to the guild fences, such as Fathis Ules. I'll need at least 1000 gold worth of stolen goods to get his attention..
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TGStolenGoods_STAGE100_LOG0: The Gray Fox may be contacting me soon. Until then I sell more stolen property to the guild fences. I'll need at least 800 gold worth of stolen goods to get his attention.. Now I can use the best fence the guild has, Fathis Ules.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TG10Boots_STAGE50_LOG0: The Gray Fox thanked me for getting him the boots. He paid me 500 gold coins for my efforts.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TG10Boots_STAGE49_LOG0: The Gray Fox thanked me for getting him the boots. However, I will not get my fee until I pay the blood price for my murders.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TG08Blind_STAGE39_LOG0: The Gray Fox took Savilla's Stone, but is withholding my payment until I pay the blood price and am reinstated into the guild
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TG09Arrow_STAGE20_LOG0: The Gray Fox will pay me 500 gold coins to steal the Arrow of Extrication. It was recently recovered by Bravil's court wizard, Fathis Aren. There will be no bloodprice for killing Fathis, so long as he doesn't die in the castle. I should start my search in Bravil.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TG11Heist_STAGE140_LOG0: The Gray Fox, who is no longer the Gray Fox, but is now Corvus Umbranox, has given me the Gray Cowl of Nocturnal. I am now the new Gray Fox and the new guildmaster of the Thieves Guild. Due to the magic of the cowl, the Thieves of the guild will not notice the change. However, since the curse is lifted, I can remove the cowl and be recognized as myself again. Interestingly, the cowl's magic makes it so that anyone seeing me remove the cowl does not associate me with the Gray Fox.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MQ14_STAGE10_LOG0: The Great Gate has opened! I must enter it at once and get its Great Sigil Stone, before the Bruma defenders are overwhelmed.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MQ16_STAGE20_LOG0: The Imperial City is under attack! Oblivion Gates have opened all over the city and daedra are pouring out! I must escort Martin safely to the Temple of the One where he can light the Dragonfires, close the Oblivion Gates, and save the city!
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MQDragonArmor_STAGE20_LOG0: The Imperial Dragon armor ordered for me by Chancellor Ocato should be ready. I can pick it up from the armory in the Imperial Legion Compound.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS16_STAGE25_LOG0: The Jemane brothers have been reunited. After they speak, I should speak to Guilbert, who seems the more levelheaded of the two brothers.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS16A_STAGE100_LOG2: The Jemane brothers have returned safely to Weatherleah.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE46_STAGE13_LOG0: The Manic Horkvir Bear-Arm has suggested I kill all the Demented in town. He'll reward me if I do.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TG08Blind_STAGE5_LOG0: The Monks of the Ancestor Moths read the Elder Scrolls. Apparenlty this makes them blind. When they retire, they are sent to live in an undergound temple. They are all masters of fighting in the dark.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TG11Heist_STAGE95_LOG0: The Moth Priests are onto me! I have to get out of here. The way back is closed. My only hope is to go forward and hope I can find another exit.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MQ07_STAGE30_LOG3: The Mythic Dawn agent named Jearl is dead. I should continue to search for other spies and locate their base in Bruma.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MQ07_STAGE30_LOG2: The Mythic Dawn agent named Jearl is dead. I should continue to search for other spies and locate their base in Bruma. Perhaps I should speak to Captain Burd, as Jauffre suggested.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MQ07_STAGE30_LOG1: The Mythic Dawn agent named Jearl is dead. I should continue to search for the other Mythic Dawn spy in Bruma.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MQ07_STAGE30_LOG0: The Mythic Dawn agent named Jearl is dead. I should report to Jauffre that both the Mythic Dawn spies are dead.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MQ07_STAGE31_LOG3: The Mythic Dawn agent named Saveri Faram is dead. I should continue to search for other spies and locate their base in Bruma.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MQ07_STAGE31_LOG2: The Mythic Dawn agent named Saveri Faram is dead. I should continue to search for other spies and locate their base in Bruma. Perhaps I should speak to Captain Burd, as Jauffre suggested.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MQ07_STAGE31_LOG1: The Mythic Dawn agent named Saveri Faram is dead. I should continue to search for the other Mythic Dawn spy in Bruma.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MQ07_STAGE31_LOG0: The Mythic Dawn agent named Saveri Faram is dead. I should report to Jauffre that both the Mythic Dawn spies are dead.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_Dark18Mother_STAGE50_LOG0: The Night Mother has named me Listener of the Black Hand! It would appear my days of killing for the Dark Brotherhood have come to an end. When I'm ready, I should speak to the Night Mother again and she will use her power to teleport me to the Cheydinhal Sanctuary.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_DLCOrrery_STAGE100_LOG0: The Orrery at the Arcane University should be functional once more. I can visit it as often as I like, and also receive powers based on the phases of the moons.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_ND09_STAGE20_LOG0: The Prophet has arrived at the Priory to see me. My knights have gathered in the Chapel to listen to him preach. I should speak to him immediately.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_Dark10Sanctuary_STAGE20_LOG0: The Purification is now complete. Every Dark Brotherhood member based out of the Cheydinhal Sanctuary has been killed. I must now report back to Lucien Lachance at Fort Farragut.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE03_STAGE200_LOG0: The Resonator of Judgment has been attuned.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MQ05_STAGE81_LOG2: The Sponsor has realized that Baurus did not come alone. I must get the fourth book from him!
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MQ05_STAGE81_LOG1: The Sponsor has realized that I did not come alone. I must get the fourth book from him!
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MQ05_STAGE82_LOG1: The Sponsor wants Baurus dead! I need to get the fourth book of Mankar Camoran's "Commentaries" from him no matter what.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MQ05_STAGE82_LOG0: The Sponsor wants me dead! I need to get the fourth book of Mankar Camoran's "Commentaries" from him no matter what.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TG07Lex_STAGE40_LOG0: The Stranger has forged a new letter for me. Now I have to go to the Imperial Legion compound in the Imperial City. I have to seal the letter using the official seal of the Legion Commander.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_ND08_STAGE80_LOG1: The Sword of the Crusader has been reconsecrated. I now possess all eight of the Crusader's Relics. Before I return to the Priory, I must prevent Umaril's aurorans from desecrating the Chapel of Arkay.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_ND08_STAGE80_LOG2: The Sword of the Crusader has been reconsecrated. I now possess all eight of the Crusader's Relics. I should return to the Priory to consult with my knights about how to attack and destroy Umaril.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE06_STAGE37_LOG1: The Underdeep is only lightly defended by the Dark Seducers. It appears that they do not believe the Golden Saints will attack this way. I should survey the Dark Seducer deployments along the main passage leading to the Altar of Despair, and then report my findings to Kaneh.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MG13Information_STAGE50_LOG1: The Vampire Hunters have left Skingrad. All that's left now is to remove the vampires from Bloodcrust Cavern.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MG13Information_STAGE50_LOG0: The Vampire Hunters have left Skingrad. I should return to Castle Skingrad and speak with Hal-Liurz.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MG13Information_STAGE40_LOG0: The Vampire Hunters in Skingrad have been killed.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MG13Information_STAGE30_LOG0: The Vampires in Bloodcrust Cavern have been disposed of. I should return to Count Hassildor and let him know my task is complete.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MG13Information_STAGE30_LOG1: The Vampires in Bloodcrust Cavern have been disposed of. Now I must deal with the Vampire Hunters.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TG03Elven_STAGE30_LOG0: The Waterfront is crawling with Imperial Watch. They are all looking for Armand Christophe. I'm sure he won't show at midnight. Dareloth's Garden is too hot. I'll need to find out where he is hiding. Maybe one of the other Thieves Guild members knows. I'll have to start asking around for them.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE10_STAGE54_LOG0: The Wellspring of the Aureal has been restored. I need to help Staada defeat the remnants of the forces of Order.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE10_STAGE55_LOG1: The Wellspring of the Aureal has been restored. I need to speak with Staada.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE10_STAGE49_LOG0: The Wellspring of the Mazken has been restored. I need to help Dylora defeat the remnants of the forces of Order.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE10_STAGE50_LOG1: The Wellspring of the Mazken has been restored. I need to speak with Dylora.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MQ15_STAGE36_LOG1: The Xivilai Anaxes is dead, although Kathutet told me not to kill it. I should find out if he will still give me the Bands of the Chosen, as he promised.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS39_STAGE20_LOG0: The alchemist I've spoken to has referred me to Sinderion in Skingrad. Apparently he specializes in the more botanical aspects of alchemy. I should bring the Nirnroot to him.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TG09BloodPrice_STAGE95_LOG0: The bloodprice has been accepted. I am back in the Thieves Guild. My promotion ot MasterThief is now final as well. I finally got paid for the theft of the Arrow of Extrication.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MQ08_STAGE9_LOG0: The book "Modern Heretics" describes the location of the Shrine of Azura. Perhaps if I visit this Shrine I can learn how to obtain a Daedric Artifact.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TG10Boots_STAGE37_LOG0: The boots were not in the tomb of Springheel Jak. I did find a diary though. Maybe it can provide a clue.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_Dark07Medicine_STAGE30_LOG0: The bottle of poisoned medicine has been placed in the cabinet, and the real medicine removed. The next time Roderick is given treatment, he will die. I must now return to the Sanctuary and speak with Ocheeva to receive my reward.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MQ01_STAGE56_LOG0: The bucket near the well will make a good target practice. To draw and aim your bow, hold <IA id="IA_Game_Combat_Attack"/> and release it.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TG03Elven_STAGE60_LOG0: The bust is in Myvryna's cupboard. Now to tell that windbag Lex where to find it.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE05_STAGE200_LOG0: The conspiracy has been stamped out. Lady Syl has executed Muurine, and thanked me for my help.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_Dark04Execution_STAGE50_LOG0: The contract has been fulfilled, but I was unable to prevent the death of any guards. I must return to the Sanctuary and speak with Vicente Valtieri to receive my reward. Unfortunately, the bonus is forfeit.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE08_STAGE40_LOG1: The counterattack on Xeddefen has begun. Aureg Desha and her Golden Saints will distract the knights. While the Golden Saints fight, I need to slip past the gates of Xeddefen and locate the source of the Spire's power.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE08_STAGE40_LOG0: The counterattack on Xeddefen has begun. Kiskella Udico and her Dark Seducers will distract the knights. While the Dark Seducers fight, I need to slip past the gates of Xeddefen and locate the source of the Spire's power.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MQ15_STAGE40_LOG0: The dremora Kathutet gave me the Bands of the Chosen, which he says will let me escape the Savage Garden into the Forbidden Grotto. I should find the door to the Forbidden Grotto and see if he was telling the truth.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE04_STAGE45_LOG0: The effects of Felldew have worn off, and withdrawal is setting in. I need to either reach the Chalice of Reversal quickly, or find more Felldew as I make my way through the Burrow.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MQ05_STAGE32_LOG0: The enemy agent who attacked Baurus is dead. I should find out what Baurus has learned about our enemies.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MQ04_STAGE25_LOG0: The enemy has stolen the Amulet of Kings from its hiding place in Weynon Priory. I should let Jauffre know at once.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_DASanguine_STAGE10_LOG0: The follower of Sanguine have told me that, in order to summon the Daedra, I will need to leave an offering of Cyrodilic Brandy at the statue. [You must be level 8 to begin this quest.]
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_DANamira_STAGE20_LOG0: The followers of Namira have decided that I am repulsive enough to summon the Daedra. I may now approach the statue.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE08_STAGE30_LOG1: The force of Knights attacking Passwall have been eliminated. I should speak to Aurig Desha about the situation.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE08_STAGE30_LOG0: The force of Knights attacking Passwall have been eliminated. I should speak to Grakendo Udico about the situation.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE08_STAGE26_LOG0: The forces of Order are advancing on Passwall. We must defeat them all.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE02_STAGE10_LOG1: The formidable Gatekeeper has destroyed a party of adventurers. I should talk to the residents of Passwall before trying to deal with this creature.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE32_STAGE20_LOG1: The ghost of Count Cirion has told me a tale of tragedy. The people of Vitharn were overrun by invaders centuries ago. Four defenders in the bailey failed in their duties. Now cursed to relive the last moments of the invasion over and over. Count Cirion has begged me to put the shades of his people to rest. I have no idea how to do this. Maybe the ghosts themselves can tell me.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE32_STAGE30_LOG0: The ghost of Desideratus Annius told me he must get back home to protect his betrothed. Tragically, by leaving his post, they both perished. There must be something I can do to get him to stand fast.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS06_STAGE100_LOG0: The ghost of Grantham Blakeley appeared after I unlocked the shackles. He thanked me for freeing him and said to take the map concealed somewhere in this room. I think the map leads to the old man's treasure. I should take the map and leave this place. My work here is done.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS06_STAGE30_LOG0: The ghost stopped its somber walk at a rocky outcropping jutting into Niben Bay. He identified himself as Grantham Blakeley, and simply said "Look for me in the mouth of the panther. Please, release me." Then it turned back out to the Bay and looked out over the water. I think it was looking that way specifically. I should try and ask Gilgondorin about the "mouth of the panther".
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS06_STAGE30_LOG1: The ghost stopped its somber walk at a rocky outcropping jutting into Niben Bay. He identified himself as Grantham Blakeley, and simply said "Look for me in the mouth of the panther. Please, release me." Then it turned back out to the Bay and looked out over the water. I think it was looking that way specifically. Perhaps someone in Bravil would know more about this spirit and the "mouth of the panther".
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS06_STAGE20_LOG0: The ghostly figure of the Forlorn Watchman has appeared on the shore of Niben Bay. Perhaps I should watch him for a bit and see what he does.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE32_STAGE200_LOG0: The ghosts of Vitharn have been laid to rest.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_ND02_STAGE30_LOG0: The ghosts of the former Knights of the Nine have appeared and blocked my path to the Cuirass of the Crusader. They will not let me pass until I best each of them in single combat.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MQ09_STAGE70_LOG0: The ghosts of the four cursed Blades have dispelled the evil enchantment on the Shrine of Tiber Septim. The way to the Armor is now open.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_FGD08Infiltration_STAGE60_LOG1: The goblins invading Water's Edge have been defeated.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS26_STAGE30_LOG0: The guards are no help. Any complaints about guard activities are to be taken to the guard captain. Of course Audens Avidius is one of the guard captains, so that won't work. I could try talking to one of the other Watch Captains.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_Dark18Mother_STAGE30_LOG0: The incantation has revealed the hidden door to the Night Mother's crypt! I must follow the other members of the Black Hand down into the crypt. Once we're down there, the traitor will surely try to destroy the Night Mother. I must stop the traitor at all costs!
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS11_STAGE80_LOG0: The innkeeper, Olav, told me that Gelebourne was slain in Skingrad by none other than Raynil. As with Bradon, Raynil claimed Gelebourne was a vampire. I think Raynil is using the vampire as a cover story to get the keys to the chest where they stashed the artifact. I think it's time to speak to Carius Runellius about Raynil. He must be stopped.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS08_STAGE90_LOG0: The key I discovered on the Orc Hunter was indeed a fake and the real key was on Kurdan's body. He'd never intended to let us leave whether we won his demented hunt or not. The real key should allow me to unlock the gateroom inside the Hunter's Run and then leave Fort Grief. I will then have to bring Ursanne the sad news.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE06_STAGE38_LOG1: The main passage leading to the Altar of Despair is strongly defended by the Dark Seducers. I should scout the Underdeep to see if it might provide an easier attack route.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_Dark01Knife_STAGE20_LOG0: The man named Rufio is dead. The next time I sleep in a location he deems secure, Lucien Lachance will visit me once more, and complete my entrance into the Dark Brotherhood.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_DLCBattlehornCastle_STAGE30_LOG0: The marauders who were attacking Battlehorn Castle have been defeated, and the grateful survivors have granted me the deed to the castle. I've learned that I can purchase everything I need to restore Battlehorn Castle to its former glory from Nilphas Omellian at the Merchants Inn in the Market District of the Imperial City.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_FGD02DandD_STAGE50_LOG0: The men tell me that the reason they've been spending time in the tavern is sheer boredom. The Blackwood Company has been stealing all the Fighters Guild work in the area.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_Dark03Accidents_STAGE20_LOG0: The mounted head has fallen on Baenlin, killing him as expected. I must return to the Sanctuary and speak with Vicente Valtieri to receive my reward.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MG08MagesStaff_STAGE30_LOG1: The necromancers that ambushed me have been defeated. I need to get wood for a staff, and get back to Raminus Polus to tell him what's happened.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MG08MagesStaff_STAGE30_LOG0: The necromancers that ambushed me have been defeated. I need to take this unfinished staff, and get back to Raminus Polus to tell him what's happened.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MQ01_STAGE92_LOG1: The nine divines grant you insight, making you realize the importance of Uriel Septim's request. Equip and cast the Clairvoyance spell to <RT_BlueMed>reveal the path to your next objective</>.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS16A_STAGE40_LOG0: The ogres have been defeated. I should make my way back to Chorrol and bring this information to Guilbert.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TG06Atonement_STAGE40_LOG0: The only prisoner in Castle Skingrad's jail is Larthjar. He told me that the Pale Lady, whoever she is, took Theranis days ago. I don't like the sound of that. There was an Argonian prisoner in the same cell as Theranis. Apparently he was also taken by the Pale Lady just a couple of hours ago. The Argonian put up quite a struggle and was bleeding. It's the only clue I've got right now. I'd better follow it.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MQ01_STAGE130_LOG0:
The potential <RT_BlueMed>gain</> or <RT_BlueMed>loss</> for each action is <RT_BlueMed>based on your Speechcraft and how full the wedge is</>.
Try to select fuller wedges when they are aligned with actions the person likes.
Try to select emptied wedges when they are aligned with actions he doesn't like.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_ND06_STAGE40_LOG0: The priest has told me that the only way to lift the curse from Kellen is to take it on myself. I need to pray at the altar in the Chapel if I wish to lift the curse.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE32_STAGE100_LOG0: The priest, Hloval Dreth, doesn't have nearly enough magicka to support the soldiers defending the gates. I need to find something that will boost his magicka. He won't take my earthly items, so it will have to be something in his spirit realm.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE10_STAGE55_LOG0: The remaining forces of Order have been defeated. I should speak to Staada.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE10_STAGE50_LOG0: The remaining forces of Order have been defeated. I should speak with Dylora.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_FGC08Prison_STAGE20_LOG0: The residents of Bravil are reluctant to speak about the fugitives, for fear of retribution. Perhaps I will have to persuade one of them to give me the information.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS12_STAGE90_LOG0: The ruins appear to be infested with undead Akaviri. I don't know how long they've been trapped here, but I should proceed with caution. I need to locate the Akaviri commander of the fort who is said to possess the Draconian Madstone.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_DASheogorath_STAGE40_LOG0: The shaman Ri'Bassa has told me of the K'Sharra Prophecy. The first sign is vermin infestation. The second sign is plague, and all the livestock are supposed to die. I will need to find a way first to create an infestation of vermin.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE02_STAGE130_LOG5: The sorceress has dropped a handkerchief full of her tears, which apparently can hurt the Gatekeeper. I should get  that handkerchief. I can also find Jayred to get the arrows made from dead Gatekeeper bones, once he is done making them.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE02_STAGE130_LOG1: The sorceress has dropped a handkerchief full of her tears, which apparently can hurt the Gatekeeper. I should get that handkerchief.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE02_STAGE130_LOG4: The sorceress has dropped a handkerchief full of her tears, which apparently can hurt the Gatekeeper. I should get that handkerchief. I can also follow Jayred to the Gardens of Flesh and Bone.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE02_STAGE130_LOG2: The sorceress has dropped a handkerchief full of her tears, which apparently can hurt the Gatekeeper. I should get that handkerchief. I can also talk to Jayred about killing the Gatekeeper.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE02_STAGE130_LOG3: The sorceress has dropped a handkerchief full of her tears, which apparently can hurt the Gatekeeper. I should get that handkerchief. I can also tell Jayred I'm ready to go to the Gardens of Flesh and Bone.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE02_STAGE130_LOG6: The sorceress has dropped a handkerchief full of her tears, which apparently can hurt the Gatekeeper. I should get that handkerchief. Jayred is still willing to come fight the Gatekeeper with me.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_Dark18Mother_STAGE40_LOG0: The traitor, Mathieu Bellamont, is dead, and the crisis that has plagued the Dark Brotherhood is now over. The Night Mother still needs to name a new Listener. I should wait and hear what she has to say...
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_FGD09Hist_STAGE30_LOG0: The tree has become a perversion of nature. It is surrounded by alien machinery. If I am to destroy this monstrosity, I will need to find a way to destroy the machinery that surrounds it.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TG01BestThief_STAGE60_LOG0: The word on the street is that Methredhel delivered Amantius Allectus diary to Armand. I hope Armand has something else I can do to get into the Thieves Guild. I should go see him at midnight in the Garden of Dareloth.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_ND08_STAGE50_LOG0: The wraith of Lord Vlindrel is destroyed. I need to reclaim the Sword of the Crusader that he somehow twisted to his evil purpose.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TG06Atonement_STAGE45_LOG0: Theranis is dead. I found his body in the secret chamber with Amusei and the Pale Lady.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE32_STAGE11_LOG0: There are ghostly warriors fighting in this place. Their battle cries lead me to believe this place is named Vitharn. Something strange is going on here. I can see the fortress keep, but there is no obvious entrance. I'll have to search around for a hidden way in. Even then, I'm not sure what I'll find.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TG10Boots_STAGE20_LOG1: There is a descendent of Springheel Jak living in the Imperial City named Jakben, Earl of Imbel. The Gray Fox has suggested I look there for clues as to where he is buried. Once I know where to look, I am to get the boots and bring them back to the Gray Fox in Ganredhel's house in Cheydinhal.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TG11Heist_STAGE70_LOG0: There must be some secret way to open this door. I'll bet this is where I have to use the Arrow of Extrication. Most likely I have to be standing in a special place for the keyhole to open up. It will be somewhere with a clear view of this pillar.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MG02Alter_STAGE90_LOG0: There's no evidence of a recommendation in Falcar's room, but I've found Black Soul Gems. I should take them to Deetsan immediately.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE32_STAGE90_LOG1: These ghostly arrows are quite strange. I am unable to nock them though.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TG11Heist_STAGE71_LOG0: These walls look like they are meant to move. Maybe the place I need to stand to fire the arrow is behind them. I'd better look for a way to get through them.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE32_STAGE45_LOG1: This ghostly doll is very odd. I have a feeling I should keep it with me for a while.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TG11Heist_STAGE72_LOG0: This must be the spot. Standing on this pressure plate opens the pedestal at the far end of the room. I should practice with normal arrows a few times before trying the Arrow of Extrication. I will only get one try.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MQ01_STAGE96_LOG2: This page displays all your active quests. Click on an active quest and hit the MAP button to display the world map showing your current quest target (if any). You can click on any icon on the map to travel directly to that location.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MQ01_STAGE96_LOG1: This page displays all your active quests. Select an active quest and press X to display the world map showing your current quest target (if any). You can select any icon on the map to travel directly to that location.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SQ06_STAGE10_LOG0: Thorley Aethelred, a shepherd who lives at the Shardrock Farm, has tasked me to slay six West Weald Bears and bring back their fangs as proof. They've been threatening his sheep, and he has nowhere else to turn.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS29_STAGE110_LOG0: Thoronir has agreed to donate all his ill-gotten merchandise to the local temple and begin selling legitimate merchandise. He also rewarded me with a small ring as a token of his esteem. I should now bring the macabre manifest and Agarmir's shovel to Jensine for my reward.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_FGD07Kidnap_STAGE100_LOG0: Though we did not get all of the answers we had hoped for, Oreyn is pleased with the information we gained.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS14_STAGE30_LOG0: Tivela told me that Rythe had been locked in his studio to work on his latest painting. He usually comes out to eat and sleep, but hadn't done so for more than a day. When she went in to investigate, he was gone. The odd thing was that the study door was still locked. Tivela gave me the key to Rythe's study. If I intend to find him, that's where I should start.

ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TrainingAlteration_STAGE10_LOG0: To learn more about Alteration, I must find Tooth-in-the-Sea, who lives north of Bravil, near Niben Bay.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE07A_STAGE5_LOG0: To learn more about Syl's routine, I should begin by asking around New Sheoth about Syl to determine the best way to get close enough to kill her.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS92_STAGE20_LOG0: To locate Black Brugo, the Count suggested I should ask Mazoga, who might have contacts among outlaws.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS23_STAGE40_LOG0: To locate Roland Jenseric, Seridur suggested I search his home, which is also here in the Temple District.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS08_STAGE60_LOG0: To my surprise, I've come across Aleron Loche inside the ruined keep of Fort Grief! He told me that the search for the axe is a ruse that Kurdan gro-Dragol uses to lure people into the ruins. Apparently, Aleron and I are now the prey in a bizarre hunting sport that Kurdan created. I should talk to Aleron and find out more.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS51_STAGE15_LOG0: To recover the stolen painting, I should begin by questioning the castle residents, and then search the Castle for physical clues that could help solve the mystery. My best bet would be to start with the Countess herself.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TrainingArmorer_STAGE10_LOG0: To train further in my Armorer study, I must speak with Gin-Wulm in the Imperial City's Market District.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MQ01_STAGE54_LOG0: To use a bow, press <IA id="IA_Game_Default_OpenInventoryMenu"/> and <RT_BlueMed>equip</> both the <RT_BlueMed>bow and the arrows</>.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TrainingAlteration_STAGE100_LOG0: Tooth-in-the-Sea has agreed to teach me what he knows about Alteration magic.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TrainingAlteration_STAGE20_LOG0: Tooth-in-the-Sea has told me I must prove myself; I need to meet him out in Niben Bay during the day.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TrainingAlteration_STAGE200_LOG0: Tooth-in-the-Sea is dead, making it impossible to further my training in the skill of Alteration.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TrainingAcrobatics_STAGE100_LOG0: Torbern has agreed to train me in Acrobatics in Aerin's absence.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE42_STAGE210_LOG0: Tove is dead. I'll never find another buyer for these useless Calipers and Tongs.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE42_STAGE200_LOG0: Tove seems to have run out of uses for calipers and tongs. However, I earned a tidy little sum off of him in the mean time.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE42_STAGE10_LOG0: Tove the Unrestful is looking for calipers and tongs. He says he'll pay five gold each for them. I don't remember agreeing to help him, but somehow I am.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE06_STAGE175_LOG0: Ulfri sacrificed herself on the Altar of Despair in order to light the Flame of Agnon. I can now retrieve the Flame from the courtyard and bring it back to New Sheoth as Sheogorath commanded.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE06_STAGE150_LOG1: Ulfri thanked me for my help in securing Cylarne for the Dark Seducers. She is now heading for the Altar of Despair, where she says she will "sacrifice herself" to kindle the Flame of Agnon. I should accompany her and see what happens.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_ND10_STAGE100_LOG0: Umaril is utterly destroyed. I have completed my holy quest.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_ND08_STAGE70_LOG1: Umaril's Aurorans have been destroyed. Cheydinhal Chapel is safe, for now. I can now reconsecrate the Sword of the Crusader to Arkay on the high altar.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_ND08_STAGE70_LOG0: Umaril's Aurorans have been destroyed. Cheydinhal Chapel is safe, for now. I should return to the Priory to consult with my knights about how to attack and destroy Umaril.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS27_STAGE89_LOG0: Umbacano died during the expedition to Nenalata. I failed in my duty to protect him. Now I will never know what secrets are hidden in the Throne Room of Nenalata.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS27_STAGE60_LOG0: Umbacano has asked me to meet him at the Ayleid ruin of Nenalata. He wants me to help him reach the throne room so that he can complete his research on the last king of the Ayleids.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS22_STAGE10_LOG1: Umbacano has asked me to retrieve a carved panel from an Ayleid site known only as the High Fane in his sources. He has given me a sketch which will help me identify this ruin, as well as one of the carving which he wants. He also gave me a carved stone key which will allow me to enter the central chamber of the High Fane when I find it.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS27_STAGE10_LOG0: Umbacano has hired me to obtain an Ayleid Crown he wants from Herminia Cinna, a rival collector. He paid me in advance; whatever I do not use to purchase the crown I can keep as my fee.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS21_STAGE20_LOG0: Umbacano has offered to pay well for any more statues I find. I should look for more of them in Ayleid ruins, and bring them to him. If I can find all ten of the statues, he will pay me a large bonus.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS27_STAGE15_LOG0: Umbacano hired me to retrieve the Crown of the Ayleids from Herminia Cinna, a rival collector. By chance, I had already stolen the crown, and was able to deliver it immediately, to Umbacano's great surprise.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS27_STAGE84_LOG0: Umbacano is dead. The only thing left to do is try to escape this death trap!
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS22_STAGE10_LOG4: Umbacano promised to pay me 1200 gold if I retrieved the carved panel from the High Fane for him.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS22_STAGE10_LOG5: Umbacano promised to pay me 1600 gold if I retrieved the carved panel from the High Fane for him.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS22_STAGE10_LOG6: Umbacano promised to pay me 2000 gold if I retrieved the carved panel from the High Fane for him.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS22_STAGE10_LOG7: Umbacano promised to pay me 2500 gold if I retrieved the carved panel from the High Fane for him.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS22_STAGE10_LOG2: Umbacano promised to pay me 500 gold if I retrieved the carved panel from the High Fane for him.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS22_STAGE10_LOG3: Umbacano promised to pay me 800 gold if I retrieved the carved panel from the High Fane for him.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS22_STAGE80_LOG0: Umbacano thanked me for attempting to recover the carving, but has already paid Claude Maric for completing the task.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS22_STAGE90_LOG0: Umbacano thanked me for delivering the carving, and paid me the promised reward for it in gold.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS27_STAGE95_LOG0: Umbacano was horribly destroyed in Nenalata when he declared himself King of the Ayleids using the crown of the rival city of Lindai. Now to escape the wrath of the undead denizens of Nenalata!
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS27_STAGE90_LOG0: Umbacano was transformed into an evil Ayleid King in the throne room of Nenalata. I must escape from this death trap!
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS21_STAGE40_LOG0: Umbacano's research has uncovered evidence that some of the Ayleid statues he is looking for may be hidden in these ruins: Moranda, Mackamentain, Wenyandawik, Ninendava, Fanacas.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE38_STAGE190_LOG0: Una Armina is dead. There's no point in looking for any more exhibits for her Museum of Oddities.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE38_STAGE21_LOG0: Una Armina paid me for the deformed Swamp Tentacle that I brought for her museum. I should bring her any new Oddities that I find.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE38_STAGE24_LOG0: Una Armina was happy to add Din's Ashes as an exhibit in her Museum of Oddities. I should bring her any new Oddities that I find.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE38_STAGE29_LOG0: Una Armina was happy to add my Dagger of Friendship as an exhibit in her Museum of Oddities. I should bring her any new Oddities that I find.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE38_STAGE20_LOG0: Una Armina was pleased with the "blind" Watcher's Eye that I brought for her museum. I should bring her any new Oddities that I find.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE38_STAGE26_LOG0: Una Armina was pleased with the "soul tomato" I brought for her Museum of Oddities. I should bring her any new Oddities that I find.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE38_STAGE28_LOG0: Una Armina was pleased with the Hound's Tooth Key I brought for her museum. I should bring her any new Oddities that I find.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE38_STAGE31_LOG0: Una Armina was pleased with the Mute Screaming Maw that I brought for her museum. I should bring her any new Oddities that I find.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE38_STAGE22_LOG0: Una Armina was pleased with the Sheogorath-shaped lump of amber that I brought for her museum. I should bring her any new Oddities that I find.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE38_STAGE27_LOG0: Una Armina was pleased with the unusual Mixing Bowl I brought her. I should bring her any new Oddities that I find.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE38_STAGE23_LOG0: Una Armina was very happy with the Pelvis of Pelagius. I should bring her any new oddities I find.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE38_STAGE10_LOG0: Una Armina, the proprietor of the Museum of Oddities in Crucible, told me that she is always looking for new exhibits for her museum. If I find anything "odd," I should bring it to her.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_Dark16Kiss_STAGE20_LOG0: Ungolim is dead. I must now journey to the city of Anvil, and pick up my reward and next contract at the dead drop there. It is located in the barrel just behind the pond, in the city of Anvil.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_DarkVamp_STAGE100_LOG0: Upon awakening, I discovered two bleeding pinpricks on my neck. It would appear Vicente Valtieri did indeed visit me last night, and pass along his Dark Gift! If what Valtieri told me is true, my vampirism will begin to manifest itself in three days, after I sleep once more.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_ND01_STAGE5_LOG0: Upon completing my pilgrimage to the wayshrines, I received a vision from the Divine Crusader, Pelinal Whitestrake. He revealed the location of his lost shrine, which is where I should begin my quest for the Relics of the Crusader.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS04_STAGE20_LOG0: Upon further questioning, I've discovered that Maelona's husband, Gogan, was carrying a family heirloom when the all-female gang robbed him.  She's desperate to get the ring back, and is offering 100 gold for its return.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE46_STAGE60_LOG0: Urul gro-Agamph living on the Dementia side of Split is dead.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE46_STAGE60_LOG1: Urul gro-Agamph living on the Mania side of Split is dead.

ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE43_STAGE10_LOG0: Ushnar gro-Shadborgob has asked me to make Bhisha the Khajiit "disappear". He seems to have a unhealthy fear of cats. Ushnar said he would pay me to do it, but he was somewhat vague about the nature of the payment.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE43_STAGE210_LOG0: Ushnar gro-Shadborgob is dead and so is my hope to get a reward out of him.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE43_STAGE200_LOG0: Ushnar was very grateful. He gave me one of his former dogs as a pet. There was something strange about how he phrased it though.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE03A_STAGE20_LOG1: Using a huge pile of treasure as bait, I lured the two remaining adventurers into a fire trap. Syndelius the Mage didn't survive the blast, leaving only their leader, Grommok. I should make my way to the last observation room and choose how the stubborn Orc will encounter his final obstacle.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE40_STAGE30_LOG1: Uungor doesn't trust me enough to agree to switch sleeping accommodations with Amiable Fanriene. I need to make him more disposed to the idea.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE40_STAGE30_LOG0: Uungor doesn't trust me enough to agree to switch sleeping accommodations with Amiable Fanriene. I need to make him more disposed to the idea. Maybe one of the others knows something that will work.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE40_STAGE40_LOG0: Uungor has agreed to switch beds with Amiable Fanriene. I should return to Amiable and tell him the good news.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE40_STAGE50_LOG0: Uungor is dead. Amiable Fanriene can now use his bedroll to sleep in. I should go tell Amiable the good news.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_DAVaermina_STAGE100_LOG0: Vaermina was pleased that I returned the Orb of Vaermina. I have been rewarded with the Skull of Corruption.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_DAVaermina_STAGE10_LOG0: Vaermina's followers have told me that an offering of a black soul gem is needed in order to summon the Daedra. [You must be level 5 to begin this quest.]
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_Dark04Execution_STAGE40_LOG0: Valen Dreth is dead, and no guards have been killed. I must return to the Sanctuary and speak with Vicente Valtieri to receive my reward, as well as a bonus.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS18_STAGE10_LOG0: Valus Odiil is concerned about his sons, who are going to fight creatures that have been appearing in the woods outside of Chorrol. After speaking with Valus, I've agreed to join them. When I'm prepared, I should make my way to Weynon Priory.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS18_STAGE100_LOG0: Valus Odiil thanked me for helping his sons, and gave me a fine weapon named Chillrend as a reward.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS18_STAGE200_LOG0: Valus Odiil thanked me for trying to help his sons, but since both of them died, he was unable to give any reward due to funeral expenses.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS18_STAGE120_LOG0: Valus Odiil thanked me for trying to help his sons, but since one of them died, he was unable to give a full reward due to funeral expenses.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MG03Illusion_STAGE20_LOG0: Varon Vamori admitted to taking Ardaline's staff, but has sold it to a friend in the Imperial City. I need to deliver this news to Kud-Ei.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS02_STAGE80_LOG0: Velwyn agreed to meet me back in Anvil at The Count's Arms. I should return there as soon as possible.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS02_STAGE88_LOG0: Velwyn and I have arrived at the secret door.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS02_STAGE87_LOG0: Velwyn and I have arrived in Benirus Manor. I must proceed cautiously to the secret room's entrance and prevent any harm from befalling us if the curse is to ever be lifted from this place.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS02_STAGE90_LOG0: Velwyn successfully opened the door to the secret room, which has stopped the ghosts from attacking. He then ran off, leaving me to clean up the mess. It's up to me, and me alone, to investigate what's beyond the mysterious portal.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_DarkVamp_STAGE110_LOG0: Vicente Valtieri believes there is a cure for vampirism. If I wish to investigate further, I should speak with Raminus Polus, a mage who has done some research into the subject. I can find him in the Imperial City, at the Arcane University.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_Dark05AssassinatedFIN_STAGE20_LOG: Vicente Valtieri has no more contracts for me. Instead, I must speak with Ocheeva here in the Sanctuary. She will provide my new assignments.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_DarkVamp_STAGE116_LOG0: Vicente Valtieri is dead. If I need further information on vampirism, I'll have to find it elsewhere...
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_DarkVamp_STAGE115_LOG0: Vicente Valtieri is dead. If I wish to become a vampire, I must seek another means of acquiring the Dark Gift...
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_FG00Expulsion_STAGE50_LOG0: Vilena Donton has offered me a chance to redeem myself. I must bring her twenty minotaur horns in order to be reinstated into the Fighters Guild.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_FGD01Default_STAGE10_LOG0: Vilena Donton has told me that, as a member of the Fighters Guild, there are a number of duties I'll be expected to perform. She would like me to speak with Modryn Oreyn about these.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_FGD09Hist_STAGE95_LOG0: Vilena Donton suggests that one of my first actions should be to reinstate Modryn Oreyn as my second-in-command, if he will accept the post.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_FGD09Hist_STAGE90_LOG0: Vilena Donton was astounded by the events I recounted, and she now realizes that her unwillingness to act could have caused the demise of the Fighters Guild. She has promoted me to Master of the Guild.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_FGD03Viranus_STAGE50_LOG0: Viranus Donton and I have arrived at Nonwyll Cavern. We'll have to find out what happened to Galtus Previa, and I should make sure no harm comes to the young Donton.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS45_STAGE20_LOG0: Vlandhonder Moslin denies knowing anything about Dar-Ma.  He says no young Argonian has stayed in his inn recently.  His evasive manner leads me to suspect he is lying, however, and I should continue my search of the town for clues to Dar-Ma's whereabouts.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS45_STAGE41_LOG0: Vlanhonder Moslin admits that Dar-Ma arrived in Hackdirt, but still denies knowing anything about her disappearance.  I am now sure that foul play was involved, and will continue my search of the town for any sign of her.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS26_STAGE50_LOG0: Watch Captain Itius Hayn is willing to arrest Audens Avidius if I can produce two witnesses that will publically accuse him. The only victims I know are Ruslan, Luronk gro-Grurzog, and Jensine. I'll need to talk to them.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MQ04_STAGE30_LOG0: We agreed that we must find someplace safe to take Martin. Jauffre suggested Cloud Ruler Temple, the hidden Blades fortress near Bruma. I should escort Martin and Jauffre there immediately.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MQ16_STAGE10_LOG0: We have arrived in the Elder Council Chamber. I must formally present Martin's claim to Chancellor Ocato, the head of the Elder Council.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_FGD03Viranus_STAGE70_LOG0: We have found the corpse of Galtus Previa. We should now return to Modryn Oreyn.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_FGD03Viranus_STAGE100_LOG0: We have returned with news of Galtus Previa to Modryn Oreyn. He was pleased with our efforts, and has paid the contract to Donton. For my efforts, he has given me a magic blade.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS18_STAGE40_LOG0: We've arrived at Odiil Farm. I need to help Antus and Rallus Odiil defeat the creatures that have been plaguing their home.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_FGD08Infiltration_STAGE50_LOG0: We've arrived at Water's Edge, which it seems has been overrun by goblins. I have been given the order to attack.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS14_STAGE80_LOG0: We've arrived back in Rythe's home. The painting is now sealed, and Rythe is safe. I should speak to him when I have a moment.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_FGC01Rats_STAGE55_LOG0: We've killed all the mountain lions Pinarus believes are in the area. I should return to Arvena Thelas.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_FGD05Oreyn_STAGE40_LOG0: We've searched the ruins of Arpenia, and the place is deserted. There are no corpses, no signs of battle. Oreyn believes that the entire story was made up by the Blackwood Company, that perhaps they paid off Azani Blackheart to move his base of operations. Oreyn suggests we search nearby Ayeleid ruins, and knows of one to the northeast.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_DANocturnal_STAGE40_LOG0: Weebam-Na denies knowing anything about the Eye of Nocturnal, and tells me Bejeen knows nothing, either. Perhaps I should try to listen in on their conversations, and see if they offer any clues.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_DANocturnal_STAGE35_LOG0: Weebam-Na is dead, so I can't learn where he has hidden the Eye of Nocturnal... except by searching every dark, wet place in the world.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS91_STAGE210_LOG0: Weebam-Na is dead. Now I'll never know what Mazoga wanted, and I can never learn Mazoga's story.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS91_STAGE35_LOG0: Weebam-Na spoke with Mazoga. Perhaps now Mazoga will tell me what's going on.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_DANocturnal_STAGE55_LOG0: Weebam-Na suspects I have been eavesdropping on his conversations. I must get to Tidewater Cave and look for the Eye of Nocturnal.

ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TG10Boots_STAGE35_LOG0: What luck! The family mausoleum for the Imbels is in the basement of the Jakben's house. The poor Earl was so terrified he told me everything I needed to know. He even gave me the key! Now to find those boots.

ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MQ01_STAGE82_LOG0_2: When a <RT_BlueMed>fight begins</>, the eye will flicker and two chevrons will appear on its sides.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_DANamira_STAGE30_LOG0: When summoned, Namira spoke to me about the Forgotten, a group of fanatical worshippers that lives in the darkness of Anga. Some priests of Arkay are planning to bring light to Anga and "save" the Forgotten Ones. I am to use the spell that Namira has given me on the priests, and let the Forgotten Ones finish them off.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_DANocturnal_STAGE20_LOG0: When summoned, Nocturnal spoke to me of the Eye of Nocturnal, which has been stolen. The Daedra believes the thieves to be in Leyawiin. I am to go there, find the thieves, and return the Eye to the shrine.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MQ01_STAGE120_LOG0:
When you hover each possible action, the character's face <RT_BlueMed>shows their reaction</> to it. It can be Love, Like, Dislike or Hate.
Their <RT_BlueMed>disposition increases</> if you select a <RT_BlueMed>Loved</> or <RT_BlueMed>Liked action</> and <RT_BlueMed>decreases</> if you select a <RT_BlueMed>Disliked</> or <RT_BlueMed>Hated action</>.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_Arena_STAGE40_LOG0: Where my supplier at? Oh yeah, in my cave.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_MS08_STAGE5_LOG0: While in Bravil, I've heard that Ursanne Loche's husband, Aleron, is missing. If I wish to help, I should attempt to locate Ursanne and see if I can find out more information.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_FGD08Infiltration_STAGE60_LOG0: While leaving Water's Edge, the Hist Sap again began to have a strange effect on me.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_Dark01Knife_STAGE10_LOG0: While sleeping, I was visited by Lucien Lachance, a representative for the assassins guild known as the Dark Brotherhood. He said that if I wish to join his "family," I must go to the Inn of Ill Omen, find a man named Rufio, and kill him. If I simply leave Rufio alone, Lachance will never visit me again.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_TG05Misdirection_STAGE30_LOG0: While spying on Hieronymus Lex, I saw a Dremora delivered a note to him. Lex has begun moving his watchmen out of the Waterfront. I think this is the signal for me to report back to Methredhel. Lex dropped that note. I wonder if I can find it?
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE07B_STAGE15_LOG0: Wide-Eye has described to me a bit of her routine. I'll need to find where she gets Greenmote from and obtain some without being discovered. Wide-Eye mentions she does a "special errand" at noon every day, I should follow her and see where she goes.
ST_LogEntries.LOC_LE_SE04_STAGE20_LOG0: Wide-Eye has told me that the Chalice of Reversal is locked away in Dunroot Burrow. I'll need to ingest Felldew to enter the Burrow, and pass through to reach the Chalice.
